tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ston pa shākya'i dbang po'i mdzad pa brgya pa'i bris yig rje btsun kun snying gis mdzad pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir skye ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa nas brtsams te/ gdul bya mchog dman thams cad la thun mong du snang ba'i mdzad pa rnam thar rags rim grags che che 'dṛ tshul ni/ dang por nam mkha' la dga' ldan lha'i gnas mtshon byed sprin gyi dbus na rin po che'i ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs me tog dang*/ mtsho rdzing dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ khang bzang mang po yod pa tsho gsum/ sa gzhi gcig la 'brel ba'am/ ma 'brel ba dga' ldan gyi bkod pa tshar gsum/ stabs gang bde ba zhig 'bri/ bkod pa rgyas shos shig tu/ dam pa tog dkar 'khor lha thams cad la chos gsung pa'i tshul zhig 'bri/ gcig tu dam pa tog dkar de dung dkar 'bud pa dang*/ lha mang po rol mo sna tshogs byed pa dang*/ lha gnyis kyi zhu ba byed pa'i tshul bya/ yang gnas gcig shos der/ dam pa tog dkar gyi byams pa la dbu brgyan prog zhu bskon pa'i tshul byed/ sa gzhi la grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu/ rgyal po pad ma chen po dang mnyan yod du rgyal po rtsibs kyi ring 'phur dang*/ 'phags rgyal du rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas dang*/ kau sham+bi ru rgyal po dmag brgya pa dang*/ grong khyer ser skyar rgyal po zas gtsang ma btsun mo'i mchog gnyis dang bcas pa/ grong khyer lhas bstan du rgyal po legs par rab sad rnams bzhugs pa'i bkod pa bya ste/ khang bzang pho brang drug po de dag lnga po ni/ bar mtshams che ba dang bcas 'bri zhing*/ ser skya lhas bstan gnyis kyi bar na chu yod pa cung zad thag nye ba zhig yod pa bya/ de rnams spyir gang bde ba de la 'bri na'ang*/ ngom che sa zhig tu ser skya yod pa byed/ bar snang la lha phran mang po phan tshun du 'gro ba dang gtam smra ba'i tshul 'bri zhing*/

rgyal po pad ma chen po'i pho brang dang nye ba'i nags tshal gcig tu/ rang sangs rgyas mang du tshogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phags te lus las 'od sna tshogs 'phro ba gcig dang*/ lus las sprin spros shing glog dang char 'bab pa zhig dang*/ me 'phro ba gcig 'bri/ grong khyer de rnams kyi nye 'khor so so na/ spyir bkod pa gang legs dang/ rtsa'i spyil po dang*/ lo ma'i spyil po dang*/ phug pa sogs na mu stegs ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad rnams 'bri'o/ /de dag las rang sangs rgyas la/ deng sang gtsug tor 'bri ba'i srol 'dug kyang 'bri mi dgos/ smin mtshams su mdzod pu nar mo zhig bya ste mi nor ba'i phyir yin/ bshad tshod med/ sku chas rab byung spyi dang 'dra ba la/ chos gos la gra mi dgos shing/ lhung bzed nag po'i tshab tu/ ku ba'am slong phor gyi rnam pa thogs pa/ 'ga' zhig chu shing gi 'khar ba bsnams pa sogs kyang rung/ 'khar gsil dang/ chos gos gra drug dang/ lhung bzed dang po ti sogs mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med pa'i skabs su rang rgyal 'byung ba yin pas so/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad la/ rdzogs byed la sogs pa rtog ge pa drug po'i rim can du/ dang po skra bregs shing gos tsag btsos kyi smad g.yogs chung ngu gyon pa/ gnyis pa ral ba khams ser bcings shing*/ rgya gar pa'i 'dom dkris gru gsum yod pa/ /lhag ma gos spangs zhing rna brgyan chung ngu yod pa/ lus la thal bas byugs pa/ gsum pa ni skra bregs shing*/ dbyug gu rtse gcig pa dang*/ spyi blugs yod pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas smad dkris pa/ bzhi pa ni skra bregs shing*/ 'khor lo lta bu'i bem po nag po gyon pa/ lnga pa yang de dang 'dra ba las/ ral pa nag po can gos dkar po gyon pa/ drug pa ni gcer bu 'dom dkris kyang med pa/ skra rnams btogs pas zad zad por gyur pa/ dkyil krungs mnyam bzhag byas pa/

bram ze rgyus rgyal la sogs pa drug kar mtshungs par bram ze'i cha byad yin pas/ phrag pa g.yas ston pa'i tshangs skud dkar po mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'am/ ras dkar po'am dmar pos 'dom gang tsam du ring ba smad dkris su byas pa/ rgya gar ba'i lugs kyi gon lugs dang mthun pa/ dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs dang po ti sogs 'chang ba/ dpral pa tsan dan gyi thig le gyen du bgreng ba gsum mam/ gcig gi 'phreng la gsum bsgrigs sam/ sked nyag gser bre dngul bre dbyibs 'dra rung yod pa sogs so sor ji ltar 'os pa 'bri/ thams cad kha spu ring ba dang*/ skra gzhan bregs shing gtsug phud spyi bor bcings pa'am/ ral pa ma yin par bshad/ mgo thor cog spyi gtsug tu yod pa bya/ rgan gzhon la sogs pa dmigs gsal gyi khyad yod na ma gtogs bram ze 'bri dgos phal cher la cha lugs 'di bzhin du byed/ bram ze yin zer nas bod pa'i rtogs ldan rgad po'i 'dra ba kho na mi 'bri'o/ ring phur la sogs pa snyoms 'jug pa drug po ni/ ral pa bcings shing 'dzings pa leb leb pa/ kha spu dang sen mo ring po/ 'doms dkris gru gsum dang*/ ri dwags kyi pags pa dang/ shing lo'i gos ci rigs pa yod pa/ bya ma bum ra 'khris su bzhag pa/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas pa 'bri/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad de rnams la/ 'khor re gnyis sam cung zad re byed/ de dag dga' ldan du skye ba mngon par 'byung ba'o/ 7 /rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i pho brang ma mo de dang nye ba'i khang bzang gcig tu/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo mnal mdzad pa'i tshul dang*/ khang bzang gi steng gi nam mkha' nas/ glang po che dkar po mche ba drug pa 'bab ba'i tshul dang*/ gzhan yang khang bzang de'i nam mkha' la mja' 'od zlum po 'dra ba bzhi'i nang du/ yum gyi rmi ltas bzhi po hal tshon lta bu la phra mo re bri bar bya ste/

gcig tu glang po rang gi lus la zhugs pa/ gcig tu yum nyid nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ gcig tu yum nyid brag ri la 'dzegs pas rtse mor phyin pa/ gcig tu skye bo mang po yum nyid la phyag 'tshal ba 'bri'o/ /dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i skor ro/ / (ka) yang de dag dang nye ba'i khang bzang gcig tu/ yum gyi sku'i lto ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' lhums su zhugs pa ni/ lha'i sku 'dra ba 'od zer 'phro bas brgyan pa dang*/ yum gyi sku g.yas g.yon du lha'i bsrung ma bzhi/ ral gri dang*/ mdung dang*/ mdung thung dang*/ mda' bo che rnams 'dzin pa yod pa/ 'khor g.yog mang po mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa 'bri'o/ /de nas rgyal pos btson rnams btang ba dang/ kun tu rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba/ da lta'i sā bya shi'i cha lugs 'dra ba cig gis/ rgya mtsho bzhi'i chu yum la 'dren pa'i rnam pa rnams 'dri'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang de gnyis na nye ba na bzhugs pa re bya/ khang bzang de dang ma 'brel bar bar stong yod tsam du gzhan zhig tu/ lum bu'i tshal de skyed mos tshal shing sna tshogs yod pa gcig bya/ de na 'khor mang pos skor nas/ rang yum nyid khyogs byams khri la g.yog ma 'ga' re dang bcas pa lum+bi na'i tshal du 'byon pa'i tshul dang*/ tshal der sku bltams pa'i bkod pa sbyi dang 'dra ba las/ nam mkha' nas chu rgyun gnyis dbu'i steng du 'bab pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi gdugs dang rnga yab la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs pa 'bul zhing*/ tshal de'i phyi nang thams cad 'od kyi khyab pa mtshon byed du/ phyi nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor zlum pos skor ba 'bri/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs rnams su/ rgod ma rte'u 'breng pa mang po dang*/ glang chen mo phrug gu 'breng ba/ bud med khye'u dang bu mo thogs pa dang*/ sa 'og nas rin po che'i gter kha bye ba rnams lnga brgya mtshon byed/ lnga tsam re 'bri/ khang bzang gzhan gcig tu rgyal po zas gtsang ma la rgyal phran mang pos phyag 'bul zhing 'bul ba byed pa/

yang khang bzang gcig na 'khor mang po can yab kyis pang na/ byang chub sems pa khye'u'i gzugs kyi bzhugs pa la/ mdun du bram ze mang po 'bri/ de nas lam du shing rta'i steng du rgyal po bzhugs pa la 'khor mang pos skor ba dang*/ khyogs byams khri skye bo mang pos btegs pa'i dbus na byang chub sems dpa' ma ma rnams dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ lha khang zhig na gnod sbyin lus la khra gyon pa zhig 'ong nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'bul ba/ de nas grong khyer ser skya'i bkod pa gzhan zhig gi khang bzang du/ yab kyi sku pang du bzhugs pa la/ mdun du drang srong kha dog mi sha kha nag po/ ral pa ser skya 'dzings shing kha spu nag po can/ tshangs skud dang dbyug gu spyi blugs yod pa/ rgan pa'i cha byad can zhig gi byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing*/ lag pa g.yas cung zad sgreng ba dang*/ phyogs gzhan zhig tu drang srong de rgyal po'i drung du mchil ma 'don pa'i tshul bya ba dang*/ pho brang de'i phyi rol na drang srong de tshur yong dus kyus ma yong ba dang*/ phar 'gro dus ni sgo'i phyi nas dar ras sogs skyang ba'i steng*/ de dang nye ba'i brag phug gcig tu de nyid bsam gtan la gnas pa'i tshul dang*/ de'i mdun du drang srong gzhon nu gcig 'bri/ de dag ni lhums su zhugs pa dang bltams pa'i skor ro//(kha) de nas ma ma brgyas skor ba'i byang chub sems dpa' byis pa'i tshul gyi gser gyi gzhong pa shin tu che ba 'bras kyis bkang ba/ phyogs gcig nas glang po che mang po la btags la/ byang chub sems dpa' khye'u'i phyag mdzub gcig gis/ gzhong pa nas 'then pas/ glang po che rnams kyang 'dred stabs su tshur drud pa/ 'bras chen nas gsol ba'i rnam pa yang 'bri ste/ phyag g.yon pas snod nas 'then tshul dang/ g.yas pas gsol ba'i rnam pa byas na legs/ de nas cung zad sku cher skyes pa'i rnam pa la/ yi ge'i slob dpon gyi drung du yi ge slob pa dang*/

rtsis kyi slob dpon gyi drung du rtsis slob pa dang*/ zhang po bzang len la rta dang glang po che'i sgyu rtsal slob pa dang*/ mda' sogs mtshon cha'i 'phrul gyi slob dpon la de dag slob tshul cung zad re dang*/ lhas sbyin gyi glang po che bsad pa dang*/ dga' bos 'jug ma nas bor ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpas phyag gi ring du 'phang pa rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'di la zhabs kyi mthe pos 'phang pa theg chen gyi lugs yin/ sngaun 'byung lugs dang*/ 'dul ba sogs nas phyag gi 'phang pa gsal bar bshad/ shing mang po ral gris bcad pa/ gzhan rnams kyis bcad pa tsho bcad ma thag 'gyel/ byang chub sems dpas de bcad kyang ring du ma 'gyel ba dang*/ rlung po byung nas 'gyel ba 'bri/ de nas mda' tsha bas 'dren pa'i bkod pa spyi dang 'dra/ spyir sgyu rtsal lnga brgya'i bar du 'gran pa yin kyang*/ sngon 'byung dang 'dul ba las lo rgyus lhag ma gsungs pa med pas skabs 'dir de tsam gyis chog/sgyu rtsal mkhas par bstan pa'i skor ro/ /(ga) byang chub sems dpa' shing rtar zhugs nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol nas nang du 'byon pa dang*/ bram ze mang po phyir 'gro bzhin pas lung bstan byed pa dang*/ khyams yangs pa zhig tu shākya'i bu mo sna tshogs pa la/ dngos po'i khyad par re re sbyin zhing*/ grags 'dzin ma sku'i mdun du gus pas 'dug pa la sor gdub gnang ba dang*/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig tu grags 'dzin ma 'khor bcas khab tu bzhes pa'i dga' ston gyi bkod pa dang*/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ shing sdong chen po zhig 'gyel bas/ rgyug chu bkag ste/ grong khyer phyogs gcig la chu nyen yod pa dang*/ shing de la skye bo mang pos 'then pa'i tshul dang*/ de'i phyogs gcig nas sbrul nag po zhig byung ba/ gzhon nu mdzes pa thod bcings pa zhig gi ral gris sked pa nas bcad pa dang*/ lhas byin gyi ngang pa la mda' 'phangs nas sa la lhung ba/

byang chub sems dpas gsos pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpas shing sdong de phyag ya gcig gis nam mkha' la 'phen pa dang*/ shing sdong de dum bu gnyis su song nas chu 'gram g.yas g.yon du lhung pa dang*/ yang khang bzang zhig gi steng nas/ sa mtsho mas byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing/ rkang pa ya gcig gi mthe bo'i shugs kyi thog gi mthil brdol ba dang*/ shing rta'i steng nas byang chub sems dpas kyang*/ sa mtsho ma la gzigs shing*/ phyag na lcags kyi mda' dum bur song ba dang*/ khang bzang mchog tu sa mtsho 'khor bcas khab tu bzhes pa dang*/ yang phyogs ji ltar 'os pa zhig tu/ khang bzang gcig dang nye ba nas/ byang chub sems dpa' shing rta la zhugs nas 'byon pa dang*/ khang bzang gi skar khung nas ri dwags skyes ma la lta zhing 'dug pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' mu tig 'phreng ba 'phangs pa/ de'i mgul du mkhril ba dang*/ khang bzang mchog tu ri dwags skyes 'khor bcas khab tu bzhes pa'i bkod pa dang*/ btsun mo'i 'khor tshogs bstan pa'i skor ro/ /(nga ) de dag phyogs gang yang rung bar pho brang gi sgo bzhi nas/ rgas pa dang/ na ba dang/ shi ba dang/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul rnams spyi dang 'dra/ zhing las byed pa'i sar phebs nas zhing pa rnams dang*/ glang sogs btang ste ci bde bar btang ba dang*/ nang gi las sna tshogs pa byed pa rnams kyi sar phebs te/ de dag kyang btang ba dang*/ shing 'dzam bu'i rtsa bar ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ grib mas sku lus ma btang ba la yab kyi phyag mdzad pa dang*/ de nas ser skya'i phyi rol 'obs dang lcags ri bdun bdun gyi skor zhing*/ lcags kyi sgo 'phar dril bu chen po can mi lnga brgyas 'byed gcod byed pa mtshon byed dang*/ skas chen po mi lnga brgyas 'dzugs shing bsdu ba mtshon byed dang*/ lcags ri'i bar bar thams cad dmag mi'i bsrung zhing*/ pho brang snying po'i phyogs bzhi nas/ rgyal po sku mched bzhis mel tshe mdzad pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' nyid dang*/ pho brang gi khang bzang gcig tu bud med mang pos rol mo dang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang*/ ma 'gags pa zhes bya ba rgyal po dang cha byad 'dra rung zhig gi lta nyul byed cing skor ba dang*/ khang bzang gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' mnal ba'i tshul dang*/ 'khor gyi bud med thams cad gnyid kyi non pas cha byad bkod pa mi sdug pa'i rnam par gyur pa dang*/ khang bzang gi nang la zlum skor lnga'i nang du byang chub sems dpa'i mnal ltas lnga 'bri ste/ ri rab dbus sngas su bcug sa gzhi gdan du gting*/ phyag g.yon nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la bcug g.yas shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la bcug zhabs gnyis lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la bcug pa dang*/ gcig tu lte ba nas rtswa sngon po skyes pa nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags pa dang*/ gcig tu bya lus dkar la mgo bo nag pa mang pos zhabs la gtugs pa dang*/ gcig tu bya spu mdog sna tshogs pa phyogs phyogs nas 'dus pa sku mdun du rigs gcig tu song ba dang*/ gcig tu mi gtsang ba'i phung po'i steng zhabs 'chag pa mdzad kyang*/ mi gtsang bas ma gos pa'o/ /grags 'dzin ma yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i drung du nyal ba'i bkod pa 'bri zhing*/ rmis ltas brgyad bshad kyang 'bri mi dgos/ des nas phyogs gcig tu lcags ri'i bar gyi dmag mi sogs thams cad gnyid du song zhing*/ lcags ri'i nang rdo chal 'dra ba zhig na/ chibs pa bsngags ldan la phyag gi bzhams pa dang*/ rta rdzi bdun pas sga sgron pa'i grabs 'bri/ khang bzang gi rtse mo'i phyogs gcig na/ rgyal po zas gtsang mnal du song ba la/ byang chub sems dpas bskor ba mdzad cing thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ ma 'gags pas rgyal po'i na bza' nas 'then zhing mnal bsod tshul byed pa dang*/ de nas chibs la chibs nam mkha'i ngos nas gshegs pa sogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rta'i rkang pa bzhi 'degs byed/ rgyal chen bzhis mi byed par lha'i gyad bzhi yin la/

sku'i mdun nas tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis 'gro zhing*/ lha gzhan mang pos mchod pa 'bul ba 'bri dgos/ rta bsngags ldan la rgyan bkal ba dang*/ rta rdzi bdun pa dang bcas pa rnams phyir klog pa dang yul du sleb pa yang 'bri/ rta bsngags ldan la dad pa gser ldan zer nas dung pa re gtong yang kha skad tsam yin gyi khungs med/ rgya gar gyi ri mo khung ma dkar por yong bas de bzhin bya/ de nas ri dwags rngon pa'i gzugs can zhig gis ngur smig gi gos phul ba dang*/ mchod rten gyi drung du nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bcad pa dang*/ gtsug phud lhas khyer ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gser gyi lo ma can gyi nags tshal zhig na drang srong mang po 'dug pa dang*/ de shing 'phags pa'i nags tshal du song ba la/ drang srong rnams mi dga' ba dang*/ de'i drung du byang chub sems dpa' byon te bzhugs pa rnams 'bri ste nges par 'byung ba'i skor ro/ /(ca) de nas grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi khang bzang gi rtse mo nas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos lta ba dang*/ lam srang na byang chub sems dpa' shing lo tsems pa'i lhung bzed bsnams te bsod snyoms mdzad pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' shing drung du bzhugs pa'i drung du/ rgyal po 'khor bcas byon te zhu ba mdzad pa 'bri/ de dang nye ba'i nags gcig tu/ drang srong la la rkang pa ya gcig 'breng ba dang*/ la la me lnga gdung ba dang*/ la la chu la zhugs ba dang*/ la la du ba 'thung ba la sogs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dka' thub de gnyis ldabs su mdzad pa 'bri/ de nas yang nags gzhan zhig tu/ lo ma'i skyal po na/ drang srong ring 'phur yod pa 'khor bcas kyi drung du byon pa dang*/ yang lhag spyod kyi drung du byon pa yang de kho na 'dra ba dang*/ 'di'i ring phur dang lhag spyod ni/ gong gi ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyi snyoms 'jug pa drug gi nang tshan yin/ de nas nags gcig tu/

'khor lnga drung na yod cing*/ gzhan mi mang po zhig ldog 'gro ba 'bri/ de nas chu klung ne rañdza na'i 'gram mtha' nags kyi skor ba'i ne'u gsing gi dbus shing drung gcig tu dka' thub mdzad pa'i rnam pa 'bri ste/ spyi khyab dang 'dra/ dka' ba rnam pa drug spyod pa'i rim pa mang po yod kyang*/ de tsam gyi chog pa 'dugaphyug rdzis snyan la shing 'dzugs pa dang*/ lha gsum gyi gtam rjes su sgrog pa sogs kyang 'bri/ de nas phyogs gcig tu khrus mdzad cing*/ mi ro la dbu sngas mdzad de gzims pa 'bri ste dka' ba spyod pa'i skor ro/ /(cha) de nas phyogs gcig tu khrus mdzad pa dang*/ 'khor lnga kun tu rgyu'i cha byad gzhan du 'gro ba dang*/ 'bras chan gsol ba'i tshul bya/ de nas bu mo dga' mo dang*/ dga' stobs mas 'o thug phul ba dang*/ gser snod chu bo ne rañdza nar bor ba dang*/ de klus khyer ba dang*/ brgya byin bya khyung du sprul nas de phrogs te lha yul du khyer ba dang*/ brag de'u me tog gis brgyan pa la bzhugs pas/ brag nyil ba dang*/ lhas bskul te de nas phar gshegs pa la/ chu nang nas klu'i rgyal po dus can zhes byas bstod pa dang*/ rtswa 'tshong bkra shis 'khor bcas kyi rtswa phul ba dang*/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i skor ro/ /(ja) byang chub kyi shing gi drung du rtsa btang ba'i steng du bzhugs pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa la/ bdud kyi sprul pa'i pho nya bdun 'ong ba dang*/ yang de dang nye bar/ bdud 'dul gyi bkod pa spyi dang 'dra ba 'bri ba las/ rin po che'i bzhugs khri mi dgos/ yang byang chub shing gcig gi rtsa ba na/ bzhugs tshul mnyam bzhag mdzad pa la/ shing gi yal ga che la dkar ba lo ma rnams lha mang pos 'dzin pa 'bri/ /mngon byung dang/ 'dul ba'i lugs la/ slu brid ston pa'i bdud kyi bu mo gsum kho na 'bri ste/ bdud btul pa'i skor ro/ /(nya) bdud 'dul ba dang sangs rgyas pa gnyis dus mtshan mo gcig kho na la yin kyang*/

mdzad pa'i khyad par shin tu che ba'i phyir/ byang chub brnyes pa logs su 'bri mi dgos te/ byang chub shing drung du rtsa'i gdan la mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ sku'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas tshangs ris kyi lha re re'i bstod pa byed pa 'bri/ de nas rgyal chen bzhis rdo'i lhung bzed phul ba dang*/ tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po la lhas lung bstan nas bsod snyoms phul zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gsung pa dang*/ yang brgya byin gyi a ru ra phul ba dang*/ phyogs gcig na bdud kyi thal mo sbyar ba 'bri/ de nas chu'i nang klu btang bzung gi pho brang du byon zhing*/ sbrul gyi gdeng ka byas pa dang*/ klu de rnams la chos gsung pa dang*/ yang byang chub shing gi rtsa bar rtsa'i gdan la mnyam bzhag mdzad pa ste/ de dag kyang spyi dang 'dra/ mngon par byang chub pa'i skor ro/ /(ta) de nas tshangs pas 'khor lo 'bul gyi chos gsung par bskul ba dang/ wa ra nā si'i phyogs la phebs pa'i lam du/ 'tsho ba pa kun tu gcig dang mjal ba dang*/ gru mkhan gyi gru ma btang ba la/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas wa ra nā si'i phyogs la drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags te/ ri chung la nags yod pa zhig tu/ 'khor lnga sde kun tu rgyu'i cha byad can rnams kyi sangs rgyas rgyang ring po nas 'byon pa lta zhing/ phan tshun du gtam smra ba'i tshul dang*/ 'khris su byon pa na/ gcig gi gdan gding*/ gcig gi zhu ba zhu/ gcig gi zhabs bkru/ gcig gis bsu ba byed/ gcig gis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ na bza' 'khur ba'i tshul byed/ de nas phyogs gcig tu pha bong 'dra ba zhig gi steng du ston pa bzhugs shing*/ lnga sde dge slong gi rnam pa can gyi chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas g.yon dang nam mkha' nas lha chos nyan pa'i tshul mang du bya/ yang phyogs gcig tu/ ston pa'i drung du dge slong gsum 'dug cing*/

dge slong gnyis kyi grong khyer nas bsod snyoms len pa'i tshul dang*/ yang de dang nye ba na/ khyim gcig na grags pa bud med kyi 'khor gyi skor ba dang*/ khyim gcig phyogs gcig tu bud med rnams gnyid du song ba/ grags pa sgo phye ste 'gro/ grags pa'i pha sgron me thogs te 'tshol ba dang*/ chu 'gram zhig tu lham bzhag chu'i phar phyogs na sangs rgyas kyi drung du grags pa chos nyan pa dang*/ de dang nye bar grags pa'i pha langs nas 'dug pa'i tshul 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na nye ba'i lnga sde ste/ dge slong lnga sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ de rnams kyi nye du mang po tshur yong ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang skyed mos tshal gcig tu/ mi mang po bud med rol mo thogs pa mang po dang lhan cig tu 'dug pa las/ rol mo thogs pa'i bud med gcig bros shing mi gcig 'tshol du 'gro ba sangs rgyas dang mjal ba dang*/ phyogs gcig tu kar pa sa'i tshal mtshon byed nags tshal gcig tu/ bzang sde drug bcu rab tu byung ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gsung pa'i tshul dang bu mo dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma la chos gsung pa'i tshul dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu/ bud med rgyan gos phun sum 'tshogs pa rgan gzhon gnyis la chos ston pa dang*/ bram ze lha zhes bya ba dang*/ de'i chung mas bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang*/ de gnyis la chos gsung pa dang*/ bram zes sa stong gcig nas brgyan mang po rnyed pa dang*/ chung mas gser gyi bum pa rnyed pa'i tshul 'bri ste/ wa ra nā sir chos 'khor bskor ba'i skor ro/ /(tha) de nas drang srong steng rgyas 'od srung gi nags su gshegs shing*/ drang srong gi bsu ba byas shing gdan la bzhugs pa dang*/ me khang gcig tu klus me sbar zhing du ba 'thul ba dang*/ ston pa'i sku las me dang du ba de las kyang cher spros te/ klu de'i mtha' rnams mes 'khor ba dang*/ klu des zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba 'bri/ 'di la sngaun gyi kha che dang bal bo'i ri mo khungs ma las/

klu de lha'i lus can mdog sngaun po sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka yod pa/ ral gri 'dzin pa'i rnam pa yod pa mthong*/ phyogs gcig tu drang srong 'od srung gi spyan drangs shing*/ ston pas lhung bzed kyi nang du klu de bcug nas bsnams pa'i tshul dang*/ phyogs gcig tu drang srong mang pos me sbor ma thub pa dang*/ ston pas rang sbar du byung ba dang*/ bram ze rnams kyis me bsad kyang ma shi ba dang*/ ston pas rang zhir mdzad pa dang*/ steng rgyas 'od srung la'ang de lta bu dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du rgyal chen bzhi lus me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas chos nyan pa dang*/ yang brgya byin yang de ltar chos nyan pa dang*/ tshangs pa yang de dang 'dra bar nyan pa ste/ de gsum kar la yang 'od bsrung rtswa spyil gyi sgo drung nas lta ba dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu 'od srung la skye bo mang po phyag byed cing*/ yo byad mang po 'bul bar 'dus pa dang*/ drang srong rang yang sbyin bsreg dang mchod pa byed/ sangs rgyas phyogs gzhan zhig la thegs 'gro ba dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu drang srong gcig pu zas nor mang pos skor pa'i sar/ sangs rgyas tshur byon pa dang*/ drang srong 'od srung la sangs rgyas kyi lhung bzed kyi nang nas shing 'bras chen po gnang ba dang*/ chung ngu gnang ba dang*/ ma smos pa'i lo thog gi 'bras skyos mar gnang ba'i tshul dang*/ de bzhin du lha'i bdud rtsi gnang ba ste bzhi po de la re re zhing drang srong rang gis kyang sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang*/ chu mig rdol ba la khrus mdzad pa dang*/ shing gi yal ga rang dud du byung ba la/ phyag 'jus te bzhengs pa dang*/ rdo leb chen po'i steng du sku 'khru ba dang*/ rdo leb chen po'i steng du sku chos brkyangs te skem pa dang*/ ston pa chu'i steng du zhabs 'chag mdzad cing*/ drang srong 'od srung sdong gru chung ngu gcig gi nang du bzhugs te 'ong pa dang*/ chu 'gram du ston pa dang 'od bsrung gsung gleng mdzad pa dang*/

drang srong rnams 'dus pa la 'od srung nyid gtam smra tshul dang*/ de dag 'khor bcas kyi ral pa bregs pa rnams dang*/ phrags gdan dang*/ dbyug gu la sogs pa thams cad chu la bor ba dang*/ de rnams kyi rab tu byung ba'i chas su sgyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ drang srong gi chas chus khyer ba/ ga ya 'od bsrung dang*/ chu klung 'od bsrung 'khor bcas kyi mthong ba dang*/ de gnyis steng rgyas 'od bsrung 'tshol du 'ong ba dang*/ kho rang rnams kyi chas kyang sngar bzhin chu la bor te rab tu byung ba dang*/ ri ga ya'i rtse mo la/ ston pa nyid bzhugs shing ral pa can stong rab tu byung ba rnams la chos ston pa/ de'i nam mkha' la sangs rgyas nyid gshegs pa dang*/ bzhugs pa dang*/ 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa dang*/ stod nas me 'bar zhing smad nas chu 'bab pa sogs kyi bkod pa dang*/ ri'i rtsa ba na rgyal po'i pho nya mdung thung thogs pa ri la lta ba zhig 'bri/ yang rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa/ pho brang gi rtse nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po blon po'i tshogs kyi skor ba la pho nya gcig gi zhu ba zhu zhing*/ pho nya gcig 'phrin par gtong pa'i tshul dang ri'i rtse mo na sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i drung du pho nya sleb ste/ zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas lam du phebs pa'i tshul/ rgyal po pho brang nas phyir byon pa'i grong khyer gyi srang kha ru/ shing rta la bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sa la bying ba dang*/ btson mang po btang ba'i tshul dang*/ yang rgyal po'i dbu rgyan sgo'i ya them la thegs pa dang*/ yul gzhan na las ka la yod pa'i mi rnams tshur bsdud pa dang*/ de nas rgyal po 'khor bcas lam du zhugs pa dang*/ glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ shing rta dang*/ rkang thang dang*/ bram ze dang khyim bdag du ma yang 'bri/ sha pa'i tshal lam tang brang gi tshal zhes pa skyed mos tshal 'dra ba khang bzang ched pa'i nags mthong zhig tu dbus su sangs rgyas nyid bzhugs/

g.yas su steng rgyas 'od bsrung dge slong dbu skra dkar po can/ g.yon nam mdun du rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba/ yang logs gcig na rgyal po thal mo sbyar te bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i g.yas g.yon rgyab phyogs rnams su dge slong mang po dang*/ mdun phyogs shes che bas mtha' skor du khrom 'tshogs pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ 'od bsrung dge slong sgres po de kha 'dra ba bzhi/ me 'bar ba dang*/ chu 'bab pa dang*/ 'od 'phro ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'chag pa'i tshul byed pa re re/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i g.yas zur 'og gi phyogs nas des phyag 'tshal ba 'bri/ yang rgyal po'i pho brang snga ma dang 'dra rung la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas grong khyer gyi nang du phebs pa dang*/ pho brang nang gi bzhugs khri la bzhugs shing*/ rgyal pos bsod snyoms dang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang*/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ 'od ma'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang 'bri dgos te/ de yang dbus su gtsug lag khang chen po/ mtha' khang bzang chung ngu mang po dang*/ khang mig gis skor ba/ khang bzang gi g.yas g.yon dang*/ mtha' skor du shing ljon pas mdzes pa/ phyi'i mtha' ra bas skor ba/ dbus kyi gtsug lag khang chen por de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa dang*/ khang bzang gzhan dang*/ khang mig rnams na dge slong mang po dag bzhugs pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ yang 'od ma'i tshal de dang 'dra rung mdor bsdus pa zhig la/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun gyis 'khor gyi skor ba/ chos 'chad pa zhig bya/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas bram ze kun tu rgyu gnyis/ gcig ni sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gcig 'khor gyi nyan thos gcig la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ de gnyis kyi rjes nas bram ze mang po yong ba/ sku'i g.yas phyogs su de gnyis dang*/ gzhan bram ze de thams cad rab tu byung bar gyur pa/ lag na lhung bzed dang bya ma bum thogs pa 'bri/ gtsug lag khang de nas 'gyang tsam du grong khyer gyi bkod pa zhig 'bri zhing*/

de'i byang lam du dgra bcom pa gcig gis bram ze gcig la chos ston pa dang*/ yang phyogs gzhan cig tu bram ze cig la bram ze gcig gi chos ston pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi gseb tu bram ze gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa 'gro ba dang*/ nags shig tu de gnyis nam mkha' la lta ba dang*/ yang dge slong mang po dang*/ skye bo mang po gtam smra ba 'bri ste/mchog zung gnyis rab tu byungaba'i bkod pa yin no/ /(da) //yang phyogs gcig tu wa ra nā si mtshon byed grong khyer cung zad dang*/ ri chung ngu nags tshal can la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa/ drang srong dar bab zhig ri'i rtsa ba nas 'ong zhing*/ ston pa'i sku gzhogs su dge slong du gyur pa dang*/ grong khyer cig gi gseb na bram ze'i khye'u zhig lag pas g.yas na shing gi glag bu la yi ge bris pa dang*/ g.yon na cung zad gyen du bteg pa/ mtha' skye bo mang pos skor ba dang*/ de dang drang srong de gtam smra ba 'bri'o/ /yang grong khyer ri de ga 'dra rung sangs rgyas 'khor bcas sngar bzhin bzhugs pa la/ sku'i g.yas phyogs nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yong ba 'dra ba la/ 'khor tshogs mang po lta ba'i tshul 'bri/ phyogs gzhan cung zad thag ring grong khyer gyi rnam pa can gcig nas/ sbrul gyi mjug ma thon pa la mgo bos wa ra na si mtshon byed sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i ri 'gram gyi grong khyer der sleb pa/ sbrul de'i mgo la shing sdong bdun skyes shing*/ bya dang sbrang bu la sogs pa 'khor ba'i rnam pa dang*/ sbrul de'i skang pa'i thad tsam na gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje 'bri ste/ ngo bo bcom ldan 'das gsang bdag yin yang*/ gsang sngags kyi sgrub thabs nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid mtha' dag tshang ba rang yang mi dgos te/ sku mdog sngo sang khro bo'i cha byad la/ sbrul dang dar sngon po dang*/ stag lpags la sogs pa'i rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/

phyag g.yon pas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yas pas rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin pa bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku drung du/ klu zhig chos nyan pa'ang 'bri ste/ ka t+ya ya na'i sde tshan no/ /(na) yang bkod pa gcig la/ bar ri nags kyi chod pa'i lung tsho gsum bya/ tshur phyogs der nags kyi dbus ri chung zhig la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas ri dwags mang po dang*/ mdun du dge slong gcig yod pa la bka' stsol ba'i tshul dang*/ phyogs gcig tu dge slong mang po sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ dge slong gtso 'khor de rnams phar phyogs la 'gro ba'i tshul bya/ yul ljongs bar ma de na/ khang pa gcig na bram ze gcig bud med gcig bu mo mchog gcig rnams 'dug pa sgo'i phyi nas gar mkhan rnams gar byed pa/ gar mkhan gcig lag tu thum po zhig thog nas bram ze de la gtam smra ba dang*/ yang khang pa de kha 'dra ba la/ khang steng na bud med de la lag pa la 'gram pa gtad cing lta ba dang*/ mdun du bud med gtam smra ba dang*/ phyogs gcig nas 'dreg mkhan mos skra 'dreg pa dang*/ tshur phyogs nas dgra bcom pa dpon slob de rnams lam nas yong ba dang*/ bud med des gar mkhan la skra'i chun po zhig sprod pa dang/ gar mkhan de la snod gcig tu dod rtsa mang po bcug nas ster ba dang*/ khang pa de'i rgyab na/ dur khrod du mi ro bsreg pa dang*/ phyogs yangs sa zhig tu/ dge slong dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bud med des gdugs tshod gsol ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ yul phar phyogs de ru grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa'i grong gi sgo'i them pa la/ dgra bcom pa de zhabs bzhag cing*/ dge slong rnams kyang rjes la 'ong ba/ nam mkha' nas lhas me tog gi char 'beb cing*/ 'byung po mang po thag ring du bros pa dang*/ de la grong khyer gyi sgo'i steng nas mi gcig gi lta zhing*/ mi de rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ phyi khyams su dge slong rnams la mchod ston gsol ba dang*/

yang khang bzang gnyis byas pa'i gcig tu dge slong dang*/ gcig tu mu stegs can rnams la chos ston gsol/ sgo so so nas de gnyis ni so sor gyes 'gro ba la/ mi res dri ba re byed tshul dang*/ yang phyogs gcig na glang po che'i ra ba re rer/ dge slong dang mu stegs can la kha zas ngan pa re 'dren pa dang*/ yang so sor gyes 'gro ba la gtam 'dri ba'i mi dang*/ grong khyer pho brang de kha 'dra ba'i dbus kyi khang bzang gcig tu/ dge slong 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod 'bul zhing*/ rgyal po yang thal mo sbyar nas 'dug pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi sgo nas/ bu mo mchog ras kyi gos g.yogs pa dang*/ 'khor dang bcas pa 'jug pa dang*/ 'byung po mang po thag ring du 'bros pa dang*/ de la mi rnams lta ba dang*/ khang bzang gcig na/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis dang*/ gzhon nu gcig dang*/ bram ze dang blon po gcig rnams yod cing*/ phyi rol gyis khyams zhig na/ glang po che dang*/ glang mo dang*/ rnga mong dang/ rta mchog dang*/ mi ba dan ring po thogs pa gcig rnams 'bri/ phyi rol kyi sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu dgra bcom pa des/ skye bo mang po la chos 'chad pa dang*/ yang khang bzang gcig tu rgyal po mnal log pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'od khyim zlum po brgyad kyi nang na/ tsan+dan dkar pos lus byugs pa'i mi dang*/ dmar pos lus la gtor ba'i mi dang*/ ri gcig dang*/ ngang pa gnyis dang*/ mi'i mchan khung gnyis nas sbrul 'chang ba dang*/ mi gcig gi mgo la me 'bar ba dang*/ mi'i rkang pa la nya gnyis 'khril ba dang*/ bya gong ma bsreg gcig dang bcas pa brgyad po de rnams hal tshon te/ ri mo phra mos 'bri'o/ /yang khang bzang de'i phyogs gcig na/ dgra bcom pa la rgyal pos zhu ba byed pa dang*/ khyams yangs pa gcig tu rgyal bo la be'u ras dang*/ la dmar rin po che dang*/ glang chen gcig rta gnyis/ gser dang rin po che spel ba'i 'phreng ba/ ral gri gnyis/

nor bu'i lham cha rnams 'bul mkhan byung ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ yang phyogs yangs pa gcig tu/ dgra bcom pa la be'u ras dang*/ bud med gcig la gser 'phreng*/ gcig la la dmar/ bram ze la rta/ gzhon nu la lham/ blon po la ral gri rnams byung ba dang*/ phyogs gcig tu dgra bcom pa la rgyal pos thal mo sbyar zhing zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ yang gtsug lag khang gcig na dgra bcom pa de yul ljongs thog ma'i phyogs la gdong gtad cing thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba 'bul tshul dang*/ de yul de'i phyogs gcig tu/ gtsug lag khang gcig nas sangs rgyas kyi de la bka' stsol ba'i tshul 'bri/ sngar gyi rgyal bo'i pho brang gi 'khris der/ dgra bcom pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ 'bru dang na bza' dang*/ snod spyad dang*/ nor dang yo byad sna tshogs pa dag dang*/ rta dang ba glang la sogs pas 'bul snod dpag tu med pas mtha' skor zhing 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ rgyal po yang thal mo sbyar zhing smon lam 'debs pa 'bri ste/ 'phags pa ka t+ya ya na mngags te/ grong khyer 'phags rgyal du rgyal po rab snang la sogs pa skye bo thams cad dge ba la 'god par mdzad pa'i skabs kyi le tshan no/ /(pa) yang khyim yangs pa gcig tu sangs rgyas la khyim bdag mo gnyis kyi bsod snyom 'bul ba dang*/ yang de'i sgo drung phyi nang gang bde ba zhig na/ ston pas khyim bdag mo de la lung bstan mdzad pa'i tshul bya/ yang khyim de'i phyi rol phyogs gcig tu gcer bu pa dang khyim bdag de gros byed pa dang*/ khyim bdag mo sbrum ma de'i dku mnye ba dang*/ de shi ste phung po 'don pa'i bkod pa dang*/ dur khrod gcig tu skye bo mang po tshogs pa'i dbus su/ de'i phung po bsregs pas/ lto gas pa'i dkyil nas/ pad+ma'i sdong po dang pad+ma kha phye ba'i dbus na khye'u yod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' stsal nas rgyal bu mtsho byed gzhon nu de len par rtsom pa dang*/ sngar gyi khyim bdag de gcer bu pa'i gdong du lta ba 'bri/

de dang nye bar gzhal med khang gcig tu/ gzhon nu zhig lha mo mang po dang*/ lha'i 'byor pa lta bu dang ldan pa 'bri ste/ me skyes lung bstan pa'i skabs so/ /(pha) yang bkod pa gcig la/ ri gcig gi drung na/ dur khrod zhig yod pa na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i bkod pa dang*/ de'i drung na khyim bdag cig chos nyan pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ de dang mi ring ba'i grong khyer gcig gi khang bzang na/ skye bo mang po zas g.yo ba'i las byed pa dang*/ khyim bdag gnyis gros byed pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ phyi khyams kyi sgo'i nang na khyim bdag de 'gro bzhin pa la/ bar snang nas lha'i rnam pa zhig gis gtam smra ba dang*/ khyim bdag de dang nyan thos zhig sdebs nas sangs rgyas kyi drung na bkod pa phyi ma rnams kyi sa la phar 'gro ba'i tshul zhig bya/ sngar gyi khang bzang mi mang po las byed pa de dang 'brel ba'i khang pa gzhan zhig tu/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la khyim bdag gcig gis mchod pa 'bul ba'i rnam pa byed/ de rnams dang ma 'brel bar theg yod pa'i phyogs gzhan gcig tu/ khang bzang gcig gi sgo drung na/ mu stegs pa cha byad sna tshogs pa mang po 'dus pa dang*/ de la khyim bdag des gtam smra ba dang*/ mtha' shing gis skor ba'i sa phyogs gcig gser gyi sbram bur brdal zhing*/ mi mang pos gser gyi khur po sa cha der skyel ba'i rnam pa dang*/ khyim bdag dang rgyal po'i bu gnyis gtam smra ba'i rnam pa byed/ yang mi gzi brjid che ba bzhi'i rtsa na/ khyim bdag rgyal po'i bu dang brtsod pa'i tshul dang*/ rgyal po zhig gi drung du yang khyim bdag dang mu stegs rnams/ phan tshun du gtam smra ba'i tshul byed/ de nas phyogs gzhan gcig tu skye bo mang po 'dus pa la/ phyogs gcig tu 'phags pa shā ri'i bu khri la 'dug pa dang*/ de'i phyogs nas rlung langs pa/ glang po che bya khyung rnams yod pa/ phyogs gcig na mun stegs 'ga' re 'dug pa/

de'i phyogs la shing sdong dang pad tshal mtsho sbrul rnams yod pa/ shing sdong gcig rlung bus dum bur bcag pa rtsa ba nas bton pa dang*/ pad+ma'i rdzing bu glang po che chen po zhig gi dkrugs shing*/ pad+ma zos pa dang*/ sbrul mgo bdun pa chen po zhig 'ong ba la/ bya khyung mang pos sbrul gyi mgo nas za ba dang*/ ro lang zhig byung ba la/ sha ri'i bus phur bu'i btab pa dang*/ ro lang gi mu stegs can gcig brdas pa dang*/ mu stegs de shā ri'i bu la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ shā ri'i bus ro langs kyi phur ba bton pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig na mtha' shing sdong gis skor ba'i dbus der/ skye bo mang po gtsug lag khang brtsig pa dang*/ de kha'i phyogs kyi zur la la na/ thig sna gcig shā ri'i bus bzung*/ gcig khyim bdag gcig gis bzung nas thig 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ de kha'i thad kyi nam mkha'i thad mthon por gser gyi khang bzang gcig dang*/ rin po che sna bdun gyi khang bzang gcig 'bri/ khang bzang de gnyis dang 'og gi gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i steng der/ gser ris lta bu ri mo zhig gi sbrel/ gtsug lag khang brtsig pa de dang nye ba'i shing drung gcig na/ shā ri'i bu zhabs 'chag byed pa/ gyad lcags kyi dbyug pa thogs pas/ mu stegs mang po 'ded pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu khri la bzhugs nas mu stegs mang po la chos ston pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba 'bri ste/ phyogs gcig la mu stegs kyi cha lugs dang*/ phyogs gcig la rab byung gi chas yod pa rnams 'bri ba legs/ gtsug lag khang de'i sgo khang gi thad na/ rgyal po'i bus bkod pa byed cing*/ sgo khang brtsig pa 'bri/ bkod pa 'di tsho dang sngar gyi dur khrod yod pa de'i bar stong la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas lam du bzhugs nas 'byon pa/ lam gyi sa stongs su 'khor bcas bzhugs shing*/ skye bo mang pos mchod pa sna tshogs byed pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ sngar gyi gtsug lag khang brtsig bzhin pa'i bkod pa de dang nye bar/

mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po'i dbus na rgyal po pho brang dang bcas pa yod pa la/ de dang nye ba na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon zhing*/ sa mthil la skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang*/ steng gi nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyi me tog gi char mang po 'bebs pa dang*/ sngar brtsig bzhin pa'i gtsug lag khang de grub pa'i tshul du byas pa/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ khang bzang chen po khang bzang bcu drug gis skor ba/ de'i mtha' khang mig drug cus skor ba mtshon byed dang*/ phyi lcags ris skor ba/ lcags ri'i phyi nang thams cad shing sna tshogs pas btibs pa/ 'di ni rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal yin te/ de'i nang du sangs rgyas 'khor du mas skor ba la/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi gser gyi ril ba spyi blugs nas chab 'bul ba'i steng ka byed pa/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol gcig tu nyan thos gcig gi lhung bzed chen po gcig bzed/ khyim bdag spyi blugs chen po gcig thogs nas/ lhung bzed der chu ldugs pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi nang gi sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la mchod pa'i yo byad mang bo yod pa zhig 'bri/ yang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de 'dra rung la/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i sku'i mdun du/ rgyal po gsal rgyal 'khor mang po dang bcas te thal mo sbyar nas chos nyan pa 'bri/ de dag ni rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal bzhengs shing*/ rgyal po gsal rgyal dad pa la bkod pa'i sde tshan no/ /(ba) de nas rgyal po'i pho brang zhig nas pho nya ba zhig mngags te/ pho brang gzhan zhig tu 'gro ba'i bkod pa dang*/ pho brang phar phyogs de na rgyal po zas gtsang lag pa la 'gram pa gtad de sems khong du chud pa'i tshul la/ de'i mdun na 'don gyi bu 'char ka blon po'i rnam pa mi sha kha nag po zhig gi rgyal po la zhu ba byed pa'i tshul bya/ pho brang tshur phyogs de dang nye ba na/ khang bzang snga ma 'dra ba la mdor bsdus pa gcig tu/

sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun nas 'char ka des zhu yig gi sgrom bu 'bul ba la/ yang de kha'i phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas khri la bzhugs pa/ sku mdun na 'dug pas bka' nyan pa dang*/ yang de dang 'brel ba'i phyogs gcig tu 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i mdun du 'char ka rab tu byung ba dang*/ 'char ka bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas phar 'gro ba rnams 'bri/ pho brang phar phyogs de dang nye bar khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi mdun na/ 'char ka rab tu byung ste gtam smra ba dang*/ rgyal bu rgyal byed tshal gyi bkod pa'i ras bris ston pa/ sgo'i phyi na 'char ka gnas pa mi gzhan zhig la lon sprod pa'i tshul 'bri/ de dang nye ba'i skyed mos tshal zhig gi dbus su gtsug lag khang bzhengs bzhin pa'i bkod pa dang*/ yang phyogs gzhan gcig nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas lam la gshegs pa dang*/ chu 'gram zhig tu dge slong rnams khrus byed pa dang*/ ser skya'i grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa dang*/ de'i mdun nas tshur la shing rta dang*/ shing rta 'dren byed kyi rta dang*/ shing rta la btsugs pa'i dar po che dang*/ ba dan dang*/ shing rta'i nang na yod pa'i mi rnams kyi gos lham thod rnga yab la sogs pa'i yo byad thams cad kha dog mtshungs pa ste/ thams cad dkar po dang*/ thams cad sngon po dang*/ thams cad dmar po dang*/ thams cad ser po dang*/ thams cad khra bo la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po 'bri zhing*/ tshur phyogs nas sangs rgyas ta la bdun srid kyi nam mkha' nas 'byon zhing*/ sprul pa mang po 'gyed pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa spyi dang 'dra ba dang*/ 'khor rnams ta la drug srid kyi nam mkha' la 'byon pa sogs mtshon byed bya/ pho brang de dang nye ba na/ n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de 'dra rung gi sgo drung na/ skye bo'i tshogs mang po dang*/ sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa phebs pa la/

rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ kun dga' ra ba de'i nang du sangs rgyas la 'khor mang pos skor zhing rgyal po la sogs pa chos nyan pa'i tshul bya/ de'i sgo drung du mi brgyan dang ldan pa gcig la skye bo mang pos smad cing sdigs pa'i tshul 'bri/ de dang nye ba na skyed mos tshal gnyis su sangs rgyas la rgyal po'i rnam pa re re gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor mang po chos nyan pa dang*/ sgo drung du mi rgyan ldan gcig la/ mi mang pos smod pa'i snga ma dang 'dra ba 'bri/ de nas khang bzang gcig na rgyal po zas gtsang yod pa'i mdun du/ dgra bcom pa gcig gdan mtho ba la bzhugs pa dang*/ steng gi nam mkha' dgra bcom pa de kha'i sku las sprul pa'i dge slong nam mkha' la 'chag pa dang*/ gzims pa dang*/ 'od zer 'gyed pa dang*/ smad nas me 'bar zhing*/ stod nas chu 'brum pa la sogs pa 'bri/ n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ lcags ri sogs thams cad shel ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du yod pa/ dbus su sangs rgyas la brgya byin la sogs pa lha 'ba' zhig gis skor ba dang*/ sgo bzhi na rgyal chen bzhi 'khor mang po dang bcas pas bsrung ba/ dgra bcom pa des rgyal po zas gtsang khrid nas/ sgo drung du sleb cing*/ yul 'khor bsrung dang gtam smra ba dang*/ yang khang bzang gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du/ rgyal po zas gtsang chos nyan pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de nas khang bzang gzhan gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po zas gtsang 'khor bcas kyis bsod snyoms 'bul ba'i rnam pa dang*/ khang bzang gzhan gcig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la/ btsun mo'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ yang khang bzang gzhan gcig tu/ rgyal po zas gtsang dang*/ mched gsum dang*/ skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang*/ rgyal po'i rnam pa zhig gi yi ge bris pa la rgyal rigs thams cad kyi nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ khang bzang chung ngu gcig na rgyal rigs gnyis/ gtam smra zhing*/

mal stan la snyes pa'i tshul dang*/ shākya rnams glang po che la zhon/ gdugs dang rnga yab sogs dang*/ gos rgyan gzab par byas pa dang*/ kha gcig shing rtar bzhugs pa dang*/ kha gcig khyogs byams khri la bteg nas 'gro ba sogs rnam grangs mang ba dang*/ g.yas g.yon nas skye bo mang po lta ba dang*/ phyogs gcig nas sa'i steng du gdan khri la rgyal po zas gtsang bzhugs/ 'khor kha re dang*/ bram ze bzhi lnga tsam/ shākya rnams la lta ba 'bri/ shākya de rnams kyi nang nas rjes na kha gcig las/ gcig gi gtsug gi nor bu dmar po khras khyer ba dang*/ gcig gis mu tig gi do shal sa la lhung ba dang*/ gcig gi 'khris su bong bu skad 'don pa 'bri/ phar phyogs su n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba sngar gyi de kha 'dra rung zhig byas nas/ phyi 'khyams su ras bting pa'i steng du/ de rnams kyi rgyan thams cad spud pa dang*/ 'dreg mkhan gyi skra 'dreg pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du khrus byed pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi khang bzang gi nang zhig tu/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su de rnams rab tu byung ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ dge 'dun gyi nang gi dge slong gcigasngar gyi 'dreg mkhan de rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa la/ shākya gsar du rab tu byung ba zhig gis zhabs la mgo bos 'dud pa 'bri/ gzhan rnams sha mdog dkar ba la/ 'dreg mkhan de sku sha sngo sangs su bris na legs par go ste/ rab tu byung ba'i gnas skabs na 'phags pa nye ba 'khor yin no/ /de dag ni yab sras mjal ba'i sde tshan no/ /(ma) yang n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i bkod pa lnga brgya bstan pa mtshon byed la/ chu sogs ji ltar rigs pa khang bzang gcig na bzhugs pa dang*/ khang bzang gzhan gcig nas btsun mo grags 'dzin mas zas mchog gis gang ba'i snod sgra gcan 'dzin byis pa'i rnam pa can gyi lag tu gtod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mang po bzhugs pa de rnams kyi nang gi sangs rgyas gcig la sgra gcan 'dzin gyi zas mchog 'bul ba'i tshul 'bri/

yang khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun gyis 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ bud med kyi tshogs mang pos chos nyan pa dang*/ nam mkha' la sangs rgyas mang po 'phur ba dang*/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba dang*/ phyag tu ri bo bsnams pa dang*/ zla ba nyi ma la phyag gis reg pa dang*/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu nas bya khyung dang klu dang*/ glang po dang*/ seng ge la sogs pa sna tshogs pa spro ba dang*/ sangs rgyas gcig gi sku las/ sangs rgyas dkar po/ dmar po/ ljang khu sogs spro ba dang*/ yang sku las/ lha dang*/ lha mo dang*/ bram ze dang*/ dge slong sogs spro ba dang/ de bzhin du stod nas me 'bar zhing*/ smad nas chu 'bab/ smad nas me 'bar zhing*/ stod nas chu 'bab pa la sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa zhig 'bri/ yang khang bzang gcig gi nang du/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dge 'dun dang bcas pa bzhugs shing*/ bud med mchog gcig gis zas mchog bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang*/ khang bzang de'i phyogs gcig gi rtse mo nas bud med de nyid 'phyongs pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul pas gnod pa med par slang ste sa la bzhag pa dang*/ de'i nye skor gyi phyi rol sa mtho ba zhig tu sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas/ bud med mchog de la chos ston pa/ bud med de da lta rab tu byung ba'i gzugs med kyang dgra bcom pa thob cing*/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par sgrub pa mtshon byed du/ lus las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba zhig 'bri/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ sangs rgyas khang bzang gi mdo'i phyi khyams 'dra ba zhig tu bzhags pa la/ khang bzang de'i sgo thams cad phye zhing*/ khyim gyi phug nas byis pa zhig sangs rgyas mthong bas dga' zhing rgyugs te 'ong ba dang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung du phyin pa des/ thal mo sbyar zhing chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ sgo nang nas sangs rgyas phar phebs pa'i rjes su byis pa 'gro ba dang*/ sgo'i phyi rol du pha ma dang nye du rnams kyis byis pa de skor ba la/

de ngu ba'i tshul dang*/ de rnams la sangs rgyas kyi bka' stsol ba'i tshul dang*/ byis pa de glang po che'i steng du bskyon/ 'khor g.yog 'ga' re yang glang po che la zhon pa dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo sna tshogs byed pa sogs 'khor mang po bskor ba dang*/ glang po che des me tog ut+pala'i sdong bu sna zhags kyi sa nas bton te za ba'i tshul dang*/ de'i nye skor nas skye bo mang po lta ba dang*/ yab rgyal po bdud rtsi zas de nyid kyang lta ba dang*/ bram ze lung bstan byed pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs su gtsug lag khang gi nang du/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ byis pa de rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa 'bri ste/ de ni 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ mu tig 'khri shing ngam/ mu tig can gyi lo rgyus kyi rtsa ba de skabs 'dir 'brel che ste/ khang bzang chung ngu zhig gi sgo nas/ shākya ming chen rgyal phran gyi cha byad can gyis 'jug pa dang*/ khang pa'i nang du ming chen thal mo sbyar ste/ de rang gi mdun sa phyogs dma' ba na/ rang gi bud med khyad 'phags 'dug pa la gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ bud med de rgyan ci rigs khyim du 'jog pa dang*/ skye rgu'i bdag mo bud med gzi brjid che ba la/ 'khor shākya mo thams cad kyis bskor te 'gro ba dang*/ de rnams bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan pa dang*/ de dag gi nang nas gcig rang gi mu tig gi do shal la lta zhing 'dug pa dang*/ ming chen gyi chung mas g.yog mo zhig rang gi khyim du rdzangs pas 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ lag tu gro ga'i gleg bu yi ge can thogs pa dang*/ lam du ba grus ma zhig gis brdung ste shi ba'i tshul 'bri/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i tshul yang 'di dang 'grel bar bris na legs te/ khang bzang gi sgo drung du sangs rgyas bsod snyoms la phebs pa dang*/ khang bzang gi nang nas dga' bo rgyal po'i cha byad zas mchog thogs pa dang*/ de'i btsun mo pun da ri kas/

gos sa la gting ba'i steng du chu'i ri mo zlum po 'bri ba'i tshul bya/ khyim gyi phyi nas sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rjes su dga' bo lhung bzed zas mchog gis bkang ste 'gro ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi nang sangs rgyas kyi sku drung du dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i chas bskon zhing skra bregs pa'i tshul bya/ phyogs gcig nas de rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs su sgyur zin nas/ phyag dar byed pa'i tshul dang*/ gtsug lag khang de'i g.yas g.yon gang rung gi phyogs gcig tu/ shing gi yal ga dud pa'i phag na de yod pa la/ sangs rgyas kyang der byon pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gos kyi grwa la de 'jus nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang*/ ri nags tshal yod pa/ shing gcig la spre'u mo zhar ma yod pa zhig 'bri/ de dang nye ba na ston pa dang dga' bo gnyis gsung gleng mdzad pa dang*/ yang ston pa'i chos gos kyi grwa la 'jus te/ ston pa nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang*/ ri rab kyi rtse mo mtshon byed rin po che'i ri'i rtse mo na ston pa zur gcig na bzhugs shing*/ khang bzang bzhi lnga zhig bris pa'i gzhan rnams na/ lha pho mo gnyis chags re dang*/ gcig na lha mo 'ba' zhig dang khri stong pa zhig 'bri/ de dag re re'i sgo drung na dga' bo re re 'bri zhing*/ ston pa'i drung du dga' bo zhu ba byed tshul bya/ yang phyogs gcig tu dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyis gzhi me 'bar ba dang*/ de'i zur gcig tu bcom ldan 'das bzhugs shing*/ dga' bos zhu ba byed tshul dang*/ phyogs gzhan nas phar la gshin rje'i mi rnams kyi zangs chen por dmyal ba'i sems can mang po 'tshod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gzhan yang mi 'dra ba'i rnam pa gnyis gsum bris la/ gcig na zangs snod zangs zhun gyis gang ba bkol bzhin pa sems can med pa zhig 'bri/ de dag re re'i rtsa na dga' bo re re 'bri/ yang gtsug lag khang gcig na/ dga' bo ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing*/

lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ dmyal ba'i bkod pa ston pa dang*/ dgra bcom thob pa'i tshul 'di gnyis ston pa ser skyar bzhugs pa'i dus skabs min yang*/ lo rgyus snga ma'i zhabs su 'brel che bas bkod pa yang 'dir 'bri'o/ /gcung dga' bo 'di ni gtsug tor dang mdzod spu na ma gtogs pa'i mtshan sum cu dang ldan par bshad la/ pags pa gser mdog 'dra rung*/ mi gzhan pas lus tshad kyang cung zad che bar 'bri/ ming chen gyi g.yog mo skye ma shi ba dang*/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba 'di yab sras mjal ba'i rjes thob rang min pa 'dra yang*/ lo mang ma 'das pa mi ring ba'i dus su byung bar mngon/ de ltar ston pa phyogs mtho sar bzhugs pa zhig la skye rgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa/ bud med gos dkar po gyon pa mang po thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ yang bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun dang bcas pa lam gcig na gshegs pa'i phyi nas bud med de dag skra bregs shing gos tshem bu can gyon te 'gro ba dang*/ yul na de kha'i grong khyer mtshon byed gcig gi nang du/ ston pa'i sku mdun du de dag thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa dang*/ ston pa'i drung du dge slong gcig gis zhu ba'i tshul dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo drung na/ dge slong de la bud med de rnams kyis zhu ba byed pa'i tshul bya/ de nas yang phyogs gcig na gtsug lag khang gi dbus na ston pa bzhugs pa la/ de dag dge slong mar gyur nas chos nyan pa'i tshul bya/ bud med rab tu byung ba'i skabs 'di yang*/ yab sras mjal ba'i rjes lo mang ma song ba zhig gi phyis yin pa 'dug na'ang*/ bkod pa 'bri ba'i skabs grong khyer ser skya'i phyogs dang 'brel ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di tsam gyi bris sku logs pa yongs rdzogs su mi longs pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi de tsho'i sdebs la bris na legs so/ /grong khyer ser skyar 'gro don mdzad pa dang 'grel pa'i sde tshan no/ /(tsa) yang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du/

nye sde dge slong ston pa'i sku mdun na yod cing*/ shākya lnga brgya rab tu byung ba la chos gsung ba 'bri/ yang dge slong mang po mnyam bzhag byas pa lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ yang rgya mtsho'i dbus na gzings btang ba zhig la/ tshong dpon gcig dang*/ tshong pa mang po gru nang du gtam mang po smra ba zhig dang gru rin po ches gang ba tshur 'khor ba dang*/ khyim rin po che sogs nor sna tshogs kyi gang ba na/ khyim bdag gcig dang tshong dpon de gtam smra ba'i tshul dang*/ tshong dpon de gcig pu rang nyid lam du zhugs pa'i tshul dang*/ khang bzang gcig gi sgo drung du sleb pa dang khang bzang de dang*/ sngar gyi de'i bar la ri sogs kyis chod pa zhig 'bri/ khang bzang de'i nang du/ tshong dpon de dang khyim bdag gzi brjid can zhig gtam smra ba 'bri/ de dang nye ba na/ gtsug lag khang zhig gi nang du/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang*/ de gnyis gtsug lag khang gi phyogs su 'gro ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i drung du/ tshong dpon de rab tu byung ba'i rnam par gyur pa dang*/ de yul gzhan la 'gro tshul/ grong khyer chung ngu gcig gi nye 'khor dben pa gcig tu mnyam bzhag byed pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ phar phyogs thag ring ba zhig la/ rgya mtsho chen po la gzings phar 'gro ba dang rgya mtsho'i phar phyogs gling phran na tshong pa mang po tsan dan gyis shing gcod pa dang*/ gru tshur lam tsan+dan sa mchog gis bkang ste 'ong pa la/ rlung nag po langs te rgya mtsho'i 'khrugs pa gru nang gi mi rnams thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ gru'i dbus su dge slong de dkyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs pa dang/ rlung phyir log rgya mtsho'i 'khrugs pa zhi ba 'bri/ gru'i zur nas dge slong de dang*/ chu'i steng nas gnod sbyin srin lus can zhig gtam smra ba 'bri/ de nas gru chu 'gram du sleb pa dang*/ de dang nye ba zhig tu tsan+dan gyi shing rnams las gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i bkod pa dang*/

dge slong de dang khyim bdag gcig gi khar lta byed pa'i tshul bya/ de kha'i khris su shing gi khang bzang de yang rags pa grub pa'i rnam pa dang*/ dge slong de dang khyim bdag de'i pus mo btsugs shing thal mo sbyar la/ mdun du spos dang me tog dang gser snod chus bkang ba mang po bzhag de gnyis la skye bo mang pos lta ba'i tshul bya/ mchod pa de rnams 'khris der sngar gyi bkod pa de khas nam mkha' la 'phags pa dang*/ nam mkha' mtho sa nas me tog rang las grub pa'i khang bzang gi rnam pa dang*/ bdug spos ni sprin gyi rnam pa dang*/ chu ni baiḍur+ya'i rnam par song*/ tshur ngos nas gtsug lag khang gi nang na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du me tog gi khang bzang sogs mchod pa de dag 'bab pa dang*/ de'i nye skor yul grong phra mo rnams su dge slong mang po yod pa rnams kun dga' bos tshul shing thogs nas bsdu ba'i tshul dang*/ de nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas tsan+dan gyi khang bzang phyogs btad de nam mkha' la 'byon pa'i tshul dang*/ yul phyogs gcig tu bud med rgyan spangs pa mang po nam mkha' la lta ste thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ ston pa 'khor bcas sa gzhi la phab ste/ mtha' gcig tu bzhugs nas bud med de dag la chos ston pa dang*/ dbu skra dang phyag sen gnang nas ba gu li'i grong khyer sa zhes bya ba'i mchod rten brtsigs pa yang 'bri/ yang yul gzhan zhig tu/ sa skya bo dang nag por song ba dang*/ shing skam pa sogs yid du mi 'ong ba zhig dang*/ de dang 'brel ba ne'u gsing dang*/ shing dang chu sogs yod pa drang srong du ma gnas pa yid du 'ong ba zhig 'bri/ de'i mtha' zhig tu sangs rgyas kyi drang srong de rnams la chos ston pa dang*/ de rnams rab byung du skad cig gis gyur pa dang*/ yang sangs rgyas dang lhan cig tu nam mkha' la 'phur zhing gshegs pa dang*/ phar ngos na grong khyer slob ma can du dbus na pho brang sgo bco brgyad pa/

lcags sgo bcu bdun na rgyal po'i bu re re*/ gcig na rgyal po yod pa/ de rnams spos phor 'dzin zhing*/ skye bo gzhan rnams kyang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul zhing lta ba/ rgyal po'i drung na/ khyim bdag gsum dge slong gcig gis/ rgyal po la bshad pa byed pa'i tshul/ yang rgyal po'i drung du sa la ma babs tsam bar snang la yong ba'i tshul gyi dge slong 'ga' re dang*/ yang sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas gser gyi 'od zer spros pa/ grong khyer de'i steng gi nam mkha' la 'od zer lta bus khyab pa/ dge slong bar snang la yod pa de tsho'i phar phyogs nas kyang cung zad mtho bar nam mkha' nas tshur la seng ge dang*/ stag dang*/ glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ sbrul dang*/ ba lang dang*/ bya khyung sogs la chibs pa'i dgra bcom pa dang*/ shing rtar zhugs pa dang*/ khang bzang du zhugs pa dang*/ lus las sprin 'phro ba dang*/ glog 'gyu ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig sa'i dkyil nas btol te 'ong ba sogs 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs na sangs rgyas la lha klu sogs thams cad kyis mchod pa byed pa dang*/ gser gyi 'od kyang de'i thugs ka nas byung ba'o/ /yang grong khyer de kha 'dra rung ba'i dbus su sangs rgyas byon pa la rgyal po sogs phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ khang bzang du sangs rgyas bzhugs pa la rgyal po thams cad kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ de dang nye ba na tsan+dan gyi khang bzang dbus su sangs rgyas bzhugs/ khang bzang de'i phyi nang thams cad 'khor sna tshogs pas skor te chos nyan pa dang*/ khang bzang de yang shel ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du song ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du klu'i gtso bo gnyis sogs klu mang po la sangs rgyas chos gsung pa dang*/ mtsho nang na klu gnyis po de lus las sprin sprul te/ chu rgyun 'dra ba'i char pa mang po 'bebs pa dang*/ de dag gi chu rgyun rnams gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun chu 'gram du byung ba la/ dge slong zhig gis de nas lhung bzed du chu blang ste bcom ldan 'das la 'bul ba dang*/

gzhan mchod pa mang po dang bcas pa 'bri/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ dgra bcom pa gcig nam mkha' la gshegs pa 'bri/ bar mtshams de nam mkha' sngo sangs kyi bcad pa'i pha rol na/ yul phyogs phun sum tshogs pa gcig dang*/ bar bar na gling bzhi ri rab kyi rnam pa chung ngu mang po sgrigs pa'i ri rab re re'i rtse mo na dgra bcom pa re re yod pa/ phar phyogs kyi zhing khams de na/ dgra bcom pa de'i phyogs su bu mo gzhon nu zhig rgyugs te 'gro ba dang*/ sangs rgyas gyi bu mo de la chos ston pa dang*/ skye bo mang po 'dus pa 'bri ste/ grong khyer glog ma can du gshegs pa dang*/ 'od zer can gyi zhing khams su byon pa'i sde tshan no/ /(tsha) yang nags kyi dbus zhig na ston pa bzhugs pa la/ skye bo mang po mchod pa byed pa 'bri/ yang de nyid kyi 'khris su ston pa'i sku'i mtha' skor du bram ze mang pos skor ba dang*/ sku mdun gyi 'og phyogs cung zad ring ba na/ bram ze gzhon nu zhig lham yu bcad gyon zhing lag pa sgreng ste gzhan du 'gro ba'i tshul bya/ yang bram ze'i khye'u de kha 'dra ba zhig bris pa'i 'khris su phyag na rdo rje bzhugs te/ rdo rje me 'bar bas de la sdigs pa'i tshul dang*/ ston pa'i sku mdun na bram ze de nyid thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul dang*/ de dang nye ba'i nags mthong de kha 'dra ba zhig tu/ ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ bram ze rgan po zhig gi zas mchog 'bul ba dang skor ba byed pa/ nags gseb sna tshogs na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams dge slong gcig gis brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ yang de'i phyogs gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze rgan po de la chos ston pa'i tshul dang*/ bkod pa de'i phar phyogs bar thag cung zad yod pa zhig na/ khang pa rgya chen po yod pa'i phyogs gcig tu/ bram ze rgan po de'i mdun du sngar gyi bram ze khye'u de 'dug te gtam smra ba dang*/

khang pa'i phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ bram ze rgan po des lham yu bcad lag tu thogs te/ bram ze gzhon nu la rdeg pa'i tshul bya/ khang pa dang nags kyi bar der/ phyogs gcig nas bram ze mang po phar 'gro ba dang*/ tshur yong ba'i bkod pa gnyis ka byed cing*/ phyogs gcig nas bram ze rgan po des/ shing rtar zhugs shing 'khor bcas sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i phyogs la 'gro ba'i bkod pa bya ste/ yul 'dod pa mthun par bram ze pad+ma'i snying po 'khor bcas brtul ba'i bkod pa'o/ /(dza) de nas yang bkod pa gzhan ni/ ri rab la sbrul gnyis 'khril te gcig gi dbugs 'byin pa dang*/ bya dang ri dwags mang po lhung ba dang*/ sbrul gcig gis za ba'i bkod pa bya/ yang phyogs gcig na/ sbrul chen po gnyis 'khril te nyal ba'i steng du dgra bcom pa zhabs 'chag byed pa dang*/ sbrul kyi khog pa'i nang du dgra bcom pas rgyug pa phyi gsal nang gsal dang*/ sbrul gyi sna nas cho 'phrul dang bcas te 'thon pa dang*/ sbrul chen po de gnyis shin tu che ba'i sbrul gyis mnan pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na bram ze gnyis 'bros shing*/ dge slong gnyis gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ de nas dge slong gcig la klu gnyis chos nyan pa dang*/ yang ston pa'i sku mdun na klu'i rgyal po dkar po gnyis klu mang po dang bcas pa/ chos nyan zhing mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ khang bzang gcig na ston pa'i sku mdun na lha'i bu gnyis dang*/ phar phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas khang bzang gi nang na lha re yod pa/ gnyis tshur 'ong ba'i tshul dang*/ yang khang bzang gzhan gcig na/ ston pa'i sku mdun du khyim bdag gnyis 'bri/ de gnyis ka la yang mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma yod pa bya/ khang bzang phyi nang gi khyim dang bcas pa zhig tu/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na khyim bdag gnyis 'dug pa dang*/ rgyal po zhig bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba yang 'bri/

gtsug lag khang gi sgo phyogs gcig na/ rin po che'i lcags ri rim pa gnyis ring por 'then pa dang*/ de dag gi steng na sbrul mgo yod pa'i mi mtshon cha thogs pa yang 'bri/ sgo gzhan gcig gi phyi nas rgyal po 'khor bcas 'gro ba'i rnam pa dang*/ sgo'i g.yas g.yon du go cha gyon pa ral gri thogs pa 'ga' re yang 'bri/ de'i phar logs pho brang gi rnam pa yod tsam gyi khyams dang bcas pa zhig tu/ rgyal po btsun mo blon po 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa yod pa la/ steng gi nam mkha' la sprin nag 'jigs su rung ba yod pa dang*/ sprin gseb nas glog dang mtshon cha nyug nyug yod pa/ bar snang der me tog gi char 'bab pa'i rnam par song ba/ de dang sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i bar de'i phyogs gcig na/ dge slong mnyam bzhag byas pa zhig 'bri/ yang phyi rol gyi sa gzhi la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun na rgyal po 'khor bcas yod pa dang*/ mi mang po mthu ba me tog gis bkang zhing*/ me tog de rnams sa la skyur ba na/ ral gri dang gri sgyog dang*/ dgra sta dang/ mda' bo che dang*/ mtshon rtse gcig pa la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs su gyur nas sa la 'babs pa 'bri/ yang khang bzang gcig tu rgyal pos dge slong zhig la mchod pa 'bri/ klu dga' bo dang nyer dga' brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(wa) yang nags gseb gcig na mi gyad kyi rnam pa mda' gzhu bkang ba lnga brgya lnga brgyas gang ba'i dong pa gnyis phrag par thogs pa/ tshong pa mang po dang lhan cig tu 'gro ba 'bri/ chom rkun mang po sa la 'gyel shing shi ba dang*/ mda' rnams sa dang shing la phyed tsam thim pa'i rnam pa dang*/ chom rkun mang po 'bros pa'i tshul bya/ nags mthong zhig tu khang bzang de'i nang na gyad de 'khor bud med mang pos skor ba dang*/ phyi rol na grong khyer dang tshong 'dus kyang yod pa'i rnam pa bya/ yang phyogs gcig tu gyad des mchog zung la sogs pa dge slong 'ga' re la bsod snyoms gsol zhing mchod pa 'bul ba'i bkod pa dang*/

lha khang gcig gi nang na mchod sdong rding btsugs pa 'dra ba'i steng na/ rdo pad gzugs kyi steng du rin po che'i tog yod pa 'dra ba dang*/ bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor mchod pa thogs pa dang bcas pa lha khang de la mchod cing bskor ba byed pa'i tshul byed/ rdzing yod cing mtha' rwa bas bskor ba gcig gi 'gram du/ gyad de skra 'khru ba'i tshul/ gshed ma mtshon cha thogs pa mang po mtha' skor ba/ de'i nye skor du rlung nag gi gseb nas mdog nag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ go mtshon thogs pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ 'khris de dang nags mthong*/ de dang grong khyer snga ma bzhin la/ de'i phar tshad kyi nam mkha' la/ rnam thos sras be con dang ne'u le thogs pa 'khor gnod sbyin mang pos skor ba'i drung du gnod sbyin nag po go mtshon can de/ rnam thos sras kyi bka' lung nyan pa'i tshul bya/ grong khyer de nas phung po 'don pa dang*/ dur khrod du bskyel ba'i rnam pa gnyis gsum 'bri/ skye bo tshogs pa la bram ze mang pos lung bstan byed tshul dang*/ shing rta dang bcas pa'i mi mang po 'bros brtsams pa la/ srin po 'jigs su rung bas lam bkag pa dang*/ phyogs gcig tu gnod sbyin gyi lha khang sha khrag mang pos lang long du gang ba gcig gi phyi rol nas/ ba lang drug gi drangs ba'i shing rta/ gtor ma dang bza' bca' sna tshogs kyi gang ba/ mi gcig zhags pas bcings pa yang der bzhag pa dang*/ mtha' skor du glu gar rol mo byed pa 'bri/ yang de dang nye ba zhig tu khang pa gcig na skyes pa gcig dang*/ bud med bu chung thogs pa gtam smra ba 'bri/ khang steng nas bud med des mchod pa mang po bshams nas thal mo sbyar ba 'bri/ de'i phar logs gcig tu gnod sbyin gyi gnas sngar gyi de kha 'dra ba la nang gi phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa/ sgo na sngar gyi gnod sbyin nag po des gtam smra ba'i tshul la sangs rgyas phyi nas 'byon pa dang*/

sgo gzhan gcig nas sangs rgyas nang du 'byon pa dang*/ phyi rol phyogs gcig nas shin tu mi sdug cing mche ba btsigs pa/ zhal ras la kha dog ma nges pa/ phyag mang po na mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ zhabs mang po can/ me rlung 'tshub pa'i dbus na yod pa zhig gi mdun du/ gnod sbyin nag po de brgyal zhing 'gyel ba zhig 'bri/ 'di lung rnam 'byed kyi dpe la lan med pa ni chad pa ste/ dpe dag pa rnams dang*/ skabs gzhan gyi lo rgyus la yod do/ /sngar gyi lha khang de 'dra ba'i nang na/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du gnod sbyin de chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ shing rta sogs kyi bkod pa yang sngar gyi de kha 'dra rung la/ mi bcings pa'i tshab tu bu chung gcig bzhag pa/ lha khang de kha'i nang gi phyogs gcig tu/ bu chung de gnod sbyin des blangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi phyag tu phul ba dang*/ lha khang gi phyi rol du sangs rgyas kyi de'i pha ma khyim bdag pho mo'i rnam pa can la/ khye'u de gtod pa'i tshul 'bri/ gnod sbyin 'brog gnas brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(zha) de yan chad ni sngar gyi klu gnyis brtul ba sogs kyi dus de dang nye ba yin no/ /yang bkod pa de dag dang nye bar nags mthong gi grong khyer snga ma dang 'dra ba'i sgo drung du/ bud med gzhon nu zhig shing rtar zhugs nas 'khor bcas nang du 'gro ba dang*/ khyim bdag gzhon nu zhig shing rtar zhugs shing 'khor bcas phyi la 'gro ba'i shing rta'i gnya' shing sne thug pa dang*/ grong khyer nang gi khang bzang gcig bud med des khyim bdag de la mchod pa dang*/ khyim de'i phyi rol phar phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas la khyim bdag des chos nyan pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang lcags ri nye skor dang bcas pa zhig tu ston pa 'khor bcas bzhugs pa la phyi rol nas skye bo mang po bskor ba byed pa dang*/ nang du mchod pa 'bul ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na khyim bdag de dus las 'das pa dang*/

gnas gtsang ma'i lha mtshon byed lha gser gyi mdog can na bza' rab byung 'dra rung la thor tshugs dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer 'bar bas yul phyogs khyab par byed pa/ ri la thogs pa med pa yong ba gcig dang*/ lha de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du chos nyan pa 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs yul ljongs gcig tu/ khyim bdag dar bab gcig dang*/ rgyal po gcig dang*/ rgyal po blon po tshong dpon sogs kyi gzugs bris pa'i thang ka lag tu thogs pa'i mi mang po dang*/ bud med gzhon nu zhig phyogs gzhan zhig la me tog 'dor ba'i rnam pa dang*/ de dag la skye bo mang po 'dus shing lta ba'i tshul 'bri/ de dag ni 'brog gnas su dbyar gnas pa mdzad cing lag rgyud bden pa la bkod pa'i bkod pa yin te/ mdzad pa 'di gnod sbyin 'brog gnas brtul ba'i rjes la/ lo mang po zhig 'das pa'i skabs su yin kyang/ sngar gyi de dang 'brel bas sdebs gcig la 'bri'o/ /(za) yang yul ljongs gnyis la/ bar du ri nags sogs sa stong cung zad yod par bya/ phar phyogs de na rgyal po'i pho brang na go cha gcig sdogs nas sgrom bur 'jug tshul dang*/ yang khang bzang phyogs gcig tu rgyal po dang tshong pa rnams gtam smra ba dang*/ yang phyogs gcig rgyal po'i drung du tshong dpon 'ga' re la/ rgyal po'i 'phrin gyi yi ge dang sgrom bu gtong ba 'bri/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs de na pho brang gcig tu rgyal po la tshong pas de rnams 'bul ba dang*/ de'i khang bzang gi phyogs gcig tu rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa go cha de la lta ba dang*/ phyogs gcig tu rgyal po blo rten ma mnyes te/ lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de don bsam pa'i tshul gyi mdun du skye bo 'ga' res zhu ba byed pa'i tshul dang*/ phyi rol khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du rgyal pos zhu ba byed pa'i tshul dang*/ phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas bzhengs pa dang*/

ras gzhi skyang ba la sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer spros shing*/ ras gzhi'i steng du 'od kyi gzugs brnyan sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra ba byung ba la/ ri mo bas tshon 'gyed cing*/ sku'i steng 'og gnyis su yig mkhan gyi yi ge 'bri ba'i tshul bya/ 'di skabs su lung rnam 'byed las sku'i grib ma btang zhes 'byung ba ni/ rgya gar gyi skad du tshā ya zhes pa/ bod kyi skad du grib ma dang gzugs brnyan gnyis ka la 'jug ste/ me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la yang tshā ya zhes/ rgya gar ba thams cad la grags pa yin pas/ gzugs brnyan gyi grib ma yin gyi nyi 'od lta bu sgribs pas grib ma lta bu ma yin te/ bod skad la grib ma grags pa 'di yin na/ zhal spyan la sogs pa'i rnam pa mi dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dra long pa dka' bas so/ / yang khang bzang de dag dang nye ba gcig na/ rgyal po'i mdun na thang sku gser gyi dong bur bcug pa'i tshul dang*/ dngul snod gser snod ras kyi g.yogs pa sogs kyang brdeg pa dang*/ phyi rol du yi ge dang bris sku de tshong dpon la gtad pa dang*/ gnyis po'i bar lam gyi sa la glang po che'i rgyab tu bris sku de bskal/ gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod pas skor/ de dang lhan cig tu tshong pa mang po 'gro ba 'bri/ sngar gyi yul ljongs phar phyogs de'i grong khyer snga ma de dang 'brel ba'i/ stod smad gang rung du/ grong khyer pho brang phyi rol gyi sa stong sogs yod par byas te/ pho brang nang du rgyal po la pho nyas yi ge gtad pa/ phyogs gcig tu blon po rnams dang gtam smra ba dang*/ lam srang phyag dar byed pa dang*/ khang thog thams cad du rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba dang*/ spos dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang*/ sa gzhi la ras khra btings ba sogs dang*/ sa steng der bris sku shing ring po'i rtse mo la btags te zhal phye/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo mang po bsu ba'i bkod pa dang*/

g.yas g.yon nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul mkhan mang po/ steng gi nam mkha' la lha rnams me tog gi char 'bab pa 'bri/ pho brang nang gi khang bzang gcig tu bris sku bkram zhing mchod pa 'bul ba la/ rgyal po nyid lta ba dang*/ rgyal po'i lus las 'od zer cung zad 'phro ba 'bri/ yang yul phyogs de nyid ka yin kyang*/ spung bris nas bkod pa 'dzings par 'gyur bas/ yul ljongs sngar gyi gnyis po 'dra rung la/ yul tshur phyogs de na/ rgyal po'i pho brang gnyis na rgyal po la 'phrin yig skyes dang bcas pa 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ gtsug lag khang gnyis na sangs rgyas re re la rgyal pos zhu ba 'bul ba re re dang*/ de gnyis kyi phyogs gzhan re re na/ sangs rgyas kyi dge slong gzi brjid che ba 'khor bcas la bka' stsol ba dang*/ dge slong ma gzi brjid che ba la bka' stsol ba'i tshul re re 'bri/ grong khyer gyi rnam pa gnyis yod pa'i gcig tu/ dge slong mang po bsod snyoms byed pa dang*/ cig shos su dge slong mang po bsod snyoms byed pa dang*/ yul phar phyogs der phyogs gcig tu dge slong mang po 'byon pa la rgyal pos bsu ba byed pa dang*/ khang bzang du dge slong gcig khri la bzhugs/ gzhan mang pos skor ba la rgyal pos mchod pa byed pa dang*/ phyi rol du khri la dgra bcom pa bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo thams cad chos nyan pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu bkod pa de kha 'dra rung la/ dge slong ma'i tshogs 'byin pa dang*/ khang bzang du btsun mo'i tshogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ khang bzang de'i phyi khyams su dge slong mas btsun mo'i tshogs la chos ston pa 'bri/ yang zur gcig tu dgra bcomapa la khyim bdag chos nyan pa dang*/ de gnyis rab tu byung ba dang*/ de gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur te rdzu 'phrul ston pa la/ skye bo mang po lta zhing phyag byed pa dang*/ mchod rten chos 'khor bzhi re yod pa gnyis la mi rnams mchod pa byed pa 'bri/

yang khang bzang gcig na rgyal po pi waṃ brdungs zhing*/ mdun du bud med gar byed pa dang*/ yang de dang 'brel ba'i khang bzang gcig na rgyal po mnal ba'i sngas mgo nas lhas lung ston pa dang*/ rgyal pos gsal rgyal srid la bskos shing*/ blon po gnyis kyang bskos pa dang*/ 'khor nyung shas dang bcas te yul ljongs tshur phyogs gyi lam du chas/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs de'i zur na/ ston pa 'khor bcas kyi spyan sngar rgyal po de 'ong zhing rab tu byung ba'i bkod pa dang*/ de'i nye skor gcig tu rgyal po de skyed mos tshal na sdad pa dang*/ rgyal po gnyis po pho brang nang na yod pa dang*/ phyi sgo nas bsu ba dang bcas te/ de spyan drangs te pho brang gi nang du 'gro ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ de dag ni rgyal po u tra ya ṇa bris skus brtul zhing*/ grong khyer sgra sgrogs su bstan pa dar ba'i sde tshan no/ /('a) 'di'i lo rgyus lhag ma ngo mtshar can yod kyang*/ ston pa nyid kyi rnam thar la med kyang chog pa dang*/ bkod pa mi mdzes pa'i phyir re zhig bzhag go /yang nags gseb gcig na ston pa rab byung dang*/ khyim pa dang tshong pa dang slong mo ba sogs sna tshogs dang lhan cig gshegs pa/ mdun du byis pa gnyis las gcig gi rnga sked nyag 'dra ba gzhan gcig dang mda' gzhu thogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ras su lta ba dang*/ zhal las 'od zer byung ste/ steng 'og gnyis su song*/ slar mgrin par thim/ sku gzhogs nas dge slong gcig gis zhu ba zhu/ de nas nags mthong gcig tu ston pa 'khor bcas shing drung so so na bzhugs pa dang*/ shing skam po gcig gi rtsa bar me btang zhing*/ khong stong gi nang nas sbrul 'phyang ba dang*/ ri de'i phar phyogs na 'khor rnams ston pa'i rjes la yong ba/ rgyang ring po nas seng ge tshur rngam zhing tshur rgyug pa dang*/ phyag sor las seng ge lnga sprul te/ seng ge brdas shing*/ phar phyogs kyi mtha' mes 'khor ba dang*/

yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun du seng ge des chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ yang de'i phyogs su sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du lha zhig chos nyan pa 'bri/ byis pa gnyis lung bstan zhing seng ge ral pa can brtul ba'i sde tshan no/ /(ya) bar 'dir sog ma med kyi dang po'i lo rgyus sbyor rgyu yin yang 'dir ma bris so/ /yang grong khyer gcig gis 'gram na chu chen po gcig 'bab pa la/ nya pa mang pos dol chen po gnyis btab pa la/ sde tshan gcig gis srog chags mang po zin/ des mi rnams sde gcig gi 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i chu srin nya'i rigs can mgo mang po de zin/ des mi rnams chu nang du 'dren grabs la/ mi gzhan mang po yang rgyug cing 'then pa'i tshul dang*/ nya chu srin de bskam la thon pa dang*/ de lus po nya la mgo bo bco brgyad yod de/ glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ rnga mong dang*/ bong bu dang*/ glang dang*/ spre'u dang*/ seng ge dang*/ stag dang*/ dom dang*/ dred dang*/ gung dang*/ byi la dang*/ ra dang*/ lug dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ ma he dang*/ phag dang*/ khyi'i mgo bo rnams so/ /bskam la bton zin pa de'i mtha' la skye bo mang po dang*/ mu stegs ston pa drug la sogs pa yang yod cing*/ gtsug lag khang gcig nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas tshur 'byon pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu ston pa byon te/ ston pas nya pa rnams la bka' stsal zhing*/ chu srin de ma gtogs srog chags gzhan thams cad nya pa des chu la gtong pa dang*/ ston pas chu srin nya de la dri ba mdzad pa dang*/ dge slong gcig gi langs te zhu ba 'bul zhing*/ gzhan 'khor tshogs mang po la chos gsung ba/ yang phyogs gcig tu nya pa lnga brgya po de dag tshur shog gi snyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa dang*/ yang nags tshal gcig tu ljon shing so so'i sar bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang*/ dge slong mang pos nor mang po rnyed nas tshur 'ong ba dang*/ yang phug pa dang*/

shing drung mang por dge slong mang po mnyam bzhag byed pa dang*/ lus las 'od mang po 'phros zhing*/ rdzu 'phrul mang po ston pa'i dge slong mang po yang 'bri/ nya pa rnams rab tu byung ba'i 'khris der lha gcig la sangs rgyas chos gsung pa 'bri/ nya pa lnga brgya brtul zhing dgra bcom pa la bkod pa'i skor ro/ /(ra) khyim gcig na bram ze gser brgyan khri la 'dug pa dang*/ khang bzang gi phyogs gcig na/ bram ze bzang po gos rgyan bzang po zhig gi mdun na/ bram ze gzhan 'ga' re langs te gtam smra ba dang*/ khyim gyi sgo bzhi nas gser las byas pa'i lha mo'i gzugs brnyan 'dra ba re thogs te phyogs bzhir 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ yang yul gzhan gcig na/ bud med gser gyis mdog can gcig gi drung du gser gyi sku gzugs de bzhag pa dang*/ khang bzang gcig na bram ze gtso bo gcig gi drung du/ bram ze 'ga' re langs te shis pa brjod pa'i tshul bya/ bud med gser mdog de shing rtar bzhugs 'khor mang po dang bcas te tshur 'ong ba dang*/ khang bzang gcig tu/ bud med gser mdog de gdan la 'dug cing*/ bram ze'i khye'u de chags pa'i tshul dang*/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig byas te/ rab byung dang bram ze dang*/ dbul 'phongs mang po la khyim gyi nor thams cad sbyin par gtong tshul/ bram ze de ston pa drug po re re'i drung du dri ba re byed pa'i tshul/ bud med gser mdog de gcer bu pa slob dpon 'ga' re'i drung du/ skra bregs shing thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul dang*/ mthar bram ze de grong khyer gcig gi 'gram bu mang po'i mchod rten zhes bya ba/ mchod rten gcig gi 'gram du/ ston pa'i spyan sngar rab byung du gyur te thal mo sbyar bas 'dug pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu bram ze dge slong du gyur pa de mnyam bzhag la bzhugs shing lus las 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ yang ston pa na bza' phyags dar khrod rdo tshos ma gsol ba dang*/

dgra bcom pa rnam sbyar shin tu dmar ba gsol pa bzhengs te gtam mdzad pa'i tshul dang*/ snam sbyar gtad pa'i steng du ston pa bzhugs pa dang*/ dge slong des snam sbyar dmar po bcom ldan 'das la phul zhing*/ ston pa'i rdo tshos ma de la gnang ba dang*/ de tshos gos rdo tshos de gyon nas nags tshal na 'dug pa dang*/ yang de rdo tshos ma de gsol/ dbu skra dang kha spu cung zad ring bar byas nas/ ston pa chos gsungs pa 'khor gyis bskor ba'i mtha' nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ yang de kha dang 'dra ba la/ ston pas de la bstan pa byed gnang ba ste/ bzhugs gdan gcig la gral sgrigs kyi tshul du 'dug pa dang*/ yang de 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas chos nyan pa 'bri/ yang de dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig na/ sngar gyi bud med gser gyi mdog can de/ dge slong mar gyur nas ston pa la chos nyan pa ste/ de dag ni 'od bsrung chen po bden pa la bkod pa sogs kyi skor ro/ /(la) yang ston pa nags tshal gcig na bzhugs pa la/ shing gi steng na spre'u shing lo'i 'dom dkris 'khril shing gi yal gas sdoms thag byas pa zhig yod pa dang*/ yang shing gi rtsa bar de babs nas/ ston pa'i lhung bzed len pa'i grabs byed pa la/ dge slong gcig gis de ldogs pa dang*/ yang lhung bzed blang nas shing gi rtse mor song ste/ lhung bzed du sbrang rtsi blugs pa dang*/ yang ston pa'i sku gzhan zhig bris pa'i sku mdun du 'bul tshul byas kyang*/ ston pa mnyam bzhag mdzad nas mi bzhes pa dang*/ yang spre'u des lhung bzed sbrang rtsis gang ba 'khyer nas sa stong gcig tu/ sbrang bu'i ro rnams phyir sel ba dang*/ chu mig gcig gi 'gram du rung chu blugs pa dang*/ yang ston pa la phul zhing ston pas bzhes pa dang*/ spre'u de dga' nas gar byed pa 'bri/ de dang nye bar phyi 'gros su phyin pas khron pa la shor ba dang*/ nam mkha'i dbyings na lha'i gzhal med khang gi nang du lhar skyes pa dang*/

yang lha de ston pa'i drung du 'ongs nas mchod pa 'bul zhing chos nyan pa 'bri ste/ yul yangs pa can du spre'us sbrang rtsi phul ba'i bkod pa'o/ /gzhan lo rgyus de kha dang 'dra ba la/ lhar skyes pa'i tshab tu bram ze las drug la brtson pa'i bur skyes te/ btsas ma thag tu sbrang rtsi'i char 'babs pa dang*/ mthar rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob pa'i bar gyi lo rgyus kyang yod do/ /(sha) yang brag phug dang*/ rtswa spyil dang*/ lo ma'i spyil po dang*/ nags gsebs dang*/ shing gi drung dang*/ spyil po sogs dben pa'i gnas mi 'dra ba drug tu/ gong du bshad pa'i rtog ge ba drug ste/ mu stegs ston pa drug tu grags pa re re yod pa'i de dag re re'i mdun du yang*/ me 'bar ba dang*/ 'od 'byin pa/ char pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ston mkhan lnga tsam re yod pa 'bri/ 1 de nas skyed mos tshal 'dra ba zhig tu ston pa drug kar tshogs pa zhig 'bri/ 2 rgyal po'i pho brang zhig gi nang du/ rgyal po'i drung du ston pa drug tshogs pa dang*/ phyi la 'gro ba 'bri/ 3 gtsug lag khang zhig na sangs rgyas bzhugs shing*/ rgyal po yang glang bo zhon nas/ sangs rgyas mjal du 'gro ba'i lam du/ ston pa drug gi rgyal po la/ gtam smra ba dang*/ 4 yang de nas phyogs gzhan du sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phar phyogs la thegs pa'i rjes nas ston pa drug 'khor mang yang 'bri/ 5 de nas yang pho brang gzhan zhig dang*/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang du sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang*/ rgyal po gzhan zhig sangs rgyas mjal du 'gro ba'i lam du ston pa drug langs ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la rgyal po des zhu ba byed pa dang*/ yang rgyal po de phyir byung nas/ ston pa drug sa la bsdad pa la gtam smra ba dang*/ ston pa drug dang mu stegs pa mang po grong khyer chung chung sna tshogs su bkram ste 'gro ba dang*/ mtsho gcig gi nang nas drang srong gcig 'dug pa des/
