ston pa drug la gtam smra ba dang*/ ston pa drug po ma dga' zhing khros nas 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ ri dang nags tshal yod pa zhig na drang srong mang po yod pa'i sar/ ston pa drug dga' ba'i tshul rnams mtha' la 'bri zhing*/ 7 dbus kyi phyogs su grong khyer tho re ba 'ga' re dang*/ khang bzang gcig gi rtse nas bud med gyi me tog 'phreng ba 'phangs pa/ rgyal po'i bu'i rnam pa 'dra ba sngo sang zhig gi lus la phog pa dang*/ grong gseb der de'i rkang lag rnams rgyal po'i gshed mas bcad cing gnyen gyi mtha' bskor nas 'jus te 'dug pa/ ston pa drug po de'i 'khris nas phar gdong sa la bab ste 'gro ba dang*/ de'i 'khris de khar dge slong gcig gi de la bden stobs brjod pas/ yan lag bcad pa rnams slar 'grig pa dang*/ 8 de rnams kyi mtha' bskor ci rigs par ston pa'i cho 'phrul khang pa rtsig mkhan dang*/ mi gzhan 'ga' res mu stegs drug po yang cho 'phrul khang ba rtsig pa'i tshul 'bri yang phar phyogs su/ 9 sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du bram ze zhig spos phor thogs te spyan 'dren zhu ba'i tshul dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu ston pa'i cho 'phrul khang bzang rgya chen po zhig gi sgo drung du rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs rnams 'dus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing 'byon pa dang*/ sgo drung du rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ cho 'phrul khang pa de'i dbus na sangs rgyas bzhugs shing*/ sgo gcig nas me 'bar ba dang*/ drang srong mang po nam mkha' la 'phur zhing 'ongs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun du chos nyan pa dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi rnam pa zhig gi shing sdong lo 'bras rgyas pa bya sna tshogs kyi khengs pa zhig khang bzang de'i g.yon du 'dzugs pa dang*/ khyim bdag gcig gi rin po che'i 'bras bu can gyi ljon shing gos rgyan du ma yal kha las 'byung ba zhig g.yas phyogs su 'dzugs pa dang*/

cho 'phrul khang pa de'i phyi nang gi zur kun nas/ mi kha dog ma nges pa/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar bo/ sngon po sogs 'ja' 'od dang 'brel ba ci rigs ci rigs 'byung ba 'bri'o/ /sangs rgyas bzhengs pa sgo'i them pa la zhabs kyi mnan pa zhig kyang 'bri/ sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul khang pa de dang nye ba na/ 10 mu stegs kyi cho 'phrul khang pa chung ba drug gi nang na/ ston pa drug po re re dang*/ phyi nang na de rnams kyi 'khor dang*/ yon bdag ci rigs pa 'bri/ 11 yang cho 'phrul khang pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ khang bzang phyi rol rdo chal 'dra ba yangs pa zhig tu pad+ma'i sdong po shin tu rgyas pa'i rtse mo la ston pa sangs rgyas nyid bzhugs pa/ phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag byed/ gzhan yal ga rnams las gyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul sna tshogs pa dag 'bri/ steng gi nam mkha' la bzhengs pa dang*/ bzhugs pa dang*/ mnal ba dang*/ 'chags pa'i tshul ston pa dang*/ klog 'gyu ba dang/ sprin 'phro pa dang*/ 'od 'gyed pa dang*/ me 'bar zhing chu 'khrugs ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mtha' skor thams cad du rgyal po la sogs pa/ skye bo dpag tu med pas yongs skor zhing*/ de dag gi phyi mtha' ma/ rta/ glang po/ rnga mong*/ rma bya la sogs pa dang nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i dud 'gro mang po dang*/ nam mkha' la lha mang pos/ me tog dang*/ rin po che dang*/ gos kyi char 'bebs pa/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin dang mi ma yin/ srin po dang klu la sogs pa mang po 'khod cing cho 'phrul la lta ba 'bri/ pad sdong gi g.yas g.yon du dgra bcom pa rnams de la lta ba dang*/ sku mdun phyogs na rgyal po gsal rgyal langs te thal mo sbyar ba 'bri/ pad sdong de rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa dang*/ gtso bo'i pad+ma gser gyis rang bzhin yin pa bshad/ khang bzang des phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi sku'i g.yas nas dgra bcom pa gcig dang*/

g.yon nas dge bsnyen ma gcig gi zhu ba zhu tshul byed/ yang de dang 'brel ba'i khang bzang gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na dge slong bya ma bum thogs pa mang po spung bris su bris/ 12 de'i phyi rol tu rgyal pos ston pa drug la gtam smra ba'i tshul dang*/ ston pa drug po gcig gis gcig la gru sug byed pa'i tshul dang*/ yang ston pa drug gnas pa'i steng*/ nam mkha'i dbyings na lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'bar ba thogs pa'i 'gram nas/ char rlung drag po mi zad pa byung bas de rnams bros 'gro tshul dang*/ de dag las thag ring rnams kyi mtha' rnams su/ gcig brag phug tu bzhugs pa dang*/ gcig rtswa 'thug po'i gseb dang*/ gcig nags dang*/ gcig mgron khang dang*/ gcig lha khang du gab nas bsdad pa dang*/ rdzogs byed lam du 'gro ba la/ mi ngan ngon gcig gis sdigs shing smod pa'i tshul dang*/ yang de'i phyogs gcig tu bum pa bye mas gang ba mgul du btags te/ rdzing bu'i nang du 'phyongs te shi ba'i bkod pa dang*/ char rlung byung sa de'i 'khris su/ mu stegs kyi cha byad 'ga' re tshogs shing gros byed pa dang*/ lam du zhugs shing*/ bud med gcig la gtam 'dri ba dang*/ rdzogs byed shi ba la lta ba dang/ de dang nye ba'i chu la bum pa mgul du btags te 'phyong ste shi ba 'ga' re bris/ de rnams mtha' la bris zhing*/ dbus yangs sa zhig tu/ bzhugs khri mthon po la sangs rgyas bzhugs shing*/ 'khor dge slong sogs 'khor rnam bzhi dang*/ skyes pa bud med lha klu sde brgyad sogs mang po dang*/ mu stegs can yang mang po 'dus pa la/ chos gsung ba'i tshul bya/ de dag ni cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i sde tshan no/ /(sa) cho 'phrul nyi ma gcig pa 'di ni/ 'dul ba sogs nas bshad pa theg pa thun mong gi lugs yin la/ cho 'phrul nyi ma bco lnga pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i lugs yin te/ lugs 'di gnyis kyang bsre bar mi bya'o/

/de'i phyir mdo sde mdzangs blun yang theg chen yin gyi/ nyan thos kyi mdo min no/ /de bzhin du dran pa nyer bzhag mdo yang theg chen kho na yin pas/ bshes gnyen chen por grags pa rnams gsung ca bcol mi 'byon par zhu'o/ /yang gtsug lag khang dbus ma zhig na sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag la bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan gnas khang so so na dge slong so so dag la mchod pa dang yo byad kyi khyad par mang po dang*/ phyi nang du skye bo 'du 'tshogs byed pa'i 'bri'o/ /yang gnas de kha 'dra ba gcig tu dgra bcom pa zhig bzhugs khri la 'duga'akhor mang po chos nyan pa'i tshul 'bri/ de ni cho 'phrul bstan pas dge slong rnams yo byad 'phel ba dang*/ des chos spyod 'gribs pas rnyed bkur gyi rgyun gcod par bzhed nas lha yul du gshegs pa/ gnyen yod du mau 'gal gyis dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /snga ma de'i 'khris su dgra bcom pa sa stegs mtho ba gcig la bzhugs pa la/ rab byung dang skye bo mang po zhu ba byed pa 'bri/ de dang nye ba na ri rab kyi bkod pa rjes mthun pa byas te/ ri'i rtse mo rgya che ba zhig byed/ de'i phyogs gcig na lha'i grong khyer gyi phyogs sa mtshon byed dang*/ phyogs gcig na skyed mos tshal gyi dbus na/ shing sdong shin tu che ba gcig yod pa/ des rtsa ba na brag leb mo dkar po shin tu che ba'i dbus na/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang*/ ston pa'i sku mdun du lha mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig dang*/ mtha' skor du lha mang po chos nyan pa'i bkod pa bya/ de'i 'khris su yang bkod pa de kha 'dra ba zhig la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dgra bcom pa zhig gi zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ de nas yang steng gi nam mkha' la lha gnas gzhan rnams 'bri ste/ go skabs yangs zhing 'bri stabs bde na/ 'dod lha rigs gzhan bzhi dang*/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun du sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i bkod pa 'bri dgos pa yin kyang*/

steng 'og tu de tsam shongs dka' bar 'dug pas/ nam mkha' la 'dod lha gong ma'i gnas mtshon byed sa gzhi ri nags/ me tog rdzing bu gzhal med khang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ lha pho mo mang po dang bcas pa'i yul phyogs gcig sprin gseb tu 'bri ste/ gnas de rang gi steng la yang sprin kha dog sna lnga dang*/ nor bu dang me tog gi rol dpyad kyi char 'bab pa'i tshul dang*/ lha pho mo mang po'i dbus na sangs rgyas chos gsung pa'i tshul dang*/ yang de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la/ sa gzhi mtha' ris bskor ba 'dra ba/ dbus su gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa thams cad kha dog dkar po nyag gcigashing dang sprin dang bya dang mtsho la sogs pa med pa/ lha thams cad kha dog ser po/ gos dkar po sha dag yod pa/ lha pho 'ba' zhig yin la/ de lta bur sangs rgyas chos gsung pa ni/ gzugs khams phal pa'i gnas rnams mtshon byed dang*/ yang de'i steng gi nam mkha' la sa gzhi ri sogs med pa'i gzhal med khang dkar po yangs pa zhig na/ sangs rgyas la 'khor lha kha dog ser po/ /na bza' dra sogs med pa ma gtogs rab 'byung 'dra rung las/ thor gtsug dang rgyan gyis brgyan pas bskor te chos nyan pa ni/ gnas gtsang ma mtshon byed do/ /ri rab de'am gzhan zhig bris nas/ de'i rtse nas mar skas kyi rnam pa byed pa'am/ yang de 'bri stabs mi bde na nam mkha'i dbyings lha gnas gzhan gcig nas skas gtsugs pa byas kyang yod/ nags mthong zhig na rab byung dang*/ khyim pa'i skye bo shin tu mang ba 'dus pa gcig gi dbus su skas bshams gtsugs pa dgos te/ skas dbus ma sngon po/ /g.yas ser ba/ g.yon pa dkar ba/ skas dbus ma'i dkyil tsam na sangs rgyas dang*/ skas g.yas pa na ston pa'i mdun tsam du tshangs pa rnga yab dkar po 'dzin pa/ skas g.yon pa ston pa'i sku rgyab tsam du/ brgya byin mig stong dang ldan pa gdug dkar po gser gyi yu ba can 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon steng rnams nas lha dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/

skas kyi phyed smad tsam na/ ston pa nam mkha' la 'byon pa gcig kyang 'bri/ yang nags mthong de kha 'dra ba zhig tu sangs rgyas 'khor mang po la chos ston pa dang*/ lha mang pos nam mkha' nas mchod pa dang*/ phyogs gcig nas tshur 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor bcas yong ba'i tshul dang*/ phyogs gcig shos de na/ shing drung gcig na dge slong gcig dang*/ gcig mnyam bzhag byed pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung na dge slong kha dog mi sha ma yin pa'i sngo sang rang btang pa zhig phyag 'bul ba rnams 'bri ste/ lha las babs pa'i skor ro/ /(ha) yang ston pa 'khor bcas lam du gshegs pa dang*/ sku mdun kyi thad la/ ljon shing gsar pa mang po dang*/ chu dang rdzing bu yid du 'ong ba me tog can mang po dang*/ khang bzang stong pa 'ga' re yod pa 'bri zhing*/ g.yas g.yon 'ga' re na shing bcad pa dang*/ khang pa bshig pa dang*/ rdzing la 'ga' zhig gi dug 'debs pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de'i pha rol grong khyer chen po lcags ri skor ba/ grong khyer gyi srang kha dang 'brel ba'i rdo chal 'dra ba zhig na/ mu stegs mang pos skye bo mang po la gtam smra ba dang*/ grong khyer de'i lcags ri sgo sdams shing*/ lcags ri'i phyogs gcig nas mar skas btsugs pa la/ bud med sgron me chen po thogs pa zhig 'bab pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol kyi gnas zhig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ bud med de chos nyan pa dang*/ grong khyer de'i nang khang bzang gcig na/ khyim bdag gcig dang*/ gzhan skye bo 'dus pa la/ bud med des khas len spong pa'i tshul/ yang grong khyer de kha yin kyang*/ bkod pa logs pa bya ste/ grong khyer du khyim bdag gcig gis srang kha'i bzhi mdor/ gser dong tse mang po spung shing*/ lcags ri'i skas de la 'bab pa dang*/ phyi rol tu ston pa'i sku drung du chos nyan pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi nang gi khang bzang zhig gi sgo ru gser gyi phung po dang*/

nor bu'i phung po spungs shing*/ skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi sgo nas phar mi mang po 'gro zhing*/ lcags ri'i phyogs gcig na/ phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje gdeng ba'i tshul dang*/ de'i thad kyi lcags ri 'gyel ba'i thad nas mi mang po 'gro ba/ de'i phar phyogs na bzhugs khri la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i sku'i mtha' bskor thams cad skye bo sna tshogs pas bskor zhing chos nyan pa'i bkod pa dang*/ steng nas lha rnams kyis mchod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gnas de 'od zer gyi khyab pa'i tshul 'bri/ de'i pha rol khang bzang zhig tu khyim bdag dar ma yol ba zhigamadzod gcig gi dra mig nas lta ba/ mdzod de nor gyi khengs pa/ bud med gcig snod gcig tu 'bras 'tshod cing*/ snod gzhan mang po 'bras kyi gang ba dang*/ gzhon nu gcig sked pa nas snod gcig gi nang nas gser dngul mang po gzhan la gtong ba'i tshul dang*/ bud med gzhon nu zhig gis snod gcig tu dri bzang ldugs par byed cing*/ snod gzhan mang po zhig dri bzang gis gang ba dang*/ khyim gyi phyi rol tu g.yog po'i gzugs zhig zhing gcig rmos pas zhing mang por rmos par gyur pa dang*/ khyim gyi sgo nang na g.yog mo'i gzugs zhig tun shing thogs nas 'bras sbru ba/ g.yas g.yon du snod mang po 'bras kyis gang pa rnams 'bri ste/ grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(a) bar 'dir khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ston pa'i sku gzugs bya bar zhus pa de yang*/ khyim bdag gcig gi khyim du gcer bu pa mang po la kha zas g.yos pa'i 'gram nas mi gcig gi bzhad gad byed pa'i rnam pa dang*/ khyim gyi phyi sgo'i nang du 'bras kyi khu ba la gcer bu pa 'gred cing*/ rdog pa'i shugs kyis then pa bud pa 'bri/ phyi rol sa stong gcig tu/ gcer bu ba de mgo la rma dkris byed cing*/ khyim bdag cig dang gtam smra ba dang*/

yang khang pa gcig gi nang na mi mang po zas sna tshogs sbyor zhing*/ de rnams la dug 'debs pa dang*/ sgo khang du dong byas par/ phyogs gcig nas me ldugs/ phyogs gcig nas rtsa'i thog 'gebs/ de'i steng du sa rab rim mthor ba dang*/ de'i phar phyogs bar stong cung zad yod par byas nas/ gtsug lag khang khang bzang du ma yod pa'i khang bzang gcig tu/ sangs rgyas la khyim bdag gcig gis zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ khang bzang gcig nas sangs rgyas bzhengs shing 'byon pa la/ lha 'ga' zhig gis ldog pa'i tshul dang/ gtsug lag khang dang sngar gyi de'i bar la/ grong khyer gyi rnam pa cung zad byas pa'i 'gram nas/ sangs rgyas phebs pa la yang*/ lha zhig gis ldog pa'i tshul dang*/ me dang dug sbyor sogs yod pa'i khyim de kha'i 'khris su/ khyim de'i kho na 'dra ba yangs pa zhig byas nas/ de'i sgo drung ma sleb tsam na/ sangs rgyas thog mar phebs shing*/ dge slong rnams phyi nas 'byon pa'i tshul bya/ sku mdun du yang lha zhig gis ldog tshul byed/ khyim de'i sgo khang yang par pad+ma'i mtsho/ dang ba dang me tog sna tshogs kyi gang ba/ sangs rgyas kyis pad+ma de dag gi steng du zhabs bzhag ste 'byon pa'i tshul dang*/ khang bzang gi rtse nas/ gcer bu pa gcig dang*/ khyim bdag gcig lta ba dang*/ khang pa de'i sgo gzhan zhig nas gcer bu pa de 'bros pa dang*/ khang bzang de'i dbus na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang*/ khyim bdag pho mo gnyis g.yog dang bcas pas/ gdugs tshod gsol ba las snod snga ma'i nang na kha zas nag por yod pa/ lhung bzed kyi nang du/ blugs pa'i tshe kha dog dkar por song ba 'bri/ khang pa de'i phyi rol sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu/ 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs 'bri ste/ khyim bdag dpal sbed la sogs pa brtul ba'i sde tshan no/ /(ki) yang ri dang nags tshal dang ne gseng yod pa zhig na/ lha mo 'dra rung mdog dmar ba bzhin zhi ma khro mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa la/

'khor byis pa rgan gzhon gyi rim pa sna chogs pa/ srin po'i phrug gu 'dra ba rgyan mang pos brgyan pa/ la la mi'i byis pa bzung ste za ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ grong khyer gcig nas bud med bu thogs pa mang po bros te 'gro ba'i tshul la/ srin po'i gzugs kyi 'gags pa'i rnam pa dang/ 'ga' zhig thag ring por bros thub pa'i rnam pa'ang 'bri/ phyogs gcig tu skye bo mang po bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba zhu ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ de nas mi ma yin gyi khang pa sha khrag rus pa thod pa tho re ba gcig gi sgo rtsar/ sangs rgyas bzhugs shing sku'i drung du/ byis pa gser mdog gcig la lhung bzed 'gebs grabs mdzad pa 'bri/ sngar gyi lha mo 'dra ba'i gnod sbyin mo dmar mo de kha yin pa la/ rings par rgyugs pa'i tshul/ skra 'dzings pa'i rnam pas grong khyer gyi srang kha la bu 'tshol du 'gro ba'i rnam pa dang*/ ri nag po dgu dang*/ gangs can sogs la pus mo btsugs te 'gro ba dang*/ tsog por 'dug pa'i tshul gyi sdod pa dang*/ slar yang rgyugs pa dang*/ tsha dmyal gyi gnas lcags bsregs dang*/ me dang*/ dmyal ba'i sems can sdug bsngal myong ba'i rnam pa yod pa gcig gi sar yang 'tshol ba dang*/ grang dmyal gyi gnas mtshon byed gangs ri dang*/ sa gzhi dkar po sems can lus tshal par gas pa yod pa gcig tu yang de'i tshol ba rgyugs pa/ ri rab steng 'og tu bang rim dang bcas pa rtse mo tshang ba/ mtsho nang nas skyes pa logs la phyang tsam phag nas 'thon pa zhig 'bri/ de'i bang rim dang rtse mo rnams su de rgyugs pa dang*/ ri rab gyi rtse mo'i phyogs gcig na lha dang gnod sbyin khro bo 'ga' zhig gi de bzung zhing phyir slog pa dang*/ ri rab kyi bang rim gyi phyogs gcig na/ rnam thos sras bzhugs pa'i drung du gnod sbyin mo de zhu ba byed pa dang*/ tshur de dga' ba'i tshul gyi log yong ba dang*/ yang gnod sbyin mi ma yin gyi khang pa sha khrag tho re ba snga ma de dang 'dra ba'i drung na/

sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ de thal mo sbyar te chos nyan pa dang*/ sku'i g.yas su lhung bzed kha sbub pa dang*/ g.yon du khye'u gser mdog de nyid yod pa 'bri'o/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ de las cung zad rgyas par byed na/ thog ma'i skabs de'i bkod pa la/ grong khyer gyi steng du/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ dar mang po phyar/ sa gzhi la me tog dor/ spos mang po btang*/ lha rten mang po yod pa'i sar/ gtor ma dang mchod pa sna tshogs bshams pa dang*/ skye bo mang po tshogs pa la nam mkha' nas lha gcig gis gtam smra ba dang*/ gzhug tu yang grong khyer chen por mi rnams dga' ston byed pa'i rnam pa 'bri ste/ gnod sbyin mo phrog ma brtul ba'i sde tshan no/ /(khi) yang bkod pa gcig la yul ljongs gnyis 'bri zhing*/ de gnyis kyi bar ri dang nags tshal dang*/ yul phra mo mang pos bar chod pa/ yul ljongs phar phyogs de cung zad chung bar bya ste/ grong khyer gyi dbus na pho brang che ba zhig bya/ de'i dbus su rgyal po chen po gcig la rgyal phran mang po 'dud pa dang*/ blon po dang dmag mi sogs 'khor tshogs mang pos skor ba/ yang de dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig tu/ khang bzang gi mdun gyi khyams yangs pa'i dbus su rgyal po chen po de dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du blon po 'ga' re dang*/ mdun nas tshong pa 'ga' re'i skyes 'bul ba dang*/ gtam bya ba'i tshul bya/ de dang 'dabs 'byor ba'i khang bzang zhig rgyal pos pho nya drug tsam la bka' gnang zhing*/ bka' yig gi sgrom bu gtod pa dang*/ yang yul de'i phyogs gcig nas/ rgyal po de'i dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang*/ 'khor gos rgyan bzang po can mang pos bskor nas/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs der yong ba'i tshul dang*/ yang yul ljongs gnyis pa'i bar mtshams de la pho nya ba rnams phar 'gro dang tshur yong ba'i bkod pa bya/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs de la/ mtha' skor du grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa drug 'bri/

de re re bzhin rgyal po re'i mdun du/ pho nya re re'i sgrom bu gtod pa re 'bri/ yul ljongs de'i dbus kyi cha la/ gung du gtsug lag khang gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i mtha' skor du/ dge slong gzi brjid che ba gcig dang*/ gzhan dge slong mang po dang*/ mtha' la skye bo sna tshogs pa 'bri/ de'i g.yas khang bzang chen po gcig gi mdun/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang bcas pa/ phyag g.yon du gzhu 'dzin zhing*/ mda' lnga nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i mi de'u rtse la pad+ma re/ pad+ma'i lte ba la rgyal po re re/ de re re las 'od zer steng 'og thams cad du 'gro ba'i tshul bya/ de'i sku mdun du sngar gyi yul ljongs phar phyogs kyi rgyal po de la blon pos gzhu gtod pa'i tshul dang*/ rgyal po de'i gzhu 'then kyang*/ 'then ma thub pa dang*/ de 'khor dang bcas pas rgyal po de la phyag 'bul ba'i tshul 'bri/ dbus kyi gtsug lag khang de'i g.yon gyi phyogs su khang bzang gcig gi nang du/ sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po gcig gis zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshul 'bri'o/ /de dag ni rgyal po ka pi na 'khor bcas brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(gi) yang yul phyogs gnyis shig bya ste/ yul phar phyogs de na/ khang bzang gcig tu rgyal po gcig gis khyim bdag gcig la bka' stsol ba dang*/ yang khyim bdag des khyim gcig gi rtsar 'dod yon sna tshogs bshams/ skye bo mang po la sbyin pa gtong ba'i bkod pa byed/ de'i drung du bram ze drang srong mang po yod pa la/ zas nor mang po ster ba zhig 'bri/ logs gcig na bram ze drang srong de rnams/ yul gzhan nas der 'ong ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ dgos pa la thog mar/ thag ring gcig nas 'ong pa la/ nye skor gzhan na chu med pa la/ shing sdong gcig gi phyogs gcig nas bram ze drang srong rnams kyi snod so so nas chu 'dzed cing*/ shing gi rtse mo nas gzugs med pa'i lag pa lag gdub can zhig brkyang ste bum pa bzung nas snod de rnams su blugs pa'i tshul dang*/

phyogs gcig nas de dag gis shing la gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ de nas ri gcig rgyab pa'i yul zhig tu/ shing gi g.yas g.yon gnyis nas drang srong rnams gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ ri'i phag zhig na mtsho chu bya dang me tog gis gang ba/ 'gram na zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod bzhag pa/ drang srong la la de phyogs la rgyug cing*/ la la der sleb nas/ mtsho nas 'thung ba dang kha zas za ba'i tshul 'bri/ de dang sngar gyi sbyin gtong gi khang pa'i bar du yang ri gcig gis chod pa 'bri/ sbyin gtong khang pa'i rgyab tu/ sngar gyi khyim bdag de dang drang srong de rnams gtam smra ba dang*/ khang bzang gcig tu khyim bdag gcig rgyal po la zhu ba byed pa dang*/ khyim bdag de dang drang srong rnams sdebs te/ yul phyogs tshur der 'ong ba'i bkod pa dang*/ yul tshur phyogs de na/ khang bzang chen po'i phyi khyams kyi sgo drung na/ khyim bdag dang drang srong de rnams tshogs pa dang*/ khang bzang gi nang khyim bdag de dang*/ khyim bdag gzi brjid can zhig stan gcig la sgrigs/ drang srong de rnams kyang mdun na 'dug pa dang*/ khang bzang de'i phyi rol phyogs gcig na phar/ khyim bdag gzi brjid che ba des/ khyim bdag dang drang srong rnams khrid cing 'gro ba dang*/ de'i yang tshur phyogs nas sangs rgyas 'khor mang pos bskor te/ chos gsungs pa dang*/ de rnams kyang phyag 'tshal zhing chos nyan pa rnams 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi drung du/ drang srong de rnams rab tu byung ste dgra bcom pa thob pa'i bar du 'bri/ yang gtsug lag khang gcig gi nang du bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba zhu zhing*/ sgo'i phyi nas khyim bdag de yul phar phyogs su 'gro ba'i tshul 'bri/ bskul byed zhes bya ba'i dgra bcom pa zhig dang*/ lhan cig du bar lam de nas 'gro ba dang*/ yul ljongs phar phyogs der de gnyis kyi kha lta byed cing skyed mos tshal zhig gi dbus su gtsug lag khang rtsig pa dang*/

yul tshur phyogs der sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi drung du pho nya zhig sleb pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas yul phar phyogs der gshegs pa'i tshul dang*/ bar lam de na mchod pa mang po dang bcas bzhugs pa dang*/ yul ljongs phar phyogs de'i dom che sa zhig tu/ gtsug lag khang rgya che bar byas te/ de'i phyi nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon pa la skye bo mang pos bsu ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ lta ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi khang bzang gi nang na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pas mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ de gnyis char gyi steng gi nam mkha' nas/ lha rnams kyi me tog gi char 'bebs pa 'bri/ yang rgyal po'i pho brang phyi khyams rdo chal 'dra ba zhig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi mchod pa dang*/ chos nyan pa 'bri/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig gi phyogs gcig tu/ rgyal po'i btsun mo 'khor bcas khri dang gdan zhig la 'dug cing*/ g.yog mo rgur mo zhig langs te tshig brjod pa'i tshul dang*/ yang de kha'i phyogs gzhan gcig tu/ g.yog mo de khri la bzhagabatsun mo 'khor bcas chos nyan zhing lus la 'od 'phro ba'i rnam pa bya/ yang khang bzang de 'dra ba la/ glo dkar shin tu mang ba gtod pa nas/ btsun mo 'khor bcas lta zhing*/ phyi rol kyi sa gzhi la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phebs pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i yul ljongs logs pa chung ngu zhig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas grong khyer du gshegs pa zhig dang*/ grong khyer de dang nye ba'i nags na/ sangs rgyas phar 'byon pa dang de'i rjes bar thag yod pa gcig na/ bram ze gcig dang*/ bud med gcig dang*/ bu mo lang tsho la bab pa gcig rnams 'gro ba'i bkod pa bya/ nags de brgal ba'i nags mthong gcig na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i phyogs gcig tu/ de rnams sleb pa dang*/ nye skor phyogs gcig na bud med lus sbom pa/ skra brdzes pa/ mig zhum bu'i mig lta bu 'jigs pa'i lus su gyur pa zhig 'bri/

de nas phar phyogs yul ljongs snga ma der/ skyed mos tshal gcig na bram ze gcig dang bud med gzhon nu gcig 'dug pa la mi mang pos skor ba dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi khang bzang gnyis na/ rgyal po btsun mo che chung gnyis dang bcas pa zas kyi bkod pa mang po yod pa re 'bri/ khang bzang gcig gi 'og khang na/ mi gos ngan pa gyon pa/ khyim bya thogs pa zhig dang*/ gcig gi 'og tu btsun mo chung ba/ bya'i sha thogs pa zhig 'bri/ yang 'khor sa'i khyams zhig na/ btsun mo che ba 'khor bcas 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos rgyang nas mda' gzhu 'gengs pa dang*/ mda' gcig bar lam du lhung ba dang*/ gcig tshur log nas rgyal po rang gi drung du lhung ba dang*/ yang khang pa de khar btsun mo de khri la 'dug pa la/ rgyal paus thal mo sbyar zhing bzod pa gsol ba'i tshul 'bri/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig tu btsun mo de rnams 'khor bcas la/ yo byad mang po'i mchod pa dang*/ de rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bka' klog pa dang*/ yi ge 'bri ba'i bkod pa bya/ 'dir de tsam zhig 'bri ste/ yul ko sham+bhir gshegs shing/ khyim bdag gdengs can gyi kun dga' ra ba phul ba dang*/ rgyal po shar pa la sogs pa yul de'i skye bo rnams dge ba la bkod pa'i skabs so/ /ngi) yang yul gcig tu rgyal po'i rnam pa gcig gi mdun na/ rin po che'i khri la/ gzhon nu mdzes pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ lhag ma rgyan cung zad tsam dang*/ gos dkar po can/ lag na par bu 'dzin pa gcig la/ mi mang pos phyag 'tshal zhing 'bul ba byed pa 'bri/ yang gzhon nu de kha skyed mos tshal 'dra ba rwa bas bskor ba gcig na/ slob ma gos dkar po gyon pa/ gtsug phud ma gtogs skra bregs pa/ rna rgyan ma gtogs rgyan spangs pa mang po zhig la bshad pa byed pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ de rnams la la po ti dang*/ la la par bu dang*/ la la gzeb ma 'khris su bzhag pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na gzhon nu de 'dug pa 'bri/

bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i sku chos kyi gral 'jus te 'gro ba dang*/ ri nags tshal dang sman du mas gang ba gcig gi rtse mor rdo leb gcig la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu nags tshal dang*/ sman ljongs nas sman mthu ba'i tshul dang*/ yang ri'i phyogs gcig tu sman rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun du spung*/ ston pa la chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ yang ston pa'i chos gos kyi gra la 'jus pa la tshur 'byon pa'i bkod pa dang*/ skyed mos tshal gyi dbus na gtsug lag khang yod pa gcig na sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms 'bul zhing gzhon nu de nyid chos nyan pa 'bri/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu pos 'phags pa'i gnas la bkod pa'i skor ro/ /(ci) yang yul ljongs gcig na/ khang bzang phyi rim nang rim mang po yod pa gcig na/ lha mo'i gzugs can shin tu mang pos khyab pa/ dbus kyi khang bzang na lha mo gcig dang*/ rgyal po gcig rnams gnas pa/ khang bzang dang shing sogs thams cad nas 'od 'byung ba gcig dang*/ yang de dang nye bar khang pa de kha 'dra ba 'od med pa/ mi phal pa lang long sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ khang bzang na rgyal po gcig yod pa/ gzhan pho brang rnam pa gcig na/ 'od 'phro ba dang*/ lha mo dang nor bus gang ba/ khang bzang na sngar gyi khyim bdag de dang*/ lha mo zhig 'bri'o/ /pho brang gi rnam pa 'dra ba de'i phyi rol na/ yang khang pa gzhan gcig na/ 'od dang nor bu lha mo sogs sngar bzhin la/ phyi la dmag mi tho re ba yod pa/ rgya phibs kyi bya 'dabs

<go cha gon pa'i mi 'ga' re rgyab gzhung kam pa'i tshad tsam bya 'dabs/> la 'phyar ba dang*/ rmog gyon pa'i mgo bya 'dabs 'phyar zhing lus kyang 'phrul du 'dug pa gcig dang*/ yang khyim bdag de'i khyim gyi yo byad thams cad rab byung dang*/ bram ze dang*/ phongs pa rnams la ster ba'i tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'gro ba dang*/ spyan sngar rab tu byung zhing lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri ste me skyes rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa thob pa'i skor ro/ /(chi) yang phyogs gcig na mtsho kha zhing che bas chod pa'i phar phyogs gling gi rnam pa zhig tu khang bzang dang*/ pho brang dang*/ rtswa shing lo ma'i khyim dang bcas pa 'bri/ pho brang de'i skar khung nas bu mo zhig gi nyan pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi gseb na/ tshong pa mang po'i gseb nas tshong pa 'ga' zhig kha ston byed pa/ phyi'i phyogs gcig tu bu mo mchog de 'khor dang bcas pa/ tshong pa de rnams la gtam 'bri ba/ yang phyogs gcig tu des de rnams la yi ge skyes bcas gtod pa 'bri/ yang gling de khar de dang ma 'dres tsam byas nas/ tshong pa mang pos sangs rgyas kyi bris sku phye ba shing ring po la btags pa/ bu mo dang rgyal po dang*/ skye bo mang pos mchod pa byed cing*/ steng gi nam mkha' nas lhas mchod pa byed cing me tog gi char 'babs pa/ khang bzang gcig tu bris sku de bkrams pa'i mdun na/ lus srang thal mo sbyar lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ yang phyi rol phyogs gcig na/ bu mo de 'khor bcas kyi mu tig mang po snod du rdeg pa dang*/ yig snod tshong pa la gtod pa 'bri/ bar gyi rgya mtsho la tshong pa rnams gzings la zhugs te phar 'gro ba dang*/ tshur yong ba gnyis kar 'bri/ tshur phyogs der chu 'gram nas/ thang dang ri dang nags la sogs pas tshur phyogs kyi yul ljongs na/ gtsug lag khang gcig tu sangs rgyas la/ tshong pas yi ge 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ yang gtsug lag khang gzhan gcig gi mdun na/

sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun du ras gzhi rgyangs pa la bris pa zhig gis sangs rgyas la 'dra len byed tshul dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros ras gzhi de la phog sku'i rnam pa gzugs brnyan du shar ba la/ tshon 'gyed pa dang*/ yig mkhan gyi thang ka de'i stod smad du yi ge 'bri tshul dang*/ bris sku snod du bcug de/ tshong pa rnams la sangs rgyas kyis gtod par mdzad pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig tu gtsug lag khang gi nang na sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i mdun du/ tshong pa rnams kyi yi ge dang sgrom bu 'bul ba dang/ sgrom bu kha phye nas mu tig tsho gsum du bgos pa 'bri/ yul ljongs phar phyogs gling der/ chu dang thang la mu tig 'dzin pa'i nya phyis dang*/ rin po che du ma dang*/ nags tshal la glang po ches khyab pa/ khyim gyi bud med rnams bud med kyi mchog 'ba' zhig 'bri'o/ /de ni rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can bden pa la bkod pa ste/ lo rgyus snga ma'i 'phros so/ /(ji) yang bkod pa gzhan zhig la/ yul ljongs phan tshun gnyis byas shing*/ bar de na ri dang nags tshal dang*/ yul ljongs chung ngu 'ga' re bya/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs de na khang bzang gcig na bcom ldan 'das 'khor nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas ste bzhugs pa dang*/ yang khyim bdag pho mo gzi brjid che ba'i mdun na/ bu mo mchog 'khor 'ga' re dang bcas pa 'bri/ khyim de kha'i sgo drung na/ gcer bu pa'i cha byad gzhon nu gcig dang*/ gzhan slong ba po 'ga' re khang bzang la lta ba 'bri/ yang khyim gyi sgo gcig nas/ gcer bu pa'i gzugs can de la bud med mchog des phye snod gang ster ba dang*/ des kyang snyug thags kyi snod gcig tu 'dzed pa 'bri/ bu mo des de la smod pa'i tshul yang 'bri/ yang de dang nye ba gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag gcig gis zhu ba zhu ba dang*/ phyogs gcig nas bu mo de shing rtar bzhugs nas yul phar phyogs de la gtad nas 'gro tshul dang*/

yang phyogs gcig tu gtsug lag khang gi phyi khyams na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la me tog gi khang bzang dang*/ bdug spos kyi sprin dang*/ chu nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can yod pa dang*/ dge slong gcig langs pa la bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsol ba dang*/ yul chung phra mo mang po na/ dge slong mang po yod pa'i sar/ dge slong re res tshul shing 'grems pa'i tshul dang*/ yang yul ljongs gnyis po'i bar gyi yul chung ngu de rnams su sangs rgyas re re skye bo mang po la chos ston pa dang*/ yul chung phra mo mang po na/ dge slong mang po yod pa de sar ljongs phar phyogs de na/ sngar gyi bu mo 'khor bcas tshur yong ba dang*/ grong gi khang bzang du khyim bdag gi bu khyu mchog ces bya bas/ de bag mar slong ba'i bkod pa dang*/ yang khyim de'i phyogs gcig na sgyug mos mna' ma de la gtam smra ba dang*/ 'khor sa'i khyams yangs pa zhig tu/ gcer bu pa mang po 'dus pa zhig la/ sgyug mo de dang khyim bdag de mchod pa byed cing*/ bu mo de gdong phyir phyogs de 'dug pa dang*/ yang khyim de'i phyogs gcig na/ bu mo des de gnyis la gtam smra ba dang*/ khang steng na mchod pa bshams shing*/ bu mo des yul ljongs tshur phyogs de la gdong phyogs de thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ mchod pa nam mkha' la 'phags pa la skye bo mang po lta ba ste/ bkod pa de rnams yul ljongs de kha'i 'og phyogs su yong bar bya zhing*/ de'i stod kyi phyogs dom che sar/ phar phyogs dang nye ba shas che ba'i nam mkha' la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon pa dang*/ tshur phyogs sa mthil la/ grong khyer pho brang sogs 'bri ste/ de yang grong khyer du sleb la khad kyi nam mkha' la/ shing rta'i steng na dge slong gcig glog 'gyu ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa/ de'i rgyab phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon steng 'og nges med la/ shing dang bya dang me tog gi rgyan pa'i brag ri'i rtse mo la/

dge slong yod pa gcig dang*/ seng ges drangs pa'i shing rta la dge slong gnas pa zhig dang*/ glang po che thal kar mche ba drug pa la chibs pa'i dge slong dang*/ gser gyi pad+ma bai ḍur+ya'i sdong bu dngul gyi ge sar can la gnas pa'i dge slong dang*/ bya khyung gis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa'i dge slong dang*/ spyod lam shin tu zhi bas nam mkha' la 'byon pa'i dge slong zhig dang*/ gser gyi ta la'i nags na gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang*/ bai ḍur+ya las grub pa'i khang bzang na gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang*/ glang dkar pos shing rta la gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang*/ ngang pas drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang*/ nags tshal na 'chag cing 'ong pa'i dge slong zhig dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ dpung yan lag bzhi/ bu stong dang bcas pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig 'ong ba'i rnam pa dang*/ la la me 'bar ba/ la la char 'bebs pa/ la la 'od 'gyed pa/ la la gdan gyi zur bzhi nas lha'am gnod sbyin gyis 'degs pa/ la la dkyil krung gi gnas pa sogs thams cad kyang nam mkha'i mthong nas 'ong ba/ de thams cad kyi rjes mtho sar/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sku'i rgyab nas phyag na rdo rje/ g.yas na brgya byin/ g.yon na tshangs pa/ steng na gnas gtsang ma'i lha/ 'og nas 'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyis mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul zhing*/ sku mdun nas zur phud lnga pa sogs dri za rnams kyi rol mo brdung pa/ sku'i gser gyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha' khyab pa 'bri/ mnyan yod nas byon nas de'i bar du mi dang mi min gyi srog chags bdun khri bdun stong bden pa la bkod do/ /de nas grong khyer dang nye ba'i sa sgang mtho ba na/ khyim bdag dang dge slong sogs skye bo mang po la/ bu mo des de dag ston pa'i tshul dang*/ tshur phyogs de'i sa gzhi la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phebs shing*/ skye bo dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/

sgo bco brgyad nas/ ston pa sku'i bkod pa re re 'jug cing*/ dbus kyi khang bzang gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa gtibs pa dang*/ gcig na khang bzang shel las grub pa/ phyi nang thams cad 'khor gyis gang ba la chos ston pa/ steng gi nam mkha' nas me tog gi char 'beb cing*/ lha dang mi ma yin du mas mchod cing chos nyan pa 'bri/ de ni grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel du byon zhing*/ ma ga dha bzang mo la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod pa'i le tshan no/ /(nyi) yang yul yangs pa can mtshon byed kyi grong khyer gcig dang*/ de dang nye ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig tu/ sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag la bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ rtswa'i spyil po sogs gnas mal sna tshogs pa na dge slong dag 'khod pa dang*/ dge slong nam mkha' nas 'byon pa mang pos/ lhung bzed shing tog gis bkang nas dge slong gzhan la ster ba dang*/ 'bras la sogs pa 'bru mang pos bkang nas ster ba dang*/ kha zas kyi khyad par blangs nas ster ba dang*/ sa la 'dug nas rang nyid kyang longs spyod pa sogs 'bri/ de nas yang sa stong gcig tu/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun na/ dge slong rtags mtshan yod pa gcig zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul bya ste/ de lhas sbyin no/ /rtags mtshan ni kha dog dbyibs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'am/ gos la sogs pa'i rtags mtshan no/ /de'i dgos pa 'di rnams grangs du ma 'bri dgos pas/ ma nor bar go ba'i ched do/ /yang dge slong gzhan mang po so sor 'dug pa'i rtsa na yang lhas sbyin de zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul bya/ grong khyer gzhan gcig tu lhas sbyin de dgra bcom pa gcig gi zhabs la gtugs pa yang 'bri/ spyil po gcig na lhas sbyin de mnyam bzhag byas pa yang 'bri/ yul de dang bar du chu bo gaṅga gis chod pa'i yul gzhan zhig tu/ rgyal po'i pho brang sgo 'ga' re yod pa zhig gis sgo gcig nas glang po che dkar po nang du 'ong ba dang*/

gcig nas phyir 'gro ba dang*/ gcig nas rta rgyan gyis brgyan pa yong zhing*/ gcig shos nas phyir 'gro ba dang*/ dge slong snam sbyar gon pa dang*/ khye'u dang bu mo dang*/ rma bya la sogs pa gzhan yang gzugs sna tshogs dang*/ de la khang bzang gi nang nas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra de/ rgyal po dar bab gcig gi rnam pas lta ba dang*/ yang khang bzang gcig tu byis pa lo bdun brgyad 'gro ba'i rnam pa/ gser gyi mdog can rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig rgyal po'i pang du 'gro ldog byed pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig na spyil po'i gnas khang na lhas sbyin la 'khor dge slong mang po yod pa dang*/ rgyal po shing rta la zhugs/ 'khor phru ba zas kyis gang ba mang po dag thogs pas bskor ba ste/ lhas sbyin gyi phyogs su 'gro ba dang*/ lhas sbyin 'khor bcas phyogs yangs pa zhig tu gral sgrigs te kha zas la longs spyod pa dang*/ de dag las gzhan pa'i phyogs gcig gi re zhig gi rtse na/ dgra bcom pa gcig gi mdun na/ lha ser po gos dkar gyon pa zhig gis gtam smra ba dang*/ sngar gyi rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye ba zhig na/ gtsug lag khang phyi ra ba gcig gi nang khang bzang logs gcig na/ sangs rgyas la dgra bcom pa gcig gis zhu ba byed pa dang*/ khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ ston pa'i drung na lhas sbyin zhu gsol byed cing*/ sgo drung de nas de khros te/ mgo bcogs shing 'gro ba'i rnam pa bya/ de nas ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' stsal ba'i tshul dang*/ dge slong ston pa la rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang*/ de dang nye bar dge 'dun rnams phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa dang*/ phyogs gcig tu lhas sbyin la dge slong gcig gis gtam smra ba dang*/ dge slong zhig la dge slong gzhan zhig gtam smra ba dang*/ de nas yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ pho brang gcig mas rgyal po bgres nyams yod pa/ shing rtar zhugs pa 'khor bcas snod mang po kha zas kyis bkang pa thogs pa dang bcas pa la/

pho brang de nyid kyi phyogs gzhan gcig nas rgyal po dar bab des/ rdo rje rtse gcig par grags pa'i mdung phyed pa 'phangs pas/ snod rnams chag ste/ kha zas bo ba dang*/ phyogs gzhan sa khul thag ring tsam zhig tu khang pa khyad par can gyi steng nas/ gzhon nu rgyan gyis brgyan pa nam mkha' la thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil nas dgra bcom pa zhig byung ste/ khang steng du babs pa dang*/ phyogs gcig tu de la chos ston pa'i bkod pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa des rdzu 'phrul gyis kha zas kyi snod chen po blangs te nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ bkod pa snga ma de'i sdebs la/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du/ dgra bcom pa des kha zas de 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ yang bkod pa gzhan la yul phyogs rim pa gnyis byas te/ bar du chu phran chung ngus chod par bya/ tshur phyogs de na gtsug lag khang na sangs rgyas mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ dge slong rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyis shing 'bras dang*/ 'bru dang zas blang nas dge slong gzhan la ster ba snga ma dang 'dra ba 'bri/ de'i 'khris phyogs gcig na/ lha sbyin 'khor bzhi dang bcas pas dge slong mang po la kha zas dang chos gos ster ba yang 'bri/ de nas dge slong mang po lhas sbyin gyis khrid nas 'gro ba dang*/ chu'i pha rol kyi yul de'i sne zin pa'i nags kyi gung zhig tu dge slong de rnams kyis mtha' bskor te 'dug /lhas sbyin dbus su 'dug nas gtam smra/ dge slong gcig tshul shing 'grems pa'i tshul bya/ yang de 'khor bcas phar song ste gnas gcig tu 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos shing rta mang po bza' bcas bkang ste skyel ba dang*/ yang sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu/ lhas sbyin chos ston pa'i tshul byed pa/ g.yas g.yon du dge slong gnyis bzhag pa la gru sug byed pa dang*/ rgyang ring po nas mchog zung gcig 'byon pa'i tshul bya/

yang lhas sbyin gyi g.yas g.yon nas dge slong gnyis 'bros pa dang*/ mchog zung gcig g.yas g.yon du 'greng ste bzhugs pa'i bkod pa gcig yang lhas sbyin chos gos sngas su bcug nas gnyid log pa kha gdengs te nyal pa dang*/ mau 'gal gyi bus nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa dang*/ shā ri'i bus 'khor rnams la chos ston pa dang*/ dge slong gcig gis lhas sbyin gnyid log pa mdzub mos ston pa dang*/ de nas mchog zung gcig gis dge slong dag khrid de byon/ lhas sbyin gnyid kyi non pa/ dge slong gcig gi gnyid gsod tshul byas kyang ma sad pa dang*/ de'i 'khris na rjes la gnyid sad nas phyir snyegs sprod pa'i tshul la/ mdun du grog po chen pos lam chod de mthar nas/ tshur ldog nas khong rang gi grogs dge slong gcig la khu tshur bsnun pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas chu brgal ba'i yul tshur phyogs der mchog zung dge slong de dag lam nas yod pa'i tshul dang*/ ston pa'i drung du de rnams thams cad chos nyan pa/ tshogs pa'i mtha' skor du 'od zer gyis bskor pa 'bri/ de dag ni dge 'dun gyi dbyen byung zhing mchog zung gcig gis bsdum pa'i skabs so/ /(ti) de nas khang pa zhig gi nang na rgyal po bgres nyams cung zad yod pa cigalus rid cing skems pa btson du zhugs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ de'i mdun na dge slong gcig chos ston pa'i tshul dang*/ de'i phar phyogs ri'i ngos la sangs rgyas zhabs 'chag pa'i tshul dang*/ sku las 'od zer 'phros pa/ btson khang de'i dkar khung chung ngu gcig dang*/ brtsig pa gas pa'i ser kha nas zhugs te/ btson khang gi nang 'od zer gyis khyab pa dang*/ yang btson khang de'i phyogs gcig nas skye bo mang po 'dzugs pa dang*/ khang pa de'i phyogs gcig tu/ rgyal po de yang 'das pa dang*/ de'i thad kyi nam mkha' la gzhal med khang gcig na/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi pang na lha'i bu gser mdog gcig yod pa/

de dang btson khang de'i bar gser ris kyis sbrel/ yang phyogs gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun du/ lha'i bu gser mdog des mchod pa mang po byed pa 'bri/ de ni gzugs can snying po rnam thos bu'i gnas su skyes pa'i bkod pa ste gzhan dang 'brel ba ma skyes dgra sdig pa'i grogs pos bzung ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod de/ bkod pa mi mdzes pas re zhig bzhag go /de nas ston pa'i sku mdun na gar mkhan 'ga' zhig gis gar sgyur ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal las 'od zer spros te/ steng 'og gnyis la mtha' med du song pa dang*/ 'od zer gyi sne gcig sku'i mgrin par thim pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de na phyi rgya gcig gi khang pa mi 'dra ba gsum na/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra dar bab de dang*/ lhas sbyin gros byed pa'i tshul re re 'bri/ yang yul ljongs grong tho re ba'i rnam pa'i phyogs gcig na/ mi gcig gi gser bzhu ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gi lhas sbyin gyi lus la gser byug pa dang*/ de'i 'khris su lhas sbyin lus gcer bu gser gyi mdog srab sreb tu song ba gcig 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu lhas sbyin rtsig pa'i tshur phyogs na yod pa/ rtsig pa'i bu gar rkang pa gnyis bcug nas rkang pa phar phyogs su thon pa/ de la lcags mgar 'ga' zhig gis lcags sregs kyi 'khor lo'i par thog nas/ lhas sbyin kyi rkang mthil la sbyor ba dang*/ de bzhin du lag mthil la yang byed pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu grong khyer gyi g.yas phyogs kyi lam du/ mi mang po mtshon cha thogs pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs kyi lam bzhi mdo na yang de lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang lam gyi bzhi mdo dag mi mtshon cha thogs pa 'ga' re 'ga' re yod pa dang*/ sa'i sgang ngam ri chung po do gcig gi rtse na/ lhas sbyin rang yang ral gri dang phub thogs nas gnas pa/ sgyogs 'cha' ba lta ba ri gcig gi rtse mo na/ sgyogs 'cha' ba'i tshul dang*/

ri de'i ri 'gram na gyad 'dra rung zhig 'khor bcas la/ lhas sbyin gyis mu tig gi do shal sogs ster ba dang*/ ri de'i phar phyogs brag g.yangs su yod pa/ de la skas btsugs nas mi mang du 'bab pa dang*/ sgyogs bshams pa'i rtse nas/ gyad lta bu de dang mi gzhan zhig gtam smra ba yang 'bri/ ri de'i phar phyogs ri bo nags tshal gyis brgyan pa zhig la sangs rgyas zhabs 'chag pa'i tshul 'bri/ yang de'i steng 'og nye skor gang 'os su/ ri de gnyis ka sngar dang 'dra ba la/ g.yang sa la btsugs pa'i skras ka de med pa/ ri'i steng la lhas sbyin 'dzegs pa dang*/ ri'i rtse mo lhas sbyin nyid kyis sgyogs thag 'then nas/ sgyogs 'phen tshul dang*/ sgyogs rdo shin tu che ba bar snang la byung bas/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes/ sgyogs rdo de phyed mar btang ba dang*/ gnod sbyin gyad gyi gzugs 'dra ba zhigasgyogs rdo de'i dum bu che ba gcig dang thug nas sa la lhung ba dang*/ phar phyogs kyi ri de'i sked pa na/ ston pas gyad 'dra ba'i mi de sogs mi mang po la chos gsung zhing 'khor bcas 'od zer 'phro ba/ ri'i rtse mo'i phug zhig na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong la/ rdo'i dum bu phra mo zhig phog ste sku mtshal byung ba'i rnam pa dang*/ ri'i sked nas phar gyad 'dra ba de sogs mi rnams mgyogs par bros pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang ri bo nags tshal dang ldan pa de kha 'dra ba zhig gi ngos la/ ston pa 'khor ci rigs dang ldan pa/ zhabs kyi mthe bong las/ sku mtshal gyi rgyun phra mo 'bab pa/ zhal las gser gyi 'od zer spros pa/ steng 'og tu song zhing*/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo mgrin par 'du ba/ de 'dra tshar gsum yod pa las/ gcig gi sku mdun na tshong dpon gyis tsan dan sa mchog 'bul ba dang*/ gcig gi sku mdun na bud med gcig gi rang gi 'o ma snod chung gcig tu 'bul ba dang*/ gcig la sman pa 'dra ba gnyis las/

gcig gis sman 'debs pa dang*/ gcig gis sngags 'debs pa'i tshul bya/ yang de kha 'dra ba gzhan gcig la/ zhal las 'od zer spro ba mi dgos/ sku mdun na dge slong dar yol gcig thal mo sbyar te bzhugs pa dang*/ sku mtshal gyi rgyun chad pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na/ shing drung gcig na lhas sbyin mnyam bzhag byed pa ltar rdzu ba dang*/ skye bo mtshon cha thogs pa 'ga' re yong zhing*/ de mthong nas ldog 'gro ba dang*/ bkod pa de dag thams cad kyi bar na/ dge slong gnyis gnyis gsum gsum tshogs nas gtam byed pa'i tshul mang du 'bri/ de nas yang phyogs gcig na/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi nang na rgyal po dang lhas sbyin gros byed pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi gseb na rgyal po'i nang 'khor thod bcings shig mtshon cha btags pa/ ba dan ring po thogs pas mi rnams la dril sgrog pa'i tshul dang*/ ra ba gcig na glang po che mang po'i dbus na/ glang po che ches che ba yod pa/ rgyal po'i nang 'khor des glang rdzi la gtam smra ba'i tshul dang*/ khyim bdag gcig gis khang pa yangs po zhig gi phyogs gcig na kha zas mang po sbyor tshul dang*/ gtsug lag khang sangs rgyas dang dge slong mang pos gang ba'i phyogs gcig na/ sangs rgyas la khyim bdag gcig gis zhu ba zhu/ phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas kyi mdun du khyim bdag de mchi ma 'byin pa'i tshul bya/ sngar gyi pho brang de'i thog kha nas/ rgyal po dang lhas sbyin gnyis lta ba'i tshul dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ khyim bdag gi khang pa'i bar sa stong yangs sar bzhag la/ sangs rgyas phebs pa la phyogs gcig nas glang po che de sbad cing*/ de yang khros nas rgyugs pa'i tshul dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na dge slong gcig 'dug cing*/ gzhan rnams phan tshun du bros pa dang*/ yang sangs rgyas kyi phyag g.yas pa'i phyag sor lnga brkyangs ba las/ seng ge ral pa can lnga byung nas/ glang po che phar bdas shing phar phyogs g.yang sa dang mes 'khor te 'dug pa dang*/

yang glang po che de tshur ldog nas sangs rgyas la snas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis glang po la phyag gis byugs pa mdzad pa dang*/ khyim bdag gi khyim de'i phyogs gcig gi nang nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs shing*/ mchod ston gsol/ sgo drung na glang po che de 'dug de phyogs kyi khang pa yang shel ltar dwangs par song*/ sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang la gshegs shul du glang po che de yang 'gro ba dang*/ yang glang po che de dbang med du bkug nas rwa bar bcug pa dang*/ rwa kha'i nang du sna zhags kho rang gi rdog pas mnan te shi ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi khyams na/ ston pa'i drung du lha zhig chos nyan pa 'bri ste/ glang chen smyon pa brtul ba ste/ de dag dge 'dun gyi dbyen gyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lhas sbyin rgyal po dang bcas pas bkur sti ma yin pa bgyis kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par mtho bar gyur pa'i sde tshan no/ /(thi) de nas sangs rgyas mnyan yod du gshegs pa'i tshul dang*/ mnyan yod du rgyal po sogs la chos ston pa'i tshul/ yang yul u dum zhes bya ba mtshon byed kyi grong khyer zhig tu byon nas chos gsung pa de dang*/ ri nags kyi bar chod pa'i nags mthong zhig gi mtsho 'gram zhig na/ rin po che'i phung po'i steng du bzhugs khri 'cha' ba'i lha mang po dang*/ phar phyogs nags gseb kyi spyil po gcig na drang srong gcig yod pa'i drung na/ gnod sbyin go mtshon thogs pa gcig kyang 'dug pa dang*/ yang sangs rgyas 'khor nyung ngu dang bcas te grong khyer de la bsod snyoms la phebs pa'i bkod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mtsho 'gram gyi nags gcig na ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang*/ bzhugs khri snga ma 'dra ba'i steng du ston pa bzhugs pa la/ yul 'khor srung dri za'i 'khor gyis bskor bas nor bu sna tshogs thogs pa dang*/ 'phags skyes po grul bum gyi tshogs kyis skor bas mu tig gi thu ba bkang ba dang*/

mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis skor bas me tog sna tshogs dang*/ rnam thos sras gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis skor bas gser sna tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ ston pa'i drung du de rnams 'khor bcas thal mo sbyar te chos nyan pa dang*/ de'i mtha' na drang srong de yang chos nyan pa 'bri/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na rgyal chen bzhi yod pa dang*/ de'i mtha' g.yas na dgra bcom pa cung zad bgres pa zhig dang g.yon du dar bab zhig 'bri/ yang de dang ris chod cing nye ba'i nags mthong grong tho re ba na/ gnas gcig tu drang srong snga ma de'i drung na drang srong gzhan zhig yod pa bram ze'i khye'u 'dra ba gzhan mang po kha zas g.yo ba'i bya ba byed pa/ yang phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ drang srong de gnyis kyis mchod ston gsol ba/ yang phyogs gcig tu drang srong gnyis po 'khor bcas chos nyan pa/ phyogs gcig tu de dag thams cad dge slong du gyur pa 'bri/ de nas yul 'bab chu bzang po zhes bya ba mtshon byed/ grong khyer gcig gi stod na a mra'i tshal gdugs lta bu zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du ston pas dge slong gsum la bka' gnang ba/ khang bzang gsum na dgra bcom pa gsum la gcig la 'khor mang ba dang*/ gzhan gnyis la cung zad nyung ba'i 'khor dge slong gi tshogs kyis skor ba 'bri/ rgyal chen bzhi bden pa la bkod cing*/ drang srong ke na'i bu dang/ drang srong ri bo 'khor bcas bden pa la bkod pa'i sde tshan no/ /(di) yang yul gcig na/ bram ze gcig slob ma gtso bo gcig sogs slob ma mang po la rig byed slob pa'i tshul dang*/ bram ze gtso bo de yul gzhan du 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ yang sngar gyi khyim de 'dra ba na/ bud med gcig dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig gtam smra ba dang*/ khyim de'i phyogs gcig na/ bud med khri la nyal ba gos hrul ba gyon pa/ skra 'dzings pa zhig la bram ze'i gtso bo de gtam smra ba dang*/

khyim gyi phyi rol phyogs gcig na/ bram ze'i gtso bo de mdun na ral gri gcig sa la btsugs/ slob ma'i gtso bo de la chos ston pa'i tshul bya/ de nas bram ze'i slob ma de/ shin tu stobs dang ldan pa 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam par song nas phyogs gzhan gcig na/ lag na ral gri thogs pa/ sor mo'i 'phreng ba mgo la thogs pa/ g.yas g.yon du sor mo bcad pa'i mi mang po shi nas 'gyel ba/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs dang bcas pas dur khrod ltar gyur pa dang*/ yang phyogs gzhan gcig tu/ de rngam zhing ral gri thogs nas rgyugs/ phar phyogs thag ring ba na/ bud med cung zad rgan pa kha zas thogs pa gcig dang*/ de'i bar na sangs rgyas phar gshegs shing phyi ltas mdzad pa zhig 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu/ sa stegs gcig na sangs rgyas bzhugs ste/ de la chos gsung pa'i rnam pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gcig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa'i dbus na/ de yang thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa dang*/ yang phyi rol sa phyogs yangs pa gcig tu/ sangs rgyas nyid sor mo'i 'phreng pa can sogs skye bo mang po mang po la chos gsung pa/ sor 'phreng de la me ris skor ba/ phar log nas rgyal po dpung yan lag bzhis skor te yong ba dang*/ 'khor de'i mtha' rgyal po yang glang po che las babs pa'i tshul dang*/ 'khor tshogs de'i dbus su rgyal po thal mo sbyar te bzhugs pa 'bri/ sor mo'i 'phreng ba brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(ni) yang bkod pa zhig la/ mtha' ri dang nags tshal gyis skor ba/ yul ljongs chen po mi med pa/ klu dang gnod sbyin mi'am ci sogs gnas pa gcig gi lung zur gcig na/ grum mtsho gru bzhi pa gcig gi dbus na pad sdong skyes pa/ dbus na sangs rgyas gzhan yal ga'i pad+ma rnams la/ nyan thos re re yod pa las/ sku'i 'khris kyi g.yas g.yon mtho sa'i pad+ma gnyis stong par yod pa/ mtsho 'gram nas dge slong zhig phyogs gzhan la 'gro tshul/

yang mtsho pad sdong de kha rang 'dra ba la/ sku'i g.yas kyi pad sdong mtho sa de la nyan thos gcig bzhugs shing*/ g.yon gyi de la med pa/ g.yon phyogs kyi nam mkha' la/ nyan thos gcig pha tshad nas 'byon pa/ yul ljongs de nyid kyi dbus sogs ngom che sa na/ g.yas na gser gyi brag ri brag phug can la/ ri chung 'ga' res skor ba/ g.yon na nags kyi dkyil na shing sdong shin tu che ba zhig yod pa de'i 'khris na rdzing zlum po che ba gcig la/ rdzing chung 'ga' res skor ba/ de na glang po che mche ba drug pa zhig nyal ba/ dbus na mtsho gru bzhi chen po/ chu bya dang nya srog chags du ma dang*/ nor bu du mas gang ba/ phyogs bzhi nas chu 'bab pa mtshon byed/ rgyab ma gtogs phyogs gsum gyi pha tshad nas/ brag gi khung bu nas chu re 'bab pa/ mtsho'i dbus su pad sdong dbus kyi pad+ma gser mdog lan sangs rgyas chos 'chad mdzad pa/ yal ga'i me tog mang po la nyan thos re re bzhugs pa/ pad sdong gi 'og chu'i steng na/ klu dkar po gsum pad sdong gi yal ga 'degs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku rgyab kyi phyogs mtsho 'gram nas/ shing sdong shin tu che ba skyes pa/ rtse mo dbu'i gtsug tor las kyang yar thal ba/ yal ga lo 'dabs 'bras bu shin tu rgyas pa zhig 'bri/ de dang ri mang pos chod pa'i phar phyogs yul gcig tu/ sa mthil la grong mang po yod pa'i ri/ rtsa ba nags dang rtse mo g.ya' lta bu gcig na/ phyogs gcig na nyan thos gcig snam sbyar 'tshem pa'i tshul gyis mdun na nyan thos gcig bzhengs pa/ de kha'i 'khris na/ de gnyis kar gyi sor mo lnga char gyis tshem bu byed pa/ yang de kha'i 'khris su/ ri de kha dang 'dra ba'i brag rtse gcig la/ ske rags kyi sne btags pa/ ske rags kyi sne phyogs gcig gis snam sbyar bcings te/ dge slong gcig gis nam mkha' la 'dren pa dang*/ ri de yang g.yo ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ de kha'i 'khris der ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa yo ba zhig la/

snga ma ltar ske rags kyi sne btags shing*/ snam sbyar de dag dge slong gis thogs nas nam mkha' la 'dren pa zhig 'bri/ tshem bu 'tshems pa'i ri de nyid la/ dge slong zhig gnas shing*/ dge slong gcig shos nam mkha' la gnas pas snam sbyar thogs/ ske rags thag gu lta bu shin tu phra ba de/ yul ljongs snga ma'i zur na bris yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'i g.yas g.yon gyi pad+ma la nyan thos med pa'i pad sdong de la btags pas g.yo 'gul ma byung ba 'bri/ las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa'i skabs kyi sde tshan no/ /(pi) de nas yul ljongs tsho gnyis bris pa'i/ tshur phyogs na sangs rgyas 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa dang*/ phar phyogs de'i phyogs gcig na/ rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer gyi sked pa zhig dang*/ pho brang de na rgyal mo khri la gnas pa dang*/ khri gzhan zhig la rgyal po dar ban zhig yod sems khong du chud pa dang*/ phyi rol kyi grong khyer khang pa so so'i nang na mi 'ga' zhig na ba'i rnam pa dang*/ phung po khyogs la btegs nas dur khrod du skyel pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi mtha' rnams dmag gi phru mas skor ba dang*/ chu rnams bskams pa dang*/ mtshe'u la dug 'debs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sprin gseb na sbrul gdug pa sogs gnas pas ser ba 'bebs pa dang*/ lce 'bab pa rtswa shing gseb tu sbrul gyis gang ba 'bri/ pho brang de'i phyogs gcig na rgyal pos pho nya zhig mngags pa dang*/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs der gtsug lag khang gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi drung na pho nya de zhu ba byed pa'i tshul dang*/ yang de'i phyogs gcig na/ khyams yangs pa zhig tu/ rgyal po dang skye bo mang pos sangs rgyas la gdugs tshod gsol ba dang*/ yul ljongs tsho gnyis po de'i bar nas sangs rgyas phar gshegs pa dang*/ ljongs phar phyogs der/ grong khyer gcig gi 'gram nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon pa dang*/ sku mdun nas rgyal po sogs kyis bsu zhing*/

skye bo mang pos mchod pa dang steng nas lha rnams kyis mchod cing me tog gi char 'bebs pa/ gzhan yang mtha' rnams nas char 'bab pas/ chu gsar pa rgyug cing rdzing bu khengs pa dang*/ mtha'i dmag rnams phyogs phyogs su gyes 'gro ba'i rnam pa dang*/ de nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gtsug lag khang gcig la 'byon pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi nang na bzhugs pa sogs 'bri/ yang pho brang gcig gi ba gam gyi 'og na/ rgyal po dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ sras dang*/ blaun po drug gis gros byed pa'i tshul dang*/ de'i 'gram na rin po che'i dbu rgyan can gos dkar po gyon pa/ langs te 'dug pa 'bri/ pho brang de'i sgo drung nas glang po che gcig gi gnya' bar gos dkar po can de zhon zhing*/ lcags kyus kha bsgyur/ glang po che'i rgyab tu/ rgyal po dang gdugs dang rnga yab 'dzin pa sogs 'khod/ g.yas g.yon du glang mo sogs mang po la/ bud med dpal 'bar thogs pa 'ga' re dang*/ gzhan yang yo byad thogs pa dag zhon nas 'gro ba'i bkod pa bya/ phar phyogs na gtsug lag khang gcig yod pa'i phyi rol gyi ne gsing rnams su/ glang po dang*/ glang mo de dag gtod nas bzhag sgo nas rgyal po dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa de 'gro ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi khang mig rnams na dge slong rnams bsam gtan byed pa dang*/ dbus kyi khang bzang na bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na/ rgyal po de thal mo sbyar zhing*/ ston pas chos gsung pa'i rnam pa dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa de sgo drung na 'dug pa 'bri/ yang logs gcig tu rgyal po pho brang gi phyi khyams na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ chos nyan pa dang/ sangs rgyas lam du 'byon pa mthong ba la/ rgyal po khang bzang gi rtse nas 'phyongs/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas gcig gis bar snang nas blangs te sa la 'jog pa dang*/ yang rgyal po glang po che'i steng na yod pas sangs rgyas rgyang nas mthong ba na/

glang po che'i steng nas 'phyongs pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bar snang nas bzung nas sa la 'jog pa dang*/ de'i rjes su lhas sbyin bya ba ma yin pas nyam thag pa'i gtam brgyud mang po zhig yod kyang*/ thams cad 'bri mi langs la/ lhas sbyin shing drung gcig na 'dug pa'i drung na/ 'od srung rdzogs byed kyi rdza'i ril ba spyi blugs bcag pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig gi phyi na lhas sbyin sman mar za zhing*/ thug pa'i snod 'khris su bzhag pa dang*/ nang du zhugs pa'i ston pa'i sku gzhogs su yang*/ sman mar gyis gang pa'i snod yod pa dang*/ phyi rol phyogs gcig na lhas sbyin na zhing 'dre ldog byed pa dang*/ dge slong 'ga' res 'dzin zhing*/ la las lta ba dang*/ khang bzang gcig na ston pa bzhugs pa'i phyag brkyang ba/ shing sdong la sogs pa gzhan gyi phag nas song ste/ na ba de'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pa dang*/ nad drag ste langs nas bzhad gad smra ba'i tshul dang*/ yang ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing bzod pa gsol ba'i tshul la/ ston pa'i zhabs shel du byin gyis brlabs/ lhas sbyin gyi sen mo chag cing*/ sen mo'i srubs su bcug pa'i reg dug sa la lhung ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na dge slong zhig yod pa la ston pas bka' stsol ba'i tshul dang*/ des kyang lhas sbyin bskyor pa'i tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i rgyang ma nas/ lhas sbyin 'gro ba'i rkang pa'i 'og sa'i gseb nas me lhag lhag byung ba dang*/ sags shing me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du lhas sbyin mgo rdog tsam ma gtogs shor/ lag pa thal mo spyi bor sbyar/ sa steng nas kun dga' bos gdams pa byed pa'i tshul bya/ de nas bkod pa'i bar mtshams bcad de/ 'og gi phyogs gcig tu dmyal gyi gnas lcags sregs kyi sa gzhi skor ba gcig na/ lcags kyi khang pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su skyes bu gcig lus la me 'bar zhing*/

gan rkyal du 'dug pa la/ lcags brag chen po nam mkha' nas 'bab pas 'tsher ba dang*/ lcags kyi glang po che me 'bar bas skyes bu gcig rdzi ba dang*/ lcags kyi sog le 'bar bas skyes bu gcig gcod pa dang*/ lcags kyi tho ba me 'bar bas/ skyes bu gcig gi mgo phye mar byed pa dang*/ phyogs de nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'bab pa dag 'bri ste/ lhas sbyin sdug bsngal myong tshul lo/ /yang phyogs gcig na skyes bu gcig gi lce shin tu che ba phyi rol tu bkrams te/ lcags kyi glang rmig pa me 'bar ba dang bcas te gshol lcags me 'bar bas rmod par byed pa'i rnam pa tsho gnyis 'bri/ phyogs gcig na nam mkha' nas char babs pa me'i dug kyis bskam pa'i tshul dang*/ phyogs gcig na mchu dang*/ de'i drung na dge slong gnyis 'bri'o/ /de dag ni ston pa dang chos la sdig bsags pas/ sdug bsngal myong tshul lhas sbyin la dper mtshon pa'i bkod pa'o/ /(phi) yang bkod pa gzhan la/ yul tsho gnyis bar na gang gā mtshon byed chu chen pos chod pa zhig 'bri/ byang ma de'i phyogs gcig grong khyer gcig na/ skye bo mang po na ba'i tshul dang*/ nad bdag 'byung po dang ma mo nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ bram ze gcig la nam mkha' nas lhas lung ston pa dang*/ bram zes skye bo mang po la bshad pa dang*/ yangs pa can gyi li tsa byi rgyal rigs kyi rnam pa can rnams 'dus nas gros byed pa dang*/ de nas pho nya ba bram ze zhig mngags pa dang*/ bram ze de yul ljongs phar phyogs de'i gtsug lag khang zhig na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb pa dang*/ yang rgyal po'i pho brang gi khang bzang gnyis las/ gcig na rgyal po dang bram ze de yod pa dang*/ gcig na rgyal po de blon po 'ga' re dang*/ bka' mchid byed pa dang*/ pho brang gi phyi khyams na/ rgyal po des bram ze la byar dga' stsol zhing bka' gnang ba dang*/ pho brang de'i sgo gcig nas bram ze 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/

phyi'i khang pa gcig na blon po rnams la bram ze gtam smra ba dang*/ phyogs gcig na bram ze des yi ge bris te pho nya rdzong ba dang*/ khyim yangs pa gcig tu sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la rgyal pos gdugs tshod gsol ba 'bri/ de'i phyogs gcig tu ston pa la rgyal po zhu ba gsol ba'i tshul dang*/ sgo drung du ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' gnang zhing*/ de'i nang du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ phyogs de nas chu bo de'i 'gram du sleb sleb kyi bar la lam rnams la phyag dar byed pa dang*/ me tog dang spos sogs mchod pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ yul tshur phyogs de nas kyang chu 'gram bar du/ de ltar byed pa 'bri/ de nas grong khyer na lan da na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du kun tu rgyu rgan po gcig the tshom gcod pa dang*/ de dge slong du gyur pa 'bri/ song ma'i dbyug pa zer ba'i grong khyer chung ngu zhig tu/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs shing*/ slob ma rnams la chos gsung pa 'bri/ de nas chu bo'i 'gram grong khyer yod pa'i phyi nang mchod rten yod pa gcig gi nang nas sangs rgyas bzhugs/ skye bo sna tshogs pa mjal du 'ong ba dang bram ze gcig gcig gis mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ grong khyer de'i phyi rol phyogs gcig na/ lha mang po sa la 'bres rgyag pa gzigs pa dang*/ grong khyer de'i dbus na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phags nas chu 'gram du gshegs pa dang*/ chu bo'i 'gram de na sangs rgyas la gdugs 'dzin pa mang po dang*/ yul tshur phyogs kyi chu 'gram na yang ston pa'i dbu gtsug tu gdugs 'dzin pa mang po dang*/ chu'i steng na klu gdugs 'dzin pa mang po dang*/ nam mkha' la rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams gdugs 'dzin pa dang*/ de las kyang mtho ba'i nam mkha' la brgya byin 'khor bcas gdugs 'dzin pa dang*/ chu de la gru gzing gnyis byas te/ de gnyis la dge slong rnams 'gro ba dang*/

chu'i dkyil nas sbrul mang po sbrul mgo'i gdengs kha byas pa gcig la gcig reg pa'i gdeng kha'i zam pa byas pa'i steng nas bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gcig 'byon pa 'bri/ yul tshur phyogs kyi chu 'gram der gdugs yod pa'i yas mar gang rigs gcig tu/ ston pa bzhugs gdan med pa sa gnon mdzad pa zhig 'bri/ yang chu 'gram de nas rgyal po smra chen 'dzin pa zhes bya bas gser gyi mchod sdong gru bzhi shin tu ring ba bzo khyad can dang*/ de la dge slong gzhan rnams lta zhing*/ gcig rgyab bstan nas chos gos 'tshems pa 'bri/ sa stong de khar bcom ldan 'das kyi sku drung du/ dge slong rnams chos nyan pa zhig kyang bya'o/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra dad pa la bkod pa'i sde tshan no/ /(bi) de nas yul ljongs tshur phyogs der/ yul sgra gcan mtshon byed grong khyer chung ngu zhig tu/ ston pa bzhugs zhing 'khor rnams la chos ston pa'i sar/ nam mkha' nas ne tso zhig 'phur ste 'ong pas/ sku mdun du 'dug ste/ spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ ne tso phar ldog pa na 'ol bas bsad de/ lhar skyes ston pa la chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ba dang*/ spong byed kyi grong khyer mtshon pa'i grong khyer gcig gi ltag na a mra'i tshal mtshon byed kyi gtsug lag khang na ston pa 'khor bcas bzhugs shing*/ lam bar de nas bud med bzang mo rta pa zhig 'khor rta pa bud med mang pos bskor te sangs rgyas mjal bar 'gro ba dang*/ ston pa'i sku mdun du zhu ba zhu ba dang*/ de nas phyogs gcig nas/ yab sras mjal ba'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ shing rta mi dang bcas pa/ sngo ser dkar ljang dmar ba 'khor du ma dang bcas te ston pa mjal du yong ba 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na bram ze gcig la/ li tsa byi mang pos gos re re ster ba dang*/ gos de rnams bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang*/ li tsa byi shing rta nas babs pa de rnams la ston pas chos gsung pa dang*/

grong khyer spong byed kyi sgo bzhi po'i sgo them la dgra bcom pa re res zhabs bzhag ste gzungs mdo 'don pa dang nad gtong pa'i 'byung po thams cad rgyang ring du bros pa dang*/ khyim yangs pa gnyis su sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ sngar gyi bud med bzang po des/ gdugs tshod gsol pa dang*/ cig shos su li tsa byi de rnams kyi gdugs tshod gsol ba 'bri/ grong khyer de'i rgyab na/ 'od ma can gyi grong mtshon byed kyi grong chung ngu gcig gi ltag na/ shing sha pa'i nags tshal gyi dbus na ston pa cung zad sku bsnyung ba'i tshul mdzad pa dang*/ dge slong mang po yul thor bu pa so so na bsam gtan byed pa 'bri/ de nas yul lus 'phags kyi grong khyer mi thi lar gshegs shing*/ skyes pa'i rabs gsung pa'i bkod pa dang*/ sa la zhes bya ba bram ze kho na'i grong gcig tu/ bsod snyoms 'bul ba med par lhung bzed stong pa gyur pa dang*/ bdud sdig can mi'i gzugs dang gtam gsung zhing*/ bdud de rlung 'tshub lta bur byas te yal ba dang*/ yul sdig pa can du gshegs te/ gyad mang pos/ pha bong shin tu che ba zhig mes bsregs pa dang*/ lcags kyi brko zhing gsil ba dang*/ thag pas 'then pa dang*/ gzu byed pa sogs yod pa ltar/ ston pa byon pa dang*/ ston pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong gis mkha' dbyings mthon por 'phangs pa dang*/ de la mi mang po lta zhing 'jigs pa'i tshul byed pa dang*/ de bye mar song bye ma'i phung po byung ba dang*/ slar yang lam gyi logs gzhan zhig tu/ pha bong sngar bzhin du 'byor ba dang*/ de la mi'i lag pa'i shul yod par ston par mdzad pa dang*/ gyad de rnams 'dus pa la chos gsung pa rnams 'bri/ bar der yul so sor byon pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod kyang 'brir ma lang*/ shing sdong shin tu che ba yod pa'i grong gcig tu/ ston pa la bud med gcig gis bsod snyoms 'bul zhing chos ston la 'od zer steng 'og gnyis su song nas gtsug tor du nub pa dang*/

khang pa'i phyi rol du bram ze la chos ston pa rnams 'bri/ de nas gi ba li zhes bya ba'i nags khrod du/ lo ma'i spyil por ston pa bzhugs pa dang*/ ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' stsol ba dang*/ nags gcig na bram ze mang po gnas pa'i sar/ dge slong de sbrul gyis gdengs ka bdun du byas te gnas pa dang*/ bram ze'i drang srong de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du chos nyan pa dang*/ de nas ku ru'i yul gyi nags tshal na bzhugs pa dang*/ skye bo mang po 'dus te chos ston pa dang*/ de'i phyogs gcig na dge slong gcig gis rgyal po la chos ston pa dang*/ de nas grong khyer glang po can du bram ze gcig gis ston pa la bstod pa 'bul te/ 'od zer steng 'og tu spros te gtsug tor nub pa dang*/ yang bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas chos gsung pa la bram ze gcig ri chung gcig gi rtse nas lta ba dang*/ ston pas bram ze la bka' bkod mdzad pa'i tshul dang*/ bram zes khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu sbyin sreg gi thab kha bshig pa'i 'og gi sa 'bru ba dang*/ de nas tsan dan sa mchog gi mchod sdong thon pa dang*/ mchod sdong de dang ston pa'i sku tshad mnyam par byung ba dang*/ mchod sdong de la dus ston chen po byed pa 'bri/ yang bcom ldan 'das bram ze'i grong la gshegs pa'i tshul dang*/ phar phyogs grong khyer gcig na/ skye bo du ma 'dus pa la/ mu stegs can rnams gtam smra ba dang*/ de rnams dmag chas ste tshur 'ong ba la/ rgyal rigs rgan po gcig gis gtam smra ba dang*/ bar gyi nags gseb gcig na dmag rnams bsdad pa la/ rgan po des me btang zhing*/ de rnams kyis me bsad kyang ma gsod pa dang*/ ston pa phebs pa'i phyogs nas me zhi ba dang*/ dmag mi rnams go phud de ston pa la chos nyan pa dang*/ bram ze'i grong du phebs nas skye bo rnams kyis mchod pa dang*/ nag po grong du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gtan/ stan gcig gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa dang*/

gnod sbyin gyi gnas gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung na gnod sbyin mang pos skor ba la/ gnod sbyin glang chen stobs zhes bya ba gcig tshur yong ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang lnga brgya mtshon byed kyi gtsug lag khang mang por/ 'khor dge slong mang po la rgun 'brum sogs shing 'bras 'bul ba ste/ de dag ni yangs pa can rnams 'jigs pa las skyabs pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(mi) gtsug lag khang de'i nang du sangs rgyas yang dag 'jog la bzhugs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dang phyag na rdo rje lhan cig tu nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang*/ nags tshal sngon po yod pa gzigs shing*/ yul gcig na gnod sbyin gdug pa can gyi skye bo mang po la gnod pa byed pa las/ mi rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'gram na gnod sbyin de yang 'dug pa dang*/ yang gnod sbyin de la dgos su chos gsung pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang rtsig pa dang*/ de kha 'dra ba gzhan yang gnyis 'bri/ yang nags tshal dang 'bab chu du ma yod pa zhig na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang steng nas mtshon cha'i char phab pa me tog gi tshal du gyur pa dang*/ klus du ba btang ba las/ ches che ba sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang*/ des me sbar ba las ches che ba sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes brag ri'i rtse mo la rdo rje 'phangs pas/ ri nyil zhing*/ klu'i gnas rnams non pa dang*/ yang klu rnams 'bros par rtsom pa las/ mtha' mes 'khor ba dang*/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du klu sog ma med de/ chung ma dang*/ bu dang mna' ma dang 'khor dang bcas te skyabs 'gro dang*/ bslabs pa zhu ba'i tshul bya/ de'i lag gcig na/ phyag na rdo rjes/ rdo rje gsor bas gar mdzad pa 'bri/ yang bcom ldan 'das dang phyag na rdo rje lhan cig nam mkha' la gshegs shing*/ mtshal sngon po mtsho dang bcas gzigs pa dang mtsho gcig na klu'i pho brang gnyis yod pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das mtsho nang du byon pa la klu de gnyis chos nyan pa/ klu'i pho brang gi rgyab phyogs na mtsho la sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ klu de gnyis lta ba dang*/ yang sangs rgyas dang phyag na rdo rje nam mkha' la gshegs te/ ri gcig rgal ba'i pha rol na/ yul ljongs chung ngu zhig 'bri/ yul de'i zur gcig na gnod sbyin mo srin mo 'dra ba zhig gis byis pa mang po za ba'i tshul la/ g.yas phyogs su mdung zhags pa gcig 'bri/ yul de'i 'dabs na sangs rgyas la bram ze dang khyim bdag mang pos mchod pa byed cing chos nyan pa dang*/ yang phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ yang phyogs gcig na bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ba' zhig gi gser gyi ril ba spyi blugs thogs nas sangs rgyas la zhu ba'i tshul dang*/ de dag gi 'gram na gnod sbyin mo srin mo'i lus can de yang chos nyan pa'i tshul bya/ logs gcig na bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin mo de kho na la chos ston pa dang*/ mi rnams kyi gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i tshul bya/ gzhan yang yul ljongs gcig na/ srin po srin mo mang po la chos ston pa dang*/ yang gcig na klu rnams 'dus pa la chos ston pa dang*/ yang gcig na lha sna tshogs 'dus pa dang*/ yang gcig na gnod sbyin sna tshogs 'dus pa dang*/ yang gcig na mi'am ci sna tshogs 'dus pa dang*/ yang gcig na 'byung po gzugs sna tshogs 'dus pa dang*/ yang gcig na nam mkha' lding sogs bya sna tshogs 'dus pa dang*/ yang gcig na lha ma yin dang lha min gyi bud med sna tshogs la chos gsung pa ste/ skabs der mi ma yin gyi gtso bo mthu che ba/ rdzu 'phrul che ba 'bum phrag bdun cu don bdun brtul ba mtshon byed do/ /de dag las 'byung po gzugs sna tshogs bcos pa ni/ 'di lta bu dag yin te/ seng ge la sogs pa mgo brnyan sna tshogs dang*/ mgo mi la lus dud 'gro sogs su 'dug pa dang*/

lus gcig la mgo mang po dang*/ mgo gcig la lus mang po dang*/ lus mgo med dang*/ mgo lus bral ba dang*/ lag mang dang*/ lus phyed pa dang*/ phrag mig dang*/ mig mang dang*/ rkang mang dang*/ rkang gcig dang*/ rkang med dang*/ kha mang po dang*/ rkang lag la sogs pa yan lag srog chags sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du 'dug pa rnams so/ /de nas nam mkha' la phyag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tshur byon pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gcig gi nang du bcom ldan 'das mnyam bzhag mdzad cing*/ sgo drung na dge slong gcig yod pa dang*/ phyi khyams na dge slong mang po bzhugs pa 'bri ste/ 'di ni thun gcig la/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa ste/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud du gshegs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(tsi) de nas gtsug lag khang de'i 'gram nas sangs rgyas dge slong gcig dang gshegs pa dang grong khyer chung ngu gnyis rim gyi brgyud nas/ ri gcig na nags tshal sngon po yod pa/ gcig ston par mdzad pa dang*/ grong khyer gcig gi 'dabs su byon pa la/ sngon por gyur zhes bya ba'i bram ze gcig gis bstod pa 'bul ba dang*/ bram ze de la chos ston zhing 'od 'phro ba dang*/ bram ze mang po gros byed pa dang*/ yang de rnams bram ze la smod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas grong khyer du phebs la khad pa las/ grong khyer gyi sgo drung na lha mo gcig lus gcer bur phyung nas 'dug pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi g.yon phyogs sa stong gcig la 'byon pa dang*/ ri chung gcig gi phug na bzhugs pa dang*/ ri'i rgyab kyi nags nang na/ byis pa bong bu la zhon pa dang*/ bong bus byis pa za ba dang*/ ri de'i 'gram tshur phyogs na/ sangs rgyas la 'khor mang pos bskor zhing mchod pa 'bul ba la/ de'i 'gram na gnod sbyin te/ 'byung po bong bu'i mgo can zhig la/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin nyis stong lnga brgya mtshon byed kyi gnod sbyin mang po thal mo sbyar ba 'dri/

de nas mi rnams kyi phyogs gcig tu gtsug lag khang lnga brgya bzhengs pa dang*/ phyogs gzhan gcig tu nyis stong lnga brgya bzhengs pa mtshon byed gtsug lag khang chung ngu mang po bzhengs pa tsho gnyis/ de nas yul ljongs gzhan zhig na/ zhing pa mang po zhing rmod pa'i phar 'gram na sangs rgyas 'byon pa dang*/ de'i phyogs gcig sa stong gcig la sangs rgyas bzhugs shing*/ zhing pa rnams 'dus pa la/ sangs rgyas chos ston pa dang*/ phyogs gcig na glang thams cad gnya' shing chu thag bcad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mtha' skor du 'khod pa dang*/ nags gcig na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i drung du bram ze dpon slob mang po zhig chos nyan pa dang*/ nye skor de na rta dkar pos drangs pa'i shing rta dag yod pa/ de nas bran mo rgan mo zhig khron pa nas chu 'dren pa dang*/ kun dga' bos lhung bzed du chu slong ba dang*/ zur gcig tu bud med mchog dang*/ rgan mo de ston pa la chos nyan pa dang*/ bram ze gcig gi zlum ra chu'i gang ba dang*/ de ston pa la chos nyan zhing dge slong du gyur pa ste/ bcom brlag dang o ta la sogs su byon pa'i bkod pa'o/ /(tshi) de nas yul ljongs gcig na nem pa la sogs pa'i shing gi nags tshal gcig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i drung du rgyal po 'khor bcas kyang thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i lam phyogs lam gnas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas tshur yong ba dang*/ phar 'gro ba gnyis char gyis/ pho brang gi nang du rgyal pos blon po rnams la bka' sgo ba dang*/ khang pa'i phyi khyams na kha zas mang po bsham pa dang*/ phyogs gcig gi khang bzang na rgyal po gnyid log pa dang*/ de'i nam mkha' la 'od skor gcig gi nang na/ grong khyer gyi mtha' rgyal po rang gi rgyu mas dkris pa gcig gi hal mtshan gyis phra mor 'bri/ de nas khang bzang gi phyogs gcig tu/ rgyal po dang bram ze zhig gtam smra ba dang*/ khang bzang gi nang zhig na rgyal po gcig por 'dug pa dang*/

pho brang gi phyi rol du mi mang po bsags pa na/ blon pos bka' sgo ba dang*/ grong khyer che chung mang po'i srang kha na/ dge slong gnyis te brda' sprod pa'i tshul dang*/ pho brang de'i sgo nas dge slong gnyis brda' sprod pa'i tshul 'bri/ phyogs gcig na tshong pa rta khal mang po can yong pa dang*/ tshong pa de rnams khal spog nas 'dug pa'i sar/ tshong dpon dang dge slong gcig gtam smra ba'i tshul dang*/ ri nags tshal can gcig gi 'gram na/ dge slong gcig gis dge slong rnams la tshul shing 'grem pa dang*/ ston pa'i drung du dge slong gnyis zhu ba byed pa dang*/ de gnyis phyogs gzhan gcig la 'gro tshul dang*/ ri de'i sked pa tsam na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa la tshong dpon de 'ong nas/ so so nas phyag 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ phyogs gcig tu bu mo gcig gis nas brdung zhing*/ dge slong zhig sa steng mtho ba gcig na bzhugs nas de tsho la chos 'chad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ ri'i rtsa ba na rta lnga brgya mtshon byed rta mang po yang bcom ldan 'das la lta zhing skad 'byin pa'i tshul dang*/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig na bu mo lnga brgya mtshon byed bu mo mang po yang thal mo sbyar zhing smon lam 'debs tshul byed/ yang sngar gyi pho brang de'i 'khris su/ khang bzang de 'dra rung gi sgo tha dad na phyogs kyi pho nya pa mang po yod pa dang*/ sgo bsrung gcig la gnas brtan gcig gi gtam smra ba dang*/ sgo nang ma gcig la sgo bsrung gis 'khrid de/ dge slong de 'gro ba dang*/ rgyal po'i drung na yang yang dge slong yod pa 'bri/ sngar gyi ri de'i 'khris su ri de ka 'dra ba zhig la phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas kyi drung na/ dge slong gcig mchil ma 'byin pa'i tshul/ ston pa'i phyag g.yon du lhung bzed bsnams/ g.yas kyi nas 'bru gcig dge slong de la gnang ba'i tshul bya/ sngar gyi dge slong phar phyogs gnyis po tshur 'ong pa dang*/

ri de'i phyogs gcig na rgyal po 'khor bcas ston pa la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul byed/ pho brang staing ma de'i phyogs gcig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ rgyal po des bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas yul gzhan la gshegs pa'i tshul 'bri/ ri steng ma de'i phyogs gcig la/ dge slong rnams kyi lo ma'i spyil po dang*/ rtsa'i spyil po dang*/ rang shong khang bu dag bshig par brtsams pa las/ ston pas bzlog pa dang*/ bkod pa de dag dang ri nags kyi chod pa'i yul ljongs chung ngu gcig na/ ri rtse gsum pa gcig la dge slong gnyis bzhugs shing*/ brgya byin gyi bdud rtsi 'dren pa 'bri/ de dang phyogs mi gcig pa ljongs snga ma de dang ri nags kyi chod pa'i yul ljongs gcig na phar shing rta 'bras kyi bkang ba dang*/ mi mang po 'gro ba'i mdun nas/ dge slong gi gzugs can gcig gi bzlog pa dang*/ yang shing rta song ba la/ char pa dang*/ 'obs chen po'i rgyun la ma thar ba rnams 'bri ste/ grong khyer sgra mthar dbyar gnas pa'i bskor ro skor ro/ /(dzi) yang bkod pa gcig la/ chu 'gram gcig la ston pa 'khor bcas gshegs shing*/ chus shing sdong chen po khyer ba gcig dang*/ chu 'gram na ston pa 'khor mang po chos gsung pa'i 'khris na/ gnag rdzi rgan po gcig chos nyan zhing 'khar ba sa la btsugs pa/ sbal ba zhig gi steng du khel ba dang*/ sbal ba lhar skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan pa dang*/ de dang nye ba'i ri sul mang po gcig na phar rgan po de song bas phyugs rdzi la sogs pa'i mi mang po 'bros pa dang*/ grong gcig gi mi rnams go cha gyon pa dang*/ rgan pos gnag phyugs rnams bdag po so so la gtod pa'i tshul dang*/ tshur lam rgan pa de phyugs rdzi mang pos skor nas ston pa'i drung du sleb la khad pa/ ston pas chos gsung pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ 'od 'phro ba 'bri'o/ /de nas chu bo chen po gaṅga'i steng la bcom ldan 'das res gru dang res chu la zhabs bzhag gin phebs pas ngang pa mang po bskor ba byed pa dang*/

nya mang po bskor ba byed pa dang*/ rus sbal mang po bskor ba byed pa dang*/ ston pas kyang chos gsung pa'i rnam pa dang*/ gaṅga'i tshur 'gram du phebs pa na/ de rnams lhar skyes pa ston pa la chos nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ yang phyogs gcig na yi dwags lus keng rus lta bu lto ba che zhing gdong dang lus skras g.yogs ba/ kha khab mig tsam/ mdog nag phra thor re ba mang po la bcom ldan 'das kyi chu bo ston par mdzad pa dang*/ de rnams kha chen por song ba la/ dge slong gcig gi chu blud pa dang*/ de dag shi nas lhar skyes pa la chos ston pas bden pa mthong ba 'bri/ yi dwags kha khab mig tsam ni rgya gar gyi ri mo khungs ma las/ sbrang bu'i mchu ltar ring ba'i rtse na/ kha'i bug ga yod pa'i rnam pa bris 'dug go /de nas ji skad du/ gzhon nu skye dang glang chen skra/ /dpung rgyan ldan dang nor bu can/ /sa la stobs dang sa la'i stobs/ /gser bre dang ni gnas bcas dang*/ /thug pa dang ni mnyan yod dang*/ /ma dros grong khyer sin+du dang*/ /yangs pa can ni tha ma yin/ /zhes yul mang por byon par bshad pa las 'di tsam zhig 'bri ste/ bram ze dbul po zhig zhing rmo ba'i sar/ bu mo zhig gi thug pa bskyel ba dang*/ de dang nye ba'i lam na sangs rgyas 'byon pa dang*/ bram zes thug pa sangs rgyas la phul ba dang*/ thug pa de khron pa rnying pa gcig tu blug pas khron pa khengs pa dang*/ thug pa de sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gsol yang nyung du ma song zhing*/ khron pa nas rlang pa 'thul ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bram ze la chos ston pa dang*/ kho'i zhing gi nas sogs lo thog thams cad gser 'ba' zhig tu skyes pa dang*/ ston thog rgyal po dang bgo bsha byas pas/ rgyal po'i de rnams 'brur song*/ bram ze de rnams gser du 'dug pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang thon mkhan gcig gi lcags te rgyang ring po nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ de dag nye bar ston pa bzhugs shing sa 'og nas/
