lha dang klu rnams kyi rin po che'i sgrom bu'i snod byung ba dang*/ de kha phye ba'i nang nas sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring srel ma nyams pa thon pa la/ skye bo mang po phyag mchod byed cing lta ba dang*/ yang de sa 'og tu nub pa dang*/ phyogs gcig nas rgyal po 'khor bcas 'ong pa dang ldog pa gnyis 'bri ste/ lho phyogs lnga len kyi gaṅga'i tshugs gshegs pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(wi) de nas khyim khang bzang can gcig na khyim bdag gcig gis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ phyi sgo nas sprang po mang po 'jug tshad pa la/ sgo srung bas bsrung ba dang*/ sprang po gcig sprang po gzhan rnams gyi skrod pa dang*/ de phyags dar gyi phung po'i gseb na mgo la rma byung nas 'dug pa dang*/ston pa dang nyan thos gcig de'i 'khris su gshegs nas/ de la kha zas stsol ba dang*/ sprang po ston pa'i phyi bzhin du 'gro ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang du ston pa'i de la bka' stsol ba dang*/ de dong tse gnyis thogs nas me tog gi ra ba'i sgo drung na 'dugs pa la/ mi gcig gis gtam smra ba dang/ dong tse de la gtad de me tog ut+pal mang po blangs te/ gtsug lag khang du 'gro ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun rnams la des ut+pal re re 'bul ba dang*/ de nas sprang po de sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ phyogs gcig tu mnyam bzhag byed cing lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ ston pa 'khor bcas yul gzhan du gshegs pa dang*/ yul ljongs der rgyal po'i pho brang zhig tu mchod ston gsol ba dang*/ ri bo nags tshal can la sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang phyi ra bas skor ba'i rdo chal yangs pa zhig tu/ phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la mchod ston gsol ba dang*/ phyogs gcig tu bram ze dang khyim bdag mang pos sangs rgyas la zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi sa la/ ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' bsgo ba dang*/

nags gseb gcig la dge slong 'gro zhing mtsho gcig gi 'gram du zas za ba dang*/ lhung bzed 'khrud pa dang*/ phyogs gcig na skyil krung bcas nas 'dug pa la/ mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa me tog gi char par song*/ du ba 'thul ba dang me 'bar ba 'bri/ phyogs gcig tu klu la dge slong des chos gsung pa 'bri/ de dag ni klu ar mra chu ngogs pa brtul ba'i bkod pa ste/ chu srin byis pa gsod ky-i ri la bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(zhi) de nas khyim khang bzang can zhig gi nang na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la khyim bdag cig gis gdugs tshod gsol ba dang*/ sgo drung du 'od srung chen po phyags dar khrod gyon pa sgo bas ma btang ba dang/ 'gram gcig tu mu lto ma mdze mo zhig gis 'bras khu 'od srung la phul ba dang*/ phyogs gcig tu 'bras khu 'od srung la phul ba de gsol ba dang*/ de dga' ldan gyi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas ston pa la chos nyan pa dang*/ 'od srung la rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi pho brang du bsod snyoms gsol ba dang*/ yang gtsug lag khang du sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ rgyal pos mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod de/ na bza' gser gyi mdog can phul ba dang*/ zas kyi lhag ma sa la bo ba rnams mul lto ba rnams kyis khyer ba dang*/ rgyal po bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na 'dug cing*/ mul lto ba gcig sgo khang na 'dug pa dang*/ yang de kha dang 'dra ba gcig la/ rgyal po phyogs gzhan du 'byon zhing*/ sgo srung gi mul lto ba rnams sprod pa dang*/ yang gtsug lag khang gi nang na sangs rgyas la rgyal po zhu ba mdzad pa dang*/ de ma yin pa'i gtsug lag khang gcig tu sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ bza' btung dang*/ na bza' dang*/ sman dang*/ mar me dang*/ 'bru mar gyi bum pa la sogs pa mang po zhig 'bul ba dang*/ sprang mos gyo mog tu mar me spar te/ khyams su bzhag nas smon lam 'debs pa dang*/

phyogs gzhan gcig na mar me gzhan rnams shi gyo mog gi mar me de ches 'bar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ ston pa'i zhal las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ gtsug tor du thim pa dang*/ dge slong gcig gi chos gos kyi dras g.yob pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis bzlog par mdzad cing*/ shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung ston pa dang*/ yang gtsug lag khang gcig tu/ ston pa'i drung na rgyal po gsal rgyal thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa rnams 'bri ste/ 'ga' zhig byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pa'i skabs so/ /(zi) de nas grong brdal me tsu ru di mtshon pa'i grong dang*/ gtsug lag khang na ston pa chos gsung pa dang*/ de'i khang bzang na ston pas rgyal po gsal rgyal la chos gsung pa dang*/ sgo drung nas bram ze gcig shing rtar bzhugs ral gri dang*/ rnga yab cod pan thogs te 'gro ba dang*/ shing drung bskam se ba gcig na/ ston pa bzhugs/ rgyal po dar bab gcig phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ dmag tshur yong ba dang phar ldog pa dang*/ grong khyer gcig tu ston pas skyes pa bud med mang po la chos gsung pa dang*/ 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ shākya lhag ma rnams bden pa la bkod pa'i skabs so/ /('i) yang rgyal po'i pho brang dang bcas pa na/ pho brang nang na rgyal pos bram ze la gsung 'byon pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ ston pa dge 'dun rnams la chos ston pa'i sku mdun du/ bram ze de yang zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul bya/ de nas ston pa 'khor bcas lam la phebs pa'i tshul dang*/ gaṅga'i lho phyogs kyi grong khyer gcig gi dbus su bzhugs shing bram ze des mchod ston gsol ba dang*/ grong khyer de'i nub sgo nas byon/ byang phyogs su 'khyogs/ gaṅga'i tshur 'gram nas mi snang bar mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan skye bo sna tshogs pa ni/ sdod gru dang*/ shing leb dang*/ ra skyal sogs la 'jus te gaṅga la 'gro ba te/ tshur 'gram nas mi snang ba sogs kyi rigs 'di la/

rnam pa gsal ba zhig 'bri dka' bar 'dug kyang*/ 'di ltar bya ste/ tshur 'gram tu sku gsal po gcig dang 'ja' 'od ban bun gyi dkyil na rib se ba zhig 'bri/ phar logs su yang 'od kyi dkyil na rib se zhig dang*/ de drung na sku gsal ba 'od 'phro ba zhig 'bri/ gaṅga'i byang ngos yangs pa can mtshon pa'i grong khyer gyi nang na/ khang pa chen po gcig la khang bzang du ma yod cing sgo bzhi pa/ grong khyer de'i ltag na gtsug lag khang yod pa na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs shing*/ khyim bdag gcig dang li tsa byi mang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bka' mchid 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ grong khyer gyi dbus kyi khang pa chen po de'i nang gi phyogs bzhi'i khang bzang bzhi kar na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la mchod ston gsol ba/ shar ma na khyim bdag cung zad rgan nyams yod pa zhig lho ma na khyim bdag mo gcig nub ma na gzhon nu gcig byang ma na bu mo gcig rnams thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul 'bri/ phyogs bzhi'i sgo nang nas dge slong re re lta ba'i tshul dang*/ sgo bzhi'i phyi na li tsa byi 'ga' re 'ga' re 'dus te gtam smra ba 'bri/ sgo nang phyogs bzhi char na phyi khyams re yod pa la g.yog pho mo las kyi mtha' sna tshogs byed pa dag 'bri'o/ /de nas yul ljongs de'i phyogs sba dang*/ snyug ma'i nags mang po yod pa'i grong khyer chung ngu gcig gis 'gram gyi skyed mos tshal na/ ston pa nyid bzhugs shing*/ glo rten la cung zad snyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang*/ sku mdun du dge slong gcig zhu ba zhu ba dang*/ grong chung sna tshogs dang*/ phug dang*/ shing drung rtsa spyil sogs yul ljongs de'i gnas ma nges pa rnams na dge slong mang po dag 'khod pa'i tshul 'bri'o/ /de dag dang nye ba'i mtsho 'gram zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa na/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa dang*/ sngar gyi grong khyer che ba de phyogs su bsod snyoms la 'byon pa dang*/

tsa sa la'i mchod rten gyi 'khris shing drung gcig tu bzhugs pa nas/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsol ba dang*/ kun dga' bo cang mi zhu ba dang*/ de nas yang shing drung gcig na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs/ shing drung gzhan gcig na kun dga' bo 'dug pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na bdud sdig can thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul gyi 'dug pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba'i ltas chu 'khrugs pa dang*/ ri 'gul dang*/ khang pa 'khyogs pa sogs 'bri'o/ /yang de'i phyogs gcig tu dge slong gcig gis dge slong thams cad bsdus shing*/ ston pa'i drung du 'dus nas chos nyan pa dang*/ de nas phar lam la gshegs shing*/ yangs pa can la phyi ltas kyi gzigs pa'i tshul 'bri ste/ rgyal bo'i khab dang yangs pa can gyi gdul bya mthar phyin pa'i sde tshan no/ /(yi) de nas ru rta'i grong dang*/ dum bu'i grong dang*/ a mra'i grong dang*/ dzam bu'i grong dang*/ rdzi grong dang*/ shur pa'i grong dang*/ longs spyod kyi grong dang*/ grong chung brgyad po rnams su gshegs nas/ shing sha pa'i tshal na bzhugs/ der yang sa g.yos skar mda' lhung*/ phyogs dmar zhing 'bar bar gyur/ bar snang nas lha rnams rnga brdung ba/ de nas gyad yul sdig pa can gshegs pa ste/ ston pa 'khor bcas lam la phebs tshul dang*/ dza lu dka'i tshal zhes bya ba skyed mos tshal 'dra ba gcig na bzhugs pa dang*/ gyad dang skye bo mang po 'ong zhing*/ ston pa'i spyan sngar chos nyan pa dang*/ de'i mtha' cig tu mgar ba'i bu btsun pa zhu ba 'bul ba dang*/ de nas yang phyogs gcig tu btsun da'i khang pa'i khyams su/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la lcags gzhong gi snod nas/ 'bras can bzang po zhu ba dang*/ yang ston pa 'khor bcas yul gzhan la gshegs te/ chu zhig brgal ba dang*/ mi ring bar gzims pa'i tshul dang*/ kun dga' bos gsol lhung du chu bo de nas chu len pa'i tshul dang*/ shing rta mang po chu'i phar logs su 'gro ba dang*/

chu de'i zhabs 'khrud pa dang*/ yang lam du bzhugs pa la/ gyad g.yog mang po dang bcas pa cig mjal ba dang*/ ston pas de la ston pa dang*/ de ras gser mdog zung gi na bza' 'bul zhing*/ sku la gsol ba dang*/ de nas ston pa'i sku shin tu kha dog gsal ba mtshon byed du 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba la dge slaung rnams gyi the tshom zhu ba dang*/ de nas chu bo gcig gi nang du bzhugs te/ sku khrus mdzad pa dang*/ chu 'gram du na bza' gcig pas bzhugs pa dang*/ btsun da'i the tshom gcod pa dang*/ chu bo de'i bar 'gram gyi phyogs gcig tu gzims pa'i tshul las/ drung du kun dga' bo bzhengs pa dang*/ de nas yang phar byon te yul ljongs gcig gi smad na gyad kyi grong khyer yod pa/ stod na skyed tshal 'dra ba ljon shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mtha' gnyis na/ sa la'i sdong po shin tu che ba yod pa/ de'i dbus su gzims khri dbu sngas dang bcas pa bshams shing*/ tshal der phebs pa dang*/ khri la gzims pa'i tshul dang*/ grong khyer de'i phyogs gcig na/ gyad mang po 'tshogs pa la dge slong gcig gis gtam smra ba dang*/ gyad bud med 'khor dang bcas pa yar yong ba dang*/ tshal de'i phyogs gcig tu de dag la chos gsung pa dang*/ tshul gyi phyi rol tu kun dga' bos gyad rnams la bslabs pa'i gnas 'bogs pa dang*/ de rnams grong khyer du ldog ste 'gro ba dang*/ yang sā la zung gi tshal snga ma bzhin tshar gcig bris/ ston pa glo rten la snyes pa'i tshul gyi sa la bzhugs shing*/ sku mdun na dge slong lus las 'od cher 'phro ba zhig 'dug pa dang*/ de langs te phyi la 'gro ba dang*/ kun dga' bo bzhugs khri'i rkang la 'jus te/ spyan chab 'byin pa'i tshul dang*/ de'i g.yon zur phyogs thag ring ba zhig gi nam mkha' la/ sprin gyi sgribs pa'i gseb nas/ ri rab kyi rtse sum cu rtsa gsum gyi grong khyer mtshon byed la/ gzhal med khang zhig na dri za pi waṃ brdung ba zhig dang*/

sgo drung na yang de 'dra ba'i bai ḍur+ya'i pi waṃ brdung ba zhig bya/ de dang dri za'i sgo srung gtam smra ba dang*/ khang bzang nang gi dri za de la yang*/ sgo srung des gtam smra ba 'bri/ de nas dri za'i rnam pa de gnyis khang bzang gi phyi rol du/ pi waṃ gi rgyud yongs rdzogs yod par brdung ba dang*/ rgyud phyed tsam bcad snyam byas te brdung ba dang*/ gcig rgyud thams cad bcad nas 'khris su bzhagagacig gi rgyud bcad kyang phyag tu thogs nas glu len pa'i tshul 'bri/ de'i phyogs gcig na ston pas dri za de la chos ston pa'i rnam pa zha/ sā la zung gi tshal dang de'i bar gsar ris phra mo zhig gi sbrel lo/ /sā la zung gis tshal steng ma de'i sgo drung na/ kun tu rgyu rgas 'khog pa zhig dang*/ dge slong zhig gtam 'dri ba dang*/ tshal de'i nang phyogs gzhan zhig na/ ston pas kun tu rgyu de la chos gsung pa dang*/ de'i lus las 'od 'phro zhing*/ de dge slong du gyur/ tshal gyi phyi rol du de mnyam bzhag bcas te mya ngan las 'das pa/ mu stegs can rnams kyi mu stegs pa'i gzugs su mthong ba'i bkod pa gcig gzhan rnams kyi dge slong gi gzugs su mthong ba'i bkod pa gcig mu stegs rnams kyi khyogs btegs kyang ma thegs/ rdzing bu'i dbus su rdo rtegs la bzhag nas zhugs la 'bul rgyu'i rdzing gi chu la bying zhing*/ chu'i srog chags kyis smugs pas chu 'gram nas don cing bros pa dang*/ dge slong rnams kyis khyogs kyang theg chu la bying zhing srog chags kyis gnod pa med pa/ mu stegs kyi me spar bas ma 'bar/ dge slong rnams kyis spar bas 'bar ba la skye bo mang po lta ba 'bri/ yang sā la zung gi tshal gsum pa zhig kyang byas te/ gzims khris steng du gzims pa dang*/ sku'i mtha' dge slong rnams kyis skor ba la/ gzims pa'i ngang nas chos gsung pa dang*/ nam mkha' la bzhugs nas/ sku stod kyi na bza' gsol nas dge slong rnams la ston pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/

de'i mtha'i g.yas g.yon rgyab steng phyogs rnams lha'i khrom chen po go ma tshams med pa dang*/ mdun gyi phyogs tshal gyi phyi na mi'i 'gro ba 'khor rnam pa bzhi/ skyes pa bud med sogs gnas pa dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan dang ri dwags dang*/ rta glang la sogs srog chags du ma yod pa'ang 'bri/ mchod pa'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa thogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' nas me tog gi char shas che ba dang*/ gos dang rin po che dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad kyi char pa yang tho re ba 'bri/ de nas de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs gcig nas/ lcags kyi sgrom bu dkyus ring po kha gcod can kha gcod kyi steng du gzo khyad kyi khebs dang ldan pa/ gyad kyi btegs pa la thegs pa dang*/ mchod pa mang po 'bul ba dang*/ slar btegs pas thegs pa'i tshul dang*/ sgrom gyad brgyad kyi btegs nas/ mtha' skor du mchod pa byed mkhan mang pos skor/ ras bal gyi khur thogs pa mang po dang*/ ras kha dog sna tshogs mang po dang*/ gser gyi bum pa thogs pa sogs kyis skor nas 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ grong khyer gcig gi nub sgo nas 'dzugs pa'i tshul dang*/ dbus nas 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ shar sgo nas 'thon pa'i tshul dang*/ chu bo gcig brgal 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ chu'i pha rol mchod rten gyi 'gram du bzhugs su gsol/ lam de dag thams cad du me tog dang*/ spos dang na bza'i char 'bab pa dang*/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams rol mo brdung ba'i bkod pa bya/ der shing gi phung po'i steng du lcags kyi sgrom bu bzhag ste/ mi rnams kyis me spar ba'i tshul byas pa las/ me ma 'bar ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ de'i drung du dge slong zhig gis gyad la sogs pa'i mi rnams la gtam smra ba dang*/ de rnams mchod pa byed pa/ yang de kha'i khris su dge slong 'od srung chen po dge slong mang po'i 'khor gyi skor nas yong ba dang*/ lcags kyi sgrom bu kha phye nas gdung la lta ba dang*/

ras zung lnga brgya mtshon byed 'bul ba dang*/ yang kha bkab ste sgrom bu de tsan+dan gyi phung pau'i steng du bzhagame rang 'bar du byung ba'i tshul bya/ de nas yang de dang nye bar gser gyi bum pas 'o ma blug te me bsad pa dang*/ sol ba'i dbus nas me tog gi sdong po chen po zhig skyes pa dang*/ gdung sgrom slar kha phye bas tshems che ba bzhi ring bsrel gyi phung po dang*/ chos gos gnyis kha dog ma nyams shing ma tshig par 'dug pa dang*/ phyogs gcig tu ring bsres de dag gser gyi bum par bcug ste/ khri chen po la bzhag ste mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ de dag las zhugs la zhen pa dang*/ gdung sgrom kha phye ba dang*/ gser gyi bum par ring bsrel bcug pa'i gnas skabs de dag las/ dge slong dang skye bo dang lha mang po mtha' skor ba'i tshul bya/ de dag ni mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar bstan pa'i sde tshan no/ /(ri) de nas yang bkod pa gzhan yul ljongs gnyis yod pa zhig bya ste/ tshur phyogs de'i dbus na grong khyer dang*/ chu rlung dang*/ phar phyogs na mchod rten dang*/ gser gyi bum pa 'od 'phro ba la/ skye bo mang po mchod pa byed pa 'bri/ grong khyer gyi nang na gyad go mtshon thogs pa dang*/ bud med rgan gzhon rnams kyang mda' gzhu dang ral gri thogs pa sogs 'bri/ rta dang glang po dang shing rta bshams pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol dang*/ yul ljongs phra mo mi 'dra tsam bdun dang*/ dmag tsho tshan bdun yod pa la/ gnyis kyi mgo mi bram ze yin la/ gzhan dmag dpon rgyal rigs kyi rnam pa 'bri'o/ /de rnams re re'i drung du/ bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa gcig rim gyi song nas so sor gtam smra ba'i tshul dang*/ sngar gyi bum pa mchod pa dang bcas pa'i nye skor der/ bram ze gnyis gyad gnyis/ rgyal rigs bzhi rnams mtha' nas skor ba dang*/ dbus su gser gyi bum pa kha phye nas/ bram ze des de dag cha brgyad du bgo ba dang de dag so so'i lag tu gser gyi bum pa sku gdung gi gang ba re re gtod pa dang*/

bram ze gcig gi gdung sol rnams 'khyer ba dang/ bram ze rgan pa de nyid kyis lcags kyi sgrom bu 'khyer ba dang/ grong khyer gyi dbus su gyad de rnams gyis mchod rten byed pa dang*/ dmag tsho bdun po de dag kyang*/ sku gdung gi bum pa glang po che la bkal te mchod pa dang bcas nas gyes 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ rgyal po'i tshul can gnyis kyis tshems mche ba re thogs te 'gro ba dang*/tshems mche ba gcig lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi thogs nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ de nas ra sogs kyi chod pa'i yul ljongs gcig tu/ dmag tsho gcig rnams chu bo gcig gi 'gram du khru ma btab te gnas pa las/ sku gdung gi bum pa dang tshems mche ba gcig klus khyer te/ klu rnams chu la song ba'i bkod pa dang*/ yul ljongs gnyis yod pa'i phar phyogs der/ grong khyer rgyal po'i pho brang dang bcas pa'i 'khris na skyed mos tshal gcig dang*/ skyed mos tshal der bram ze gcig gi bkod pa byas nas/ ri mo mkhan gyi ri mo 'bri ba'i tshul de yang sku bltams pa dang*/ bdud brtul ba dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ cho 'phrul dang*/ lha babs dang*/ myang 'das kyi bar du bris pa mtshon byed gnyis ri mo phra mos hal tshon du bri/ gzhong pa mar khus bkang ba bdun dang tsan+dan gyi lde gus bkang ba gcig bshams/ der rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang byon zhing*/ bram ze des ri mo la rten bshad byed pa'i tshul bya/ de nas rgyal po de 'gyel ba dang*/ mar khu'i nang du lus bcug pa dang*/ tsan+dan gyi lde gu'i nang du bcug pas sos pa'i tshul 'bri/ de'i phyi rol tu glang po che la chibs pas kyang lhung ba'i tshul bya/ de nas phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ dpung yan lag bzhi mdun du bshams/ rgyal po nyid khri la 'dugamadun du bram ze yod pa la bka' gnang ba'i tshul bya/ yul de kha'i phyogs gcig gi ri la/ 'od srung chen po mnyam bzhag byed pa dang*/

sa'i mthil la 'od srung 'khor dge slong mang pos skor nas/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs la chas pa'i rnam pa dang*/ yul ljongs gnyis po'i bar de dag tu 'od srung 'khor bcas la/ ras zung 'bul ba mang po byung ba'i bkod pa dang*/ rgan zhugs gcig tshur yong ba'i rnam pa yang bya/ 'di la rgyus sde tshan gong ma dang 'brel ba yin yang yul ljongs kyi bkod pa phyi ma dang 'brel bar bya dgos pa yin/ de dag ni sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i bskor ro/ /(li) yang bkod pa gzhan ni/ gyad gyi grong na 'od srung chen po'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi la chos ston pa'i tshul dang*/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams 'phya smod byed pa'i tshul dang*/ 'od srung chen pos dge slong gzhan zhig la bka' stsal te/ des kyang dge slong tshogs pa la khrims su bca' ba smra ba dang*/ 'od srung lam gzhan gcig la byon/ dge slong des gtso mdzad pa'i dge slong gzhan rnams lam gcig shos de la yong ba'i tshul bya/ yul ljongs phar phyogs der rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar 'od srung 'byon pa dang*/ rgyal pos pho brang gi rtse nas mthong bas sangs rgyas dran te 'phyongs pa dang*/ 'od srung gi sprul pas bar snang la bzung ste sa la bzhag pa dang*/ pho brang gi nang du 'od srung khri la bzhugs pa'i drung du rgyal po 'dug pa dang pho brang de'i g.yas phyogs su bya rgod phung po'i ri dang*/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi bar n+ya gro rda'i phug ces bya ba/ phug pa chen po gcig dang*/ mtha' skor du phug chung mang po yod pa/ dge slong rnams der 'ongs pa'i tshul dang*/ phug pa chen po'i nang du 'od srung chen po la dgra bcom pa rnams kyis skor ba/ phug chung rtsa spyil/ lo spyil sogs na dge slong sna tshogs pa yo byad dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad sbyor mi sogs kyang 'bri/ phyogs yangs pa gcig tu 'od srung dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ dge slong chen po gcig la 'od srung gi gtam smra zhing tshul shing gtod pa/

dge slong de sa sgang gzhi gcig gi phyogs bzhir blta zhing*/ mchil ma 'byin pa dang*/ de la 'od srung gi gtam smra ba dang*/ phug de kha 'dra ba gsum gyi bkod pa 'bri ste/ gcig tu khri'i steng na snam sbyar mang po brtsegs pa la/ kun dga' bo bzhugs shing*/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyis mtha' bskor te chos nyan pa dang*/ nam mkha' nas lha dang mtha' bskor nas 'byung po rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i bkod pa bya/ gnyis pa der gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ nye ba 'khor gtso bor byed/ gsum pa der gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'od srung gtso bor byed/ de rnams yul bkod snga ma de la yod par byed cing*/ de dag las gzhan phyogs chu dang ri sogs mang pos chod pa/ yul chung zhig gi nags kyi dbus na khang bzang yod pa zhig na/ dge slong gcig mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i mdun na/ dge slong gcig langs te gtam smra ba 'bri/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la me dpung bzhi 'bar pa'i phyogs bzhi nas chu rgyun bzhi 'bab pa gcig na/ yul grong gcig na skyes mos tshal gcig tu dge slong gcig mnyam bzhag mdzad pa la/ slob mas mdun nas gdams ngag smra ba dang*/ de dang phug kyi sa phyogs kyi bar der/ dge slong dpon slob gnyis phar 'byon pa dang*/ tshur ldog pa gnyis ka 'bri ste/ de dag ni 'od srung gis mdzad pa bka' bsdu dang po'i skor ro/ /(shi) de nas bstan pa'i gtad rabs phyi ma rnams la/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos mdzad pa mtshon byed/ 'phags pa nyid rin po che'i khri la bzhugs nas/ 'khor rnam bzhi'i tshogs dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs 'dus pa la chos ston pa 'bri/ sha na'i gos can gyis mdzad pa mtshon yang de kha dang 'dra ba zhig 'bri/ nyer sbas kyi mdzad pa rnams kyi nang nas/ 'di 'bri bar bya ste/ ri nags tshal gyis brgyan pa/ phug pa dang gtsug lag khang yod pa gcig bya/ der dgra bcom pa des/ rab byung dang skye bo mang po la chos ston pa dang*/

sa mthil du yul grong ngo bo gcig yin kyang bkod pa so sor 'bri dgos te/ chung ngu drug tsam bya ste/ dang po 'bru'i char/ gnyis pa gos kyi char/ gsum pa dngul/ bzhi pa gser/ lnga pa nor bu/ drug par 'dod yon sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab cing*/ mi mang po yang ri nas babs te graung de dang de dag tu 'gro ba 'bri/ grong bdun po ni/ grong khyer che bar byas te/ de'i dbus kyi phyogs gcig na gar mkhan pho mo mang po la skye bo mang po thams cad lta ba dang phyogs gcig na de dag gi mgo dang mgrin pa la dge slong de dag gcig gis me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dogs pa dang*/ phyogs gcig na gar mkhan de rnams kyi mgo dang mgrin pa ya khyi ro rul ba/ mi ro rul ba btags shing*/ lus kyang rgas 'khogs su bris la/ skye bo thams cad sna bkag cing gdong phyir phyogs pas 'dug pa dang*/ phyogs gcig na gar mkhan tshul can bdud de rnams dgra bcom pa de la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ logs gcig na/ dgra bcom pa las dma' ba tsam na sangs rgyas bzhengs sku 'dra ba la/ dgra bcom pa thal mo sbyar ba lha'i gzugs 'gyel ba dang*/ rlung 'tshub sna lngar yal ba rnams 'bri/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol du/ khri mthon po la dgra bcom pa de bzhugs shing*/ 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba la chos ston pa/ 'od zer gyi phyogs thams cad khyab pa dang*/ yang ri dang phug sogs snga ma de kha 'dra ba zhig la/ phug pa de shing bu phra mos phal cher khengs pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du dgra bcom pas slob ma dge slong mang po la chos ston pa 'bri/ de dag ni nyer sbas kyis bdud brtul zhing sa steng dgra bcom pas khyab par mdzad pa'i skor yin no/ /dhi dhi ka ra dang*/ nag po dang*/ legs mthong rnams kyi mdzad pa yang*/ kun dga' bo'i skabs kyi de kha dang 'dra ba de 'bri/da ni bris sku'i gtso bo la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa 'bri tshul ni/

dbus su ston pa nyid khri rgyab yol sogs bkod pa lhun chags shing*/ sku tshad che la 'tsham pa/ rgyab yol rgyan sna drug sogs ji ltar mdzes pa dang*/ srog chags bzhugs gdan ni/ srog chags rin chen pad+ma nyi zla dar gyi blo stan zhes gdan drug brtsegs su byed pa legs shing*/ srog chags ni seng ge kho na'am/ glang seng spel/ rin chen ni rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma nyi zla go bar zad/ dar gyi blo stan ni/ zab chen gyi phyi g.yogs byas pa'i/ 'bol gdan lta bu stan nang tshad can no/ /sku'i g.yas g.yon gyi rim pa dang po la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'bri ste/ sku'i g.yas su 'jam dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po dang*/ phyag rdor zhi ba'o/ /de la kun bzang sku mdog dmar po/ bum pa dang pad+ma dmar po nyi mas mtshan pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi dbu'i thor gtsug rtse dang*/ ston pa'i sku dpung mnyam pa tsam rim pa gnyis pa la/ nyan thos chen po bzhi 'bri ste/ mchog zung*/ kun dga' bo/ /'od srung ste bzhi'o/ /yang na sgra gcan 'dzin/ 'od srung/ ka ta'i bu/ nye ba 'khor/ de rnams phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i rnam pa byang sems nyan thos de dag bzhengs pa bzhugs pa ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham pas chog /rim pa gsum pa bzhugs khri'i 'og thad la yong pas/ mdun gyi dbus su rgyal po dang*/ btsun mo 'dud pa'i rnam pa dang*/ g.yas su tshangs pa ser po sha nyams rgyas pa/ gdong bzhi ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ phyag 'og ma gnyis na ril ba spyi blugs dang*/ dbyu gu 'dzin pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can/ tshangs skud dang ldan pa/ de'i rgyab tu khyab 'jug sngon po/ phyag 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo dang*/ be con dkar bo 'dzin pa/ zhi ba rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ g.yon phyogs kyi dang po brgya byin ser po dpral pa mig gcig phred la yod pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis na 'jig rten pa'i rdo rje dgu pa dang*/

rin po che 'dzin pa zhi ba dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i rgyab tu dbang phyug dmar po yid tsam khro ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug la zla bas brgyan pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍa ma ru dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sbrul gyi do shal can mgul rgyan gyi dbus na thod skam yod pa/ rgyan lhag ma rin po che ste/ de ltar lha bzhi char yang*/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ yon bdag la sogs pa 'bri na de'i ji ltar 'os pa 'bri/ go skabs yangs na 'khor phra mo'i rigs/ sems dpa' sems ma/ dge slong*/ dge slong ma/ skyes pa/ bud med/ klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa 'bri zhing*/ bar snang la gser gyi me tog gi char dang*/ ngang pa/ ngur ba/ rma bya/ khrung khrung la sogs rin po che'i phreng ba dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i snye ma mchus 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon du cha yod pa 'bri/ steng gi nam mkha' mtho sa la/ sprin gseb nas lha dang lha mo mang pos mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'o/ /gang ltar yang lhun zhing brjid chags pa/ mthong ba tsam gyi dad pa 'dren pa 'bri bar bya'o// //de ltar na ston pa'i rnam thar bris yig 'di ni/ sa la spyod pa'i dbang phyug phun tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung gi bskul nas/ kun dga' snying pos pho brang chen por nges par brjod pa'o/ ༈ swa sti/ mnyam med bu ram shing pa'i rnam thar mchog/'gro kun rab dga'i sa la 'god pa'i ched/ /snying po'i don mthong blo gros yangs pa yis/ /rgya mtsho che bas chu rlung 'babs pa bzhin/ /mi zad par du sgrub pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug sems can thams cad kun/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i mdzad pa'i tshul rnams dang*/ /ring por mi thogs de 'dra kho nar shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ston pa shākya'i dbang po'i mdzad pa brgya pa'i bris yig rje btsun kun snying gis mdzad pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 10 -- PAGE 127 -- PAGE 8 -
